In the upper part of the painting, on clean canvas, black, yellow, blue abstract surfaces alternating with smaller geometric shapes and signs. Through the middle of the four panels runs a wave-shaped transverse, highly relief surface pressed from a tube in white paint.
f7d3a41d91683299629a7c5d1cf5c00a2df17e03: architect, graduate of the University of Tartu (Faculty of Technology 1935-1936), University of Helsinki architecture 1937-1940, Munich Technical University architecture 1942-1944, Ontario College of Art (Toronto) ceramics 1982-1992, architect at the Bavarian Ministry of Finance's construction department 1945-1948, Sweden 1948, to Canada 1949, lecturer of architecture at the University of Toronto, also private architect 1949-1982, visiting professor at the Royal Danish Academy of Fine Arts 1964, professor emeritus 1982
76a5d4dee5b01679797c774145f93704ce837a41: Was a high-ranking Russian state official, one of the creators of the vicegerency system. Was secretary of the Russian embassy in Copenhagen and in 1749-1755 in London. In 1756 major in the Russian army, ober-quartermaster, 1764-1776 Governor of Novgorod, 1776-1781 of Tver, 1777 also vice-governor of Pskov and Novgorod, privy councillor. In 1793 became Russia's envoy in Warsaw, etc. Married his cousin Elisabeth von Sievers, from whom he was divorced; the woman married Prince Putyatin, with whom they lived in Dresden.
ca6b1260f1088df1e76c1c64472675d870dd8e2d: On a deep blue background on the right, a pale nude figure as if given in nocturnal moonlight, eyes with dark lashes lowered, a smile on the lips, a white cloth around the hips. To the left of the female figure, at the bottom edge of the picture, a green bottle and a brown vessel. At the left edge, a man in profile cut off by the edge of the picture, wearing a wreath of flowers on his head. In the centre of the background a window opening through which the night starry sky is visible, on the windowsill a small red blossom. At the right edge a purplish-white drapery.
12c15abdab4030050a1425f9d118dfa84cff1b85: On a yellowish-brown base covering the lower third of the painting, in the left golden section lies a pumpkin, a cut-out piece of which is placed on the right. In front, two peaches. Behind the pumpkin piece on the right a plate with blue plums, partly with stems and leaves, behind it on the right a conical goblet with red wine. In front of the plate three red plums and a small plum branch, whose leaf extends over the edge of the table. In the background on the left edge of the picture a blue plum with stem and leaves.
c3789f6f85651190f192b3b9d45826d1561c53e3: On the left side of the sheet depicting a fresco bordered by architectural details and sculptures, an atlas figure, seen from behind, carries a console of a ceiling beam. Beside him, below, two boy fauns, above them two putti. On the right again an atlas figure carrying a console, surrounded by four putti. On the fresco a Roman soldier stands before a cart harnessed to a pair of oxen, forcibly halted, which two men are pushing around. In the foreground a man grabs a large stone from the ground.
41637ee9ee81aa271da3dc786dac3de097614200: Three men sitting in a plain interior, shown in half-profile. On the left a man with a cap and side whiskers, almost in full profile to the right, pointing with his left hand towards those sitting opposite, while his right hand holds a double-barrelled shotgun resting on the floor. On the right an older man wearing a lakki-type cap, in profile to the left. His right hand holds a curved pipe in his teeth, his left hand rests on his knees. Between the two, seen frontally, a young peasant man in a felt hat and folk costume.
d25225a93ca8293f0c2216e862b081301b21a29c: Flower painting - depicts, with bold brushstrokes and vivid colours, three kinds of flower bouquets in vases. Half of the upper surface of the painting shows, in yellow and orange tones, a bouquet of globeflowers, whose blossoms spread over the entire upper painting surface. In the centre of the picture a small light-coloured vase with blue forget-me-nots, at the bottom right pinkish-purple flowers. The background (lower part) of the painting is rendered with abstract surfaces of old-rose, bluish-green and dark brown colour.
7249723c6b9569088bb8ce56620a007fe89a0752: Black-and-white autumnal photograph printed on satin fabric of an abandoned outdoor swimming pool area in Kadriorg. The area with stone slabs between the pool and the water slide is covered with moss, grass and leaves; on the pool walls, the stand and the part of the building adjoining the stand there is graffiti, the bottom of the small pool is entirely covered with dark shimmering tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ("Pools"), defended as a bachelor's thesis in the printmaking speciality at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.
40bcbcc3f0abc578f47bf9e1e8050a1caf69d62e: A construction formed of a circular shape made of three larger strips left over from die-cutting, and five smaller circular shapes and thin vertical tubes; each circular element rests on a clock ruby placed on a needle at the end of a tube, sliding there freely and beginning to rotate under the influence of the airflow from a fan; below the construction an electric fan operates, whose wind sets the parts of the construction rotating.
145f4e76462f39e34d9fee5d28fbe5124554c1c4: On a low sandy beach, against the background of a rolling sea, lies the body of a young drowned girl. In front of her kneels a grey-haired old man, holding the girl's hand with his left hand and reaching out with his right hand an open locket with a miniature portrait. On the left stands, with his back to the viewer, a black man who has raised his crossed hands above his head in despair. In the distance the mast of a sailing ship wrecked in the waves is visible. Washed up on the sand are a barrel on the left and, in the foreground, a log with a rope.
2a1330ade16723c59d9810b77ce33d556bc3033a: The artist Epp Margna was born in 1965 in Tartu. She graduated from the Tartu Art School in painting and design in 1984. After graduating she worked at the Tallinn Art Combine ARS, and later also as an art teacher. She has mainly worked as a freelance artist. She has participated in exhibitions since 1994. Member of the Tartu Artists' Union. Her work is characterised by an ethnofuturist style and a strong connection to South Estonian tradition and folklore.
69311814bc6385da9d6fd24b206788cb8575a2e3: A decorative landscape painting in vivid colours depicts a view from a height down onto a fjord. The background is a blue sky with pinkish-purple clouds. In the foreground at the bottom centre stylised coniferous trees in green-orange tones, on the left slightly farther away smaller dark-coloured trees. The ground in green-orange-blue tones, in places at the bottom right of the painting a bluish rocky surface is indicated. On the low horizon the opposite shore in purplish-greenish tones.
b397739313f438ae864af80274ff17ac877eb555: A three-quarter portrait, front-facing and seated, of a girl with short hair and a straight nose line. Wearing a jacket with lapels and a skirt, hands folded on the knees. Painted in a geometricised manner, coloured facets form a structure that is generalised into an image. In the background on the left facets reminiscent of a bundle of rays, on the right larger light brown surfaces. Greys, cold greens and ochre tones are used, in places paper is also glued on, in places also fabric.
0e764f99683b7ff1a1870de9c91e83c43de6fdcc: In the foreground, slightly to the left of the vertical centre line, a red-haired dancer with shoulder-length hair, in a dress gathered at the neckline, fitted at the waist and full below. Her right hand is raised to her ear and holds a coloured fan-like object. Behind the woman on the left stands a man in a black cloak and a wide-brimmed hat, holding her by the hands. On the woman's head a black hat with a small crown and wide brim, with a red ribbon around it. The background consists of brightly coloured shapes.
c2077ada16c1409759450467b88006a14adcb033: In the work of Caroliina Ladva (1997), inward contemplation and the poetics of natural landscapes intertwine. Her art is characterised by a material-based and experimental approach, in which traditional handicraft meets a dialogue between different materials on the themes of memory and landscape. Ladva graduated from the Pallas University of Applied Sciences in the textile speciality in 2024 and has taken part in several group exhibitions in Estonia. She is a member of the Estonian Textile Artists' Association.
c9aec2a5d29e1a5ef5a05c8fd7c0dd5c1fb4f5e4: A sketch for a multi-figure composition: on the strip of beach in the foreground, fishermen and beach women in white headscarves form compositional groups. On the beach a few horses harnessed to carts, four small-sailed boats have been pulled ashore. At the right edge fishermen's huts with reed roofs, with individual trees behind them. On the horizon a dark sea, above a cloudy sky. In an overall greyish-brown colouring all details are rendered sketchily.
7e4730f9bf1f7d5182e7782cebd31d6e68466d9b: In 1924 he joined the Estonian Artists' Group and became its spiritual leader, in 1928 he edited the EKR's programmatic almanac Uue Kunsti Raamat (The Book of New Art), in 1926-1927 the Estonian Art yearbook, and in 1928-1929 the youth magazine Taie. He participated in the exhibitions of EKKKY and RaKÜ. He published art criticism in the newspapers and magazines Olion, Looming, and Kunst ja Kirjandus. He worked as a teacher in Tallinn schools until 1945 (J. Westholm Gymnasium, among others), after which he was a freelance artist.
d0c5e29eb05f94d5c5afbe22152264942d419663: Last places of residence: Karksi and Karksi-Nuia (the building of the Karksi parsonage), later Viljandi. In 1946-47 he became acquainted with Elmar Kits (1913-1972) and Evald Okas (1915-2011), who often came to visit Robert in Karksi for the summer (an influence on his taking up art). As a painter R. Meister was mainly self-taught. His favourite genres are landscape and flower painting. According to the recollections of his daughter, Mari Meister, her father painted throughout his entire life. He was also a passionate fisherman.
9371cde55059b447bc3a067c00aa0005200d6975: Sirje Piir was born in 1955, graduated from the Tartu Art School in 1978 in the speciality of artistic design, and has worked for over 30 years as an artist-designer and computer graphic artist. In addition to her main work, alongside design work and computer graphics, she has also painted and drawn. She has been interested in seeing the patterns, forms and colours of nature and in painting from nature. In Sirje's opinion, colour is the painter's main means of expression. She has been participating in exhibitions since 1990.
c9bd154daf2dcde31db873b3fb557e775e7fadd5: Front view of a section of the facade of the hotel "Kopli" with a neon sign. In the middle, an advertisement with the word: KOPLI, below it, on a dark base projecting from the facade: hotell, (the same in Russian). Surrounded by a sandy-brown, half-decayed wall, on which, at left, is the house number plate with a light above it, part of a cable. Above, in the middle and at right, part of open windows is visible. A slide has been used. Painted in beige, bluish tones with putty knife, spray gun, brush, in places very impasto.
d0a9d95ae9edfa9249c501f6dcf68f9c89c9b79a: Kristiina Laurits (b. 1975) completed her master's studies in the Department of Jewellery and Blacksmithing at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2003 and furthered her studies in jewellery art at Escola Massana in Barcelona. Since 1995, Laurits has taken part in more than 70 jewellery exhibitions both in Estonia and elsewhere in the world. Her works are held in various jewellery collections and galleries in Estonia, Finland, Germany, the Netherlands and the USA. Kristiina Laurits is a member of the jewellery art group õhuLoss.
b611405f3830e5a7acd1a38a4349f29b265bf169: A rectangular three-part composition depicting three nude female figures. On a blackish-yellow background at right, a large painted woman in full view, arms stretched upward-forward, left leg raised at the knee, right leg cut off above the calf. At left, a kneeling figure in side view, cut off above the thigh, hands behind the head. Spanning both parts of the painting, at upper left, a curled-up female figure, legs entwined above herself. Dark greenish colour scheme, vigorous brushwork.
e5f7771768c0612354ae8d52c169282e518fa62c: Karolina Peterson is a multimedia artist whose work combines video, installation, performance and scenography practices. In the course of her scenography studies she discovered video art and has in recent years focused on exploring its various forms and possibilities. Her work encompasses music videos, narrative video works, performance documentation, animation and a feature-length film, which was created as her bachelor's thesis.
277821de311935b3f5b223a91f3a6da4c4e915a5: A hollowed landscape between low, gently sloping hills, with a narrow winding river running diagonally from the lower left corner of the painting. In the middle ground of the picture plane, from the right edge to the left golden section, a narrow grove of bushes with two lighter-coloured deciduous trees at its end. In the background, at the right golden section, a house among trees. On the horizon, across the whole width of the painting, a bluish strip of forest. In the sky, purplish-pink white cumulus clouds. The painting's colour scheme is in light tones.
91e9260d7be3b0af8809bef18b8f2034752164a6: Three-quarter figure of a young woman in side view facing right, dark hair in a bun, head turned over the shoulder, gaze directed downward, hands behind the back. The woman has soft facial features, a serious expression, wearing an airy white dress with a stand-up collar and long sleeves. The background is pale yellow, an olive-coloured landscape with a pinkish sky. The face and head are carefully modelled, surrounded by a dark contour. The body area is marked energetically with chalks, leaving the underlying surface visible.
ee5df68975c135e412f43d61f1b35a3d614d2bec: In the foreground, a girl's legs in white knee-socks and high-heeled shoes, seen from behind. In the background at left, a crouching girl with long hair in white knee-socks, at right a man in profile looking out of a window. At upper right, small text: eagles dont use stairs. In the middle, large white text: Charmingly in Charge. At lower left: Freckie Koala, at right: Logan Embers. At bottom: Carbonary Pictures presents. In the lower right corner, a logo and text: While Away Films
fad66cde6f394d0584ad5898cc8e98b0a0766127: Graphic artist. Was among the reformers of Estonian graphic art in the 1960s (introduced electrographic screen printing). Sought documentary quality in his work. Cultivated, alongside free graphic art, book graphics with novel compositional methods (P. Rummo's "Proloog ja probleemid" 1961, H. Jürissoni's "Puu silmapiiril" 1966). From 1975 designed a series of infographic maps, including a cultural-historical atlas of Estonia (writers' birthplaces, architectural monuments etc. 1995).
c0170a7517838b7145cc3b7bfca04e640f74f317: A multilayered abstract composition on a base sewn together from old painted canvases, painted with dripped paint and a spatula. Predominantly in a combination of white - black - blue. The lower left part is a bluish-black painterly rectangular surface. The upper and lower right half of the painting are painted with soiled white spatula strokes. At bottom centre, written with an airbrush, grey text: POVERTY STINKS, at bottom right, painted impasto in the paint surface: FOR EVER AND EVER.
4260a2a7a1d269eb00deb11f7ef189d2a22d4c2a: A landscape in vivid colours. Slightly left of centre, a small white house with a black roof. To its left, three electricity poles. At the left edge of the painting and also at the right, bluish low mountains. In front, a bright green hill with a greyish path on it. At right, a steep bank and a bit of bright blue sea. In the foreground, reddish-pink plant foam, in which there are four smaller stones or tulips in grey tones. In the background, a cloudy sky in a bright blue-white colour scheme.
6f2c4421897b674dd1f01755a7d4bd73ba286b2e: Five women of easy virtue, wearing combinations, in stockings, sitting-lounging on a striped chaise longue. In the room, a yellowish striped wallpaper, on the back wall four pictures. In front of the window a lace curtain, at left on a chair an old fan. In front in the middle a large old suitcase, on which there is an open box of sweets and an ashtray with cigarette butts. Around the photo a pink mount, at the bottom of which is written calligraphically in gold and white: F.F.F.F. The frame is plastic, white with small gilded ornamentation.
9584bfb65837ed571d77b57e52a34ffb570b4982: Voldemar Vaga has stated in his "Eesti kunst" (1940) that although Jansen is among those artists who "tirelessly work on the comprehensive development of their artistic personality and abilities," and although his "development has continually been on an upward path," he "created his most mature and interesting works" precisely in the second half of the 1930s – Vaga considers especially good, in terms of the density and persuasiveness of artistic form, his fresh and cheerful-looking landscapes.
40baee3aa44eb439ab45ae71148bbd03a76a407d: Knee-length portrait of an elderly bald man with grey moustaches, seated, in three-quarter profile to the left. The left hand rests on the side support of the chair, with the fingers touching the thigh, the right hand holds onto the side support of the chair. Dressed in a dark suit jacket and a shirt with a starched stand-up collar and cuffs. The background is a red tone; at upper left, a depiction of the family coat of arms - a lion on a curved sword - next to it the title "Baron Waldemar Uexkuell Naumhof MDCCCC XII"
23fe36b745cfa8fbce3a96b3a6dd5bf8b2705468: In the middle section, between two barrels on the left and a woodpile on the right, a man in a sailor's cap sits on a crate in a quarter turn to the left, legs apart, hands resting on his knees. Behind him a woman in a red skirt, in full view, bending slightly to the left. Further back at left, the figures of three seated young men. In the foreground on the pier a large fish, an overturned bucket, a floor brush. In the background the sea with a dark strip of shore on the horizon. The painting is in pastel pinkish-blue tones.
fbe336e163b8f86c8ef8eebe646554f4b7bb6f9f: In the middle of the photo, the carcass of a pig hanging head down. At right, a man in national costume stands in profile with a scythe, one foot resting on a wooden block. At left, a nude woman stands in a frontal view, upper body slightly turned to the right, head in profile. In her right hand she holds a scythe. In front of the pig stands a crate, on which stands an alarm clock. On both sides at the top edge of the photo, axes struck into the wall. At the bottom of the photo, two rubber boots facing each other. In the right corner, a small child peeks out. In the background, forest.
8eea59cfcec371668b61a1086fdead69296e4182: View of the Nunna Gate and Toompea. In the foreground an elevation, the tunnel top of the bastion gate, on the stone edge of which a soldier sits, at right a gentleman in a top hat walks. In the middle, the entrance road leads to a gate set in the wall. Along the road, the guardhouse with a facade of five arcaded arches. In the background at left, the towers of the Nunna Gate, two sections of the town wall, which extend to Toompea. In the background at right, the slope of Toompea, on the right side of which is the classicist courthouse.
8439fdb5711fde04b55c455d9c2202a5b71f9bd9: A few years ago, Triin Tamm created waves in both the art world and graphic design world with her author's book Retrospective, the covers of which were ripped off. These ripped-off covers, now vacuum-packed, have not arrived at EKKM as a conceptual donation. Thereby the ripped-off covers, as something very intangible, have been specially objectified for the EKKM collection — a retrospective of the covers of the retrospectives.
e5fa65a18c97fefcfefb6d846dc1cabd59798fb6: In 1942 he began studying at the Higher Courses of Fine Art in Tartu. His teachers were A. Vabbe, A. Vardi, E. Kits, J. Võerahansu. Furthered his studies at the KKKK. In 1949 he worked as an artist at the Pärnu Linakombinaat. From 1974-83 he worked as an artist at the Pärnu EPT. Began exhibiting in 1947. In 1991 received the Pärnu City Government's annual prize for fine art. Cultivated oil painting and watercolour. Late abstract works in the so-called akvamis technique.
56cca8e0d1f4bf39e2df670c6c9c6ba573f99164: Riina Varol (b. 1979) is an Estonian artist and photographer, known in the field of fashion and portrait photography, who does not, however, set herself limits in terms of media in her artistic expression, moving in the fields of photo manipulation, graphic art, painting, sculpture, space- and perception-based installations and performance. In her work Varol focuses on questions of sensory perception, functions of the subconscious, as well as animism and Eastern philosophy.
df0f1f46ca310614acd71d7a7f17f77883669f64: A composition with trees and a house roof. On a brownish-black surface, at front left, a brownish-dull, iris-green tree crown painted with broad brushstrokes, with an orangish-brown top; at front right, a whitish-blue surface. In the background at right, among slightly lighter green trees, an orangish-brown upright building with a rising little tower in the middle. To its left on the horizon, light blue and whitish-blue elongated colour patches, below them a dark reddish-beige surface.
eec5c803bbcf951ce93950f4e78883e4f1fa7fc3: Behind a long yellow table, six men in the foreground and seven men on the other side of the table. In various poses, with hair of all colours, three with beards. On the table nine goblets filled with yellow drink, on the left edge of the table a green wickerwork bottle with a red cork, on the right edge of the table a guitar with a brown cloth thrown over it. On the belt of the third man from the right in the foreground a sheath knife in a brown sheath, beside the man a white flower. Background blue, marking a vaulted structure.
56f0ce71327c674b01fcdba3fc27917c4b96ef9e: A three-part photomontage forms a unified overall image of a reclining man seen from above. The man's arms are raised, bent at the elbows. The head turned towards the left shoulder, eyes closed. Mosaic-like, rectangular motifs are used. A playing-card motif is also used. The image is black-and-white. Parts II and III are lightly coloured in reddish-blue tones. Part III has the same motif as Part I, but considerably denser and larger.
f40bf0416842a395354b5875c1bcb752ebe9559a: Voldemar HAAS (1898, Tori – 1982, Tallinn) was an Estonian theatre artist and pedagogue who enriched Estonian stage design with many technical innovations (cyclorama horizon, projection and cloud apparatuses). He was a prolific landscape painter in the 1920s and a painter of cityscapes in the 1970s. Haas received his art education under Ado Vabbe and Konrad Mägi at the Pallas Art School and studied drawing pedagogy at the University of Tartu. /text by Liisi Aibel, 2013/
94e52e61b9ecbcf4c087c2a25525a5bef8fb98a4: View through doorways into two rooms of an unfinished house, in which men in blue work clothes are standing: the one on the left has reddish-brown hair and beard, a screwdriver head visible from his work clothes pocket; the man on the right has slightly curly hair and a moustache. Both men are working on switches located beside the door. In the back, in the unfinished rooms, a trestle, coils of wire in several colours. Painted in blue tones using the visual vocabulary of painted slide art.
72946136d7e293f821f167bd1e2ca18b35f940f2: The surface of the picture is divided vertically into two black areas, through which a light stripe runs lengthwise. On the left a green quadrangle split by a blue and a red horizontal line; on the upper right a red quadrangle pierced by a dark diagonal line ending in a green circle, below a yellow quadrangle. Across the whole surface of the work, red, black, yellow, blue, green and brown circles in two sizes. Pure local tones; even paint surface. Overall impression decorative.
4d1880acd892273e1b601d251925e9534f5af717: Born in Koeru, Järva County, lived in Narva 1907-1915, in Omsk, Russia 1915-1921. Returned to Estonia in 1921, studied at Pallas in Tartu 1923-1935. Graduated as a graphic artist. 1937-1941 married to Kaarel Liimand. 1937 study trip to Paris. 1940 member of the organisational committee of the artists' union, a "June communist". 1940-1941 lecturer at the Tartu K. Mägi-name Art School. 1941-1944 stayed in the rear of the Soviet Union, in Jaroslavl in 1942. From 1946 freelance artist in Tallinn
3c93ef2ac9a8304461609343a043535facc62e48: Interior view of Pärnu St. Nicholas' Church towards the main nave, facing west. Opens onto the wall with low arcade arches separating the central nave from the southern side nave, with pilasters and windows above. At the end of the main nave the organ gallery with the organ, and the church's western entrance below it. On the right, a pulpit with a canopy. In the church, rows of pews with closed doors. Light falls from the windows of the south nave on the left, the church is generally dim. The sides of the triumphal arch frame the view from both sides.;
2724a4174f964be58ed07a59d44ce036de80a4e3: A narrowing snowy street leading to the central axis of the composition, on the right in the background a two-storey house and in the middle ground a single-storey house. On the left in the foreground a fence, in the middle ground a long single-storey house with a gas lamp on the street façade facing the viewer. In the distance on the central axis the tower of St. Olaf's Church, on the left in the middle ground a roofless defence tower of the town wall shows above the masonry. On the street further back a large sledge, in front a man with a child.
b0b5ed7d6c084c8c6ac3a8f6aaa764c9b12581ac: Bust of a woman with beautiful facial features, a slightly curved nose, a long slender neck and a graceful posture, turned towards the right shoulder. The bust is cut off above the left shoulder. The turned face rests with the chin on the raised right shoulder. The woman's face, neck, shoulder area and upper chest are painted turquoise blue, the lower part of the bust is covered for about 11 cm in width with white paint. The hairless head is covered up to the eyebrows with a greyish-white wrap ending in a protruding knot at the crown.
fd40e87fc1805efc6f2e33210db86a9624eb8489: In the foreground on the left a bay-like inlet of a lake extending to the right, with a castle in medieval architectural style at the tip of a headland intruding from the right. A causeway fortified with a gate leads to the castle from the rising shore on the right. On the right, on a path along the shore, a huntsman with a dog. On the left a mountain with a snowy peak is visible across the lake. A slightly cloudy, sunset-red sky is reflected on the mirror-like surface of the lake, giving the gloomy castle a partly cheerful reddish colouring.
2608a03489d10e3eece3efb0b163a0446543ef43: Worked in Russia from the late 1750s. Was an assistant to the artist and restorer L. C. Pfandzelt, among other things in the execution of decorative paintings at Tsarskoye Selo. Later worked independently as a portraitist and copyist; several of his copies of portraits of Peter III, Catherine II and the heir to the throne Pavel Petrovich (Paul I) have survived. Painted portraits of high state officials and military men, made sketches for M. V. Lomonosov's mosaic workshop.
abf394b8dfef78f0b97a7bdc1110c22c5a0f51fc: From 1934 Herman Talvik began exhibiting at art exhibitions in Finland and Estonia; during World War II he worked as a teacher (mainly at Tallinn Secondary School), in 1944 he fled to Sweden, where he was a freelance artist. Solo exhibitions of this outstanding Estonian émigré artist were held in Estonia in 1971 and 1981 at the Art Museum of Estonia in Kadriorg Palace, in 1991 at the Tartu Art Museum, in 2006-2007 at the Art Museum of Estonia's Adamson-Eric Museum, and in 2016 at the Hiiumaa Museum
d49a437fddc5b55a4272c923dd45579acd9331d6: Below and on the left in the foreground a car with a blue bonnet and windscreen. In front of the glass, "wipers", the surrounding grass reflected from the windscreen. In the background, in greyish-green tones, a lush grassy landscape, bushes on the horizon, above it a cloudy sky. At the intersection of the centre lines, in the upper right quarter, a pasted printed image of a road and a truck. In the upper right corner a bright yellow background with blue and green stripes and a blue triangle.
4edc31d52bff6ecd3592e10c475dceedebfd2d6a: View from an open window across the street to the façade of a house with a Gothic portal. One leaf of the house's door is open, on the right-hand door panel a copper sign fastened at the top. To the left of the door is a large window with many small panes. Below the window, on the right, a yellowish plaque with an inscription (J. Ramsalu?). In the foreground of the painting, enthroned on the windowsill, on the left a fuchsia-like potted plant with red flowers, on the right, in a larger pot, a houseplant with green arrow-shaped leaves.
43b3887c64fbac491da25e665279aa116100828b: Anu Lehis (b. 1993) is an artist who lives and works in Tallinn. She has completed the bachelor's programme in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts (2017) and is currently studying in the master's programme in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts. In addition, she has studied abroad at the Royal Academy of Art in The Hague (Koninklijke Academie van Beeldende Kunsten, Den Haag) in the fine arts speciality (2015-2016). Anu has participated in exhibitions since 2014.
3806af7183b4f122c3d82481c7d33bf782554715: Half-length figure of a seated middle-aged man in three-quarter turn to the right, wearing a black hat and a dark suit. The man's face is clearly modelled in brown-ochre tones. Blue eyes, dark straight eyebrows, straight nose, lips pressed together. Left shoulder slightly raised, hand resting on the knee, right hand bent in the lap. At the neckline a glaringly white shirt collar, a red tie in front, a white handkerchief in the breast pocket. Background beige, in places with a lighter bluish tinge.
1cecd1a2f9a24f53466e90ee1ad88179d6d2c59d: Most of the picture's surface is covered by a white wall, whose plaster has largely flaked off, with black and red lines. On the right a strip running from top to bottom of coloured horizontal stripes and a winding line drawn from top to bottom in pastose paint. In the left edge a fragment of a house, with a shop on the ground floor, and from the upper window bordered with green shutters a figure in a light blue shirt and blue suit is visible, with an orange dot above the head.
a72581aae2a9f2f16af729ae282e1e2e75e1fe80: Triangular decorative composition with four female nudes. In blue, greenish and reddish tones, in an interior of geometric shapes, on the left a kneeling woman in profile, hands raised forward. In the centre a figure leaning on an orange pillow, upper body raised, in the raised right hand a blue bottle. On the right a standing figure in half profile, in the left hand a blue goblet. In the background in the centre, a figure standing in an orange rhombus-shaped opening.
2d0e0ed860b72c8c556a813e4fe5d0b24d661322: Mari Karjus (born 2003) is an artist living in Tallinn. She is studying at the Estonian Academy of Arts and has spent a year of exchange studies at the École Nationale Supérieure des Arts Décoratifs in Paris. Working with photography, video and installation, she explores themes of everyday poetry, friendship, love and the signs and labels found in everyday life. These themes are visualised through repetition, collage and displacement.
6ee07e491aec0ff5c7fee378c494e9c39d840add: Figural composition in greenish-grey tones: in the middle ground a group of men and women with pitchforks and rakes building a large haystack. To the left of them a group consisting of a seated, drinking man and two women, one woman with her hand raised to her forehead. In the foreground at the edge, on the ground, a rake and a pitchfork, a bowl, a basket and a large dark green bottle. Background a landscape of hayfields, trees, animals and farm buildings. Sky yellowish-green, with a few pink clouds.
a6b6e742b510ed5358b564d1a72a6086db694da1: A large symmetrical composition printed from three plates. In the middle section a column-like figure, on its shaft vertically arranged clock mechanisms, on each side symmetrical cuckoos, below gearwheels. On the side sections three rocket-like figures repeat, surrounded by wristwatches and crowned with bunches of leaves. The surface beneath the columns is filled with rows of horizontal Roman and Arabic numerals. The clock faces and mechanisms are in photo-etching
77fb0fdb7f570df45d5ddd2da508812546761a63: Two-part composition placed one above the other, with a wide white frame with black zigzag cuts on the left edge. Three-quarter figure of a nude woman in a quarter-turn to the right. The woman's head is turned back, the upper body leaning slightly backwards, eyes closed. The right hand holds a greenish garment together under the breast, the left hangs at the side. The figure's legs are cut off at the calf. Background pale grey and reddish at the top, greenish at the bottom, marked with broad brushstrokes.
269f627fe620ab6f73723a11ecd5369dbf8f184f: An axe-man is chasing through the apartment, probably his own wife and two children. The woman and children try to hide themselves everywhere - behind the sofa or bed, or behind the cupboard, or under the blanket, but the axe-man always finds them and then something happens. And each time after that something, the axe-man is more and more covered in blood. But the woman and the two children look better and better. And so it goes on endlessly. (Marko Mäetamm)
d7daa3cad5c41b81279352889d5e69fc9826929d: Lilli-Krõõt Repnau (b. 1982) graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, Department of Graphic Art, in 2005, and completed her master's studies in the field of animation in 2015. She has also furthered her studies in Switzerland, at the video department of the Lucerne University of Art and Design. In 2010 Lilli-Krõõt Repnau's graphic art was recognised with the Edmund Valtman Scholarship. She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Association of Printmakers.
67a462e846161f7717e7a84eb2b8a2dba3997bc4: In the centre, a view into nature from a blue space, decorated with two columns on pedestals on either side of a window-like opening, reached by a four-step staircase. The opening reveals a landscape in bluish-green and glowing red tones: a narrow path leads into the depth of the picture, bordered on both sides by a high barbed-wire fence. On both sides of the path is an area of trees and bushes reminiscent of an abandoned natural meadow. Above, a blue sky covered with fibrous clouds.
e0c5be041f0966f412adaedb58696de573f90f2c: View of the so-called Square of Towers in Tallinn. In the foreground, a lawn with playing children. To the right and towards the back runs a roadway and the town wall with five towers. Along the wall there are clustered small annexes, so that only the round towers protrude. In front of them, a low wooden fence. On the upper floor of the right-hand tower, situated in the foreground, there is a wooden parapet, the lower two floors have been converted into residential apartments. In the centre of the picture, the tower of St Olaf's Church.
66a1774bb92da77b475799eb8719bb9638c1be3c: On the left, an Estonian Republic policeman in winter clothing and a winter cap, wearing a double-breasted greatcoat, with a buckled belt bearing a revolver holster. In the centre, a porter in a uniform cap and a large apron. In one hand a round plywood hatbox, in the other a leather suitcase. On the right, a tram conductor: a woman in a uniform beret and coat trimmed with green. Around her neck, a black leather ticket and money bag on a long strap. On her feet, felt boots with grey leather soles.
36e240a3b949285ed87aabb5c1c2d5c8da0e5c50: In 1966 he was entrusted with drawing up the restoration project, together with extensive research, for the main building of the University of Tartu, which had been partly destroyed by fire. In the later period he studied older stone architecture, mainly castles. In the years 1977-93 conservation-restoration projects were completed for the castles of Kuressaare, Haapsalu, Paide, Porkuni and Virtsu. The results are summarised in the extensive book "Eesti keskaegsed linnused" ["Estonian Medieval Castles"], published in 1993.
61830e79faabbb64eda343e1109610a11cb7d68b: Against the background of a large, spreading deciduous tree crown and a clearing opening beyond it with a strip of forest (a single tall deciduous tree in the left background), a young woman in a blue sweater, en face, her head turned slightly to the left, her gaze directed at the viewer. Large light-brown almond-shaped eyes, a fine, delicate, straight nose, small sensitive lips, wavy brown hair falling freely onto the shoulders, and a light-blue headscarf at the back of the neck. The right hand, with a cherry between the fingers, is held above the chest.
e734f06fd1d4999767b8dbc36a77385e62388712: Painter of Baltic German origin (battle painter). Born as the youngest son of August von Kotzebue's 3rd marriage. Served in the Russian army, studied at the St Petersburg Academy of Arts 1837-45 (under A. Sauerweid), stayed in Paris 1847-48 as a pensioner of Nicholas I. From 1850 lived in Munich, 1851-53 travelled in Switzerland, Italy, Belgium. In 1857 became professor at the St Petersburg Academy of Arts, was also imperial court painter, honorary member of the Munich Academy of Arts.
f129546b9f2a999b56e73461559c05a5847ab4d1: White male nude with a narrow face, glass eyes deep in the eye sockets, viewed from the front. The right hand is bent up to the ear (originally the hand held a book-like plate, which has since been lost), the left hand is extended forward. The right foot rests on the base plate, the left foot has sunk into a "rock mass", from which the toes protrude. The athletic man's body is shown frontally, consisting of two parts joined together above the waist, the musculature worked out in detail.
4fe198ec5e8a424ddf4a88b0bd57b49024f774cf: Half-figure of a seated woman slightly to the right of the centre line, viewed frontally, her face turned slightly to the left, her left hand resting with the elbow on the chair's armrest, her right hand resting in her lap. A face with a strong, somewhat fleshy nose, grey hair. Wearing a colourful blouse and a dark blue skirt. In the left edge, above the centre line, a factory interior is faintly suggested. The background and the whole picture are rendered mainly through the juxtaposition and interweaving of patches of blue, red and green colour.
f235bede23a141ffa405167495ce0665353bf21a: In the foreground of the landscape, on a road leading diagonally from the right corner across the river to the mountain on the left, two men in ancient armament are descending the mountain. Towards them moves a group of men with a large log. At the foot of the mountain, on a bridge leading over the river rapids, a cart with a load of logs drawn by oxen. In the centre, on the steep slope of the hill fort, men can be seen rolling logs towards the stronghold. In the foreground on the left, at the foot of the hill fort, an ancient settlement; behind it a bend of the river is visible.
ec536189047d54309d73aad9e8bd7e02c879750b: He settled in Tartu in the 1850s, starting out as a draughtsman for L. Höflinger, opened his own lithography workshop in 1858. From 1859-1861 he also managed a book printing house. After difficulties, he reopened a lithography workshop and photographic studio in Tartu in 1866, at the corner of Rüütli and Küütri Streets in the Schramm building, later moved it to the corner of Vana and Aia Streets, and finally moved to Riga. See Sven Lepa. Esimesed paiksed fotograafid Tartus, Tartu Linnamuuseumi aastaraamat 2015, pp. 108-109.
4b47c9fb6b891ecfb145e9f55d7293a28c077667: On a background covered with advertising prints, orange and pink quadrangles are painted, along with surfaces with stepped, jagged edges covered mainly in reddish-toned brushstrokes. The work, consisting of three panels, diminishes in steps from left to right. On the edge of the left-hand picture panel, two toy planes. On the left-hand panel three, on the middle one two, and on the right-hand one, one grey manlike figure, inside which is a black almond with a yellow edge.
5914ebed770b2b576be845a553bd1e665b574726: the sheet is divided in two: on the right, a young man seen clearly, in front of him three bearded men with a money pouch, a woman and a man with books [reading] ART, SCIENCE. In the left part of the sheet, a male figure upside down on a wall or table, above him a bearded old man, holding a book and pointing to the inscription on the book SCIENCE. On the right, a female figure, holding a book with the inscription ART, above the man in the centre, hands with a money pouch, next to which the text: Man, are you a fool?
b1e089d9a513acd973fcfc41d36a734055199a93: In the lower half of the picture, a river shimmering with colour, a strip of shore and a tree reaching over the water on the right. On the left bank, boats, in some of which people are sitting. Behind the bank, covered with green grass, a small tree and a couple of bushes, a street with walking people and houses painted red, yellow, green and white. Above, a blue sky with white clouds. Bright, joyful colour tones, the boats and water painted in places quite impasto.
6192605c0b468e98aa7d621e8fca8031bc755107: A panoramic South Estonian landscape with hillocks, strips of field and hayfield between them, trees and clumps of forest. In the middle ground, between the trees and hills, low farm buildings, on the horizon on the left a dark blue silhouette of forest. Above, a pink sky covered with a greyish fringe of clouds. Painted in green and pink tones, with the forms of nature lightly geometricised. In places, scratches have been drawn with a sharp object through the paint layer to enliven the surface.
67bb62b5085807be0ea807a1c492c1f1a655764e: A site-specific soundscape installation for Endel Kõks's exhibition attempts to combine the distant reflections, present in the work of this Pallas-trained painter, of an interest in electronics and electronic music and in the Estonian-born émigré composer Udo Kasemets (who was one of the first followers of John Cage's ideas), Cage's post-musical ideas connected with silence, and the fact of Kõks's exhibition taking place, from a conceptually vulgar-materialist perspective.
7897b75c2d557423b1207b94b4ea54fa9a307117: Full figure of a man standing, viewed frontally, painted realistically. His head is turned slightly to the left, his gaze directed downward. The man wears a grey slouch hat, a grey coat, from under the open lapels of which a bright red shirt is visible. His left hand rests on a walking stick, his right hand hangs straight at his side. The man wears grey trousers and shoes in grey tones. On the right stands a larger dog with brownish fur, in a 3/4 turn to the left. The background of the painting is in grey tones.
6f05ed692a4e854e662a68b2ba4029a53fc4ef12: Edgar Tedresaar (b. 1984 in Tartu) graduated from the University of Tartu with a master's degree in painting (2014), and had earlier studied painting at the Tartu Art College. Tedresaar has a particular interest in panel paintings and wall paintings. In his work, the upcycling, i.e. the valorising reuse, of materials plays an important role. His large-format abstract paintings are made from remnants of canvas tinted with natural pigments.
9f64b5e2fde58685f1504466bf42833e2e60521b: A uniform bluish-green background, with pastel-coloured depictions of mourning candles, and a lacy white decoration at the top and bottom edges. Left of centre, on a dark red-black upholstered base, the figure of a bear with a boy's head sits, viewed frontally, depicted in black and white. Near the head, so-called thought bubbles, in which is written: TRY Me! Below, on the right, the text: AND SEE WHAT HAPPENS! A comic-like decorative manner of depicting the finished design. A black contour line surrounds the depicted figure.
9fca53f8552eed15afa8a1995b058b6b1051abb3: On the right edge a man in a long coat with a hat, a long pole on his shoulder, the hat pulled down over his eyes. To the left of the man a reclining woman with rounded forms, bare feet, a large décolleté revealing part of her breast. In the lower left corner the figure of a crawling child sketched with a black contour line. In the upper edge, in the middle, above the man, two small figures with their backs to the viewer. Painted in pink and green tones, sketchily, letting the white ground shine through.
f9e438c7770aedc859a559ee643ea79c348a20a2: A hilly landscape with sharp contours and generalised drawing, mainly in poisonous green tones. A stepped rise beginning at the lower edge of the composition and running to the upper part on the right side, towards a hill; a steeper left edge covered with dense deciduous trees. On the crest of the dome a strip of trees as a dark silhouette. In the middle of the painting a steep triangular hill, in front of it a strip of yellowing field. On the left a valley with a house roof, on the horizon a gently rising terrain with a strip of forest.
c1aaf787a22b4e77c0450e36978cce978f555ebc: In the foreground on the left, in half-profile facing right, a standing man with a protective helmet, in his raised right hand a welding cable which he holds at hip height with his left hand. In the lower left a crouching welder wearing protective goggles. In the lower left corner a small conveyor. In the right golden section a view opens onto the middle plane (sea between quays) and the background (a ship standing in dock with scaffolding around part of the rigging). Blue and greenish-blue overtone dominate.
94f87fd47692f7a634229c66a9587e5d554167c4: A farewell scene against the background of a southern landscape. In the middle a woman in white clothes, barefoot, a brownish shawl on her shoulders. She has stretched out her arms to the right, towards a girl, who is stroking her cheek. Around the girl's waist a young man is holding her, pointing with his other hand to the right, towards a sailboat standing further away. From the left an older man and a woman come running. In the background on the left a house is also visible, on the right a bay with a sailboat and sharp-peaked mountains.
e6ee3ca70f9a427d20ab8b4a51a8d5e4970777dd: A scene in the rectangular inner courtyard of Paide Castle. In the foreground a round arcade. In front, three Estonians defend themselves against the overwhelming force of armoured knights attacking them. One of the Estonians has fallen in the foreground, a spear in his back, a sword in his hand. The Germans have helmets with face guards on their heads. Above the rear roof the great octagonal tower of Paide Castle, with a serrated upper edge, is visible. Heavy cumulus clouds in the sky. The battle takes place in semi-darkness.
4db403ca920e7b4bb41234183d446e7618547774: M. Hakk (b. 1947) is a freelance watercolourist who works in Estonia and France. Graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts (former ERKI) in 1971 in the speciality of interior design. Worked at Eesti Tööstusprojekt, then in Helsinki as an interior architect at the architectural offices of Into Pyykkö and Leena Kolineni. From 2008 a member of the Estonian Watercolour Society (EAÜ). From 2015 a member of the French Watercolour Society (SFA). Regularly participates in exhibitions of the EAÜ and SFA.
2ee16bb8eeb2d1e268b67f419b8b723fbd8ed5b5: In the foreground a brown writing desk covered with green table paper, on which stands a table lamp with a green glass dome, its cord running across the table to a socket; a spilled blue ink pot, a grey notebook, a brown box with a diagonal red stripe, a dark red candle, brushes in a cup widening at the top. On the right of the tabletop a colourful airy heap. Behind the lamp a yellow rectangular surface. Background light blue, with white, green and red rings.
d574df2fc4d3ece006dbbcd5d8c0a491cf47d92a: A figural composition consisting of eight standing and sitting peasants. The peasants wear white shirts, grey jackets and coats, hats or fur caps on their heads. In the tavern room a table, chairs and a cupboard. On the table bottles and glasses. The lively interest of all the characters is concentrated on the left, on the dice game of two peasants. Between the playing peasants a peasant man in an open coat, with his right hand raised. Greyish-brown colour scheme.
50125193c31e9b0caca109839b1ea58b8ce4bf37: painter, theatre artist and graphic artist. From 1919 worked at the Museum of the War of Independence, which was being established, 1920–25 as a teacher at the State School of Arts and Crafts and 1921–26 also at the theatre school of the Drama Studio, and 1926–30 at the Higher Art School "Pallas". In the 1920s made stage designs for the theatre, created the emblem and badge of the Drama Studio Theatre (Drama Theatre); in the 1930s worked mainly as a graphic artist. Fled to Germany in 1944, lived in New York from 1949.
b79d6953f7433ece430ae7a2db77eaefe0854c7b: The artist was born in Tallinn, in 1944 finished Kodasoo primary school and fled to Sweden the same year. In 1947 finished the Norrköping School of Commerce. 1963–67 studied at the graphic arts studio of Kursverksamheten at Stockholm University, and 1964–67 at the evening courses of the Stockholm Higher School of Applied Arts. In 1968 became a member of the Swedish-Estonian Cultural Association. His work is dominated by graphic series, spatial objects, acrylic paintings and collages.
6556879400a85f913154b855f188fdccf47a9c3b: On the left edge of the canvas, on a dark table covered with a poisonous-green cloth, in a reddish-brown flowerpot, a houseplant - horsetail. In front of the pot whitish-green shapes resembling fragile plants. Behind the pot and the table something in Erko-orange. The background of the pot is a fence of beautiful thin black iron bars, behind it a lawn and shrubbery. Above, a yellowish-grey sky. 4/5 of the picture surface consists of intertwining shapes imitating metal and marble.
15df72d1acbf81d20baf8590b976d6d2eb5cd11d: A naked man is tied by a white strip of cloth to a stick standing in the middle of a muddy field. The man wears only old leather footwear. The strip of cloth, tied around the man's genitals, pulls them backward as the man moves, so that they are no longer visible from the front. The man slowly and painfully hobbles round and round, reaching as far as the strip of cloth allows. The sound background is the creaking of a wooden swing or the like. The sky is cloudy and low.
4198848f5f1448feead7d931fdc59bc50d1aa5d2: A woman sitting on a greyish-blue sledge, on her head a white hat with rounded edges, wearing a light jacket with a green collar, a greenish skirt and checked stockings. In the woman's lap a girl in a light dress, a red cap and stockings, and green boots. Both the woman and the girl have straight noses, the woman has brown eyes, the girl green eyes. The background in the middle section is checked, brown, with greyish-green stripes at the edges. In the background, in the left corner, a small light square.
a20aeb68f80afd479d3330b8d94146fe02a2078a: In the middle of the picture, in the lower part, a garden corner between houses with individual trees and bushes. On the right, left and in the middle plane various houses emphasising geometric volume. Behind the houses an open field, above the horizon a grey sky, in places translucent and light. The greenery is painted with thick paint, brushstrokes visible, the sides of some houses modelled with light and shadow. Green, yellow and brown tones dominate.
cef26317dacac42256f7cb7f3ea8ab8b3afc71ac: A landscape painted pastosely, with broad, thick brushstrokes, in bright colour tones, whose rounded forms are delimited by thick contours contrasting in light-dark with the base tone. From a viewpoint higher than eye level, a view over a mustard-yellow meadow, onto which, in the foreground, fall the round, brightly coloured shadows of trees. In the background on the left, against the background of deciduous trees with large crowns, a reddish-brown barn with its corner facing the viewer.
c69c33197fb6f1a159fe52dd5f64b868b48af428: On the beach, by the corner of a net shed, a group of five people: on the right a briskly walking woman seen frontally, a food basket in her left hand, a kerchief raised in her right hand for waving; next to her a man seen frontally and a small girl, further along the shoreline, watching a sailboat that is visible. In the foreground on the left a kneeling boy and girl seen in profile, mending nets. Mature beige, brown, blue tones, a style painting forms out with rounded clarity.
cdceb842b5b3a4171be64315a2416dc2b006462a: On a red background lies a female nude with slightly bent knees, her head resting on an arm bent at the elbow, strong shadows in red and green colour falling on the body. The woman's fluffy hair is poisonous green. In the background, in the upper right corner, abstract surfaces in several green tones, on a light green patch a large yellow shape and small colourful geometric figures. The woman's elbow rests on a blue-green-patterned rug.
2068e56023322637703e0cb2733ab55f7c562f38: Against the background of a grey, hazy, spacious seaside landscape, a group of four figures: on the left in the middle, seen frontally, a man standing ramrod straight, his gaze directed upward. Past him, to the left, the figure of a young woman passing by. The woman has long dark hair, a startled look, her mouth slightly open. On the right a young woman standing, seen frontally, in a blue dress with shoulder straps, long brown hair falling down her back. Past her, to the right, a shadow-like male figure flitting by.
3dcd8119b8245aa61b478a33e10bec713f165142: A female nude bent forward, surrounded by an abstract substance of red-blue-green colour, her face, framed by light hair with a cherry-red mouth, turned towards the viewer. Her left hand strokes a light beige Siamese cat with black ears lying in the lower edge. Onto her right hand, stretched out backward, descends a bird with black wings and a blue underside. The background is sea-green in the lower part, lilac-grey above. In places very pastose, painted with a palette knife.
bd3e7c0702cc46a8739751f999dbab3ad9083348: On a fresco bordered above and below by architectural ornamentation, a building in the Renaissance style, built in a mountainous area, is depicted. A high, upward-narrowing staircase leads to the main portal of the building, flanked by columns. On the right side of the foreground of the picture two young men can be seen heading towards the building. In the background on the left a man is also hurrying towards the house, a boy at his hand. Two men are stepping onto the staircase, and two men are also at the doorway.
1179f2155226355721613dad6bf618ce7401f226: Against the background of a spacious landscape with yellowish-green field strips, a group of dreamy-serious people. In the foreground the corner of a table with gravel, a bowl, around which young people are dining: on the left the half-figures of a young man in a white shirt, a dark-haired woman seen frontally, a man in a peaked cap seen frontally, on the right a woman and a man with raised hands. Further back on the left a reclining woman and a sitting man. Bright tones, a painting style generalising dense forms, softly modelling.
b66e14c6e6887d7af8c08c269430f3db93f2b764: Marina Aleksejeva (born 18 May 1971) is an Estonian artist known for her drawings and collages. She graduated from the painting department of the University of Tartu in 1995 and defended her master's thesis at the same university in 2016. Since 1992 she has participated in numerous exhibitions both in Estonia and internationally. In addition to her artistic work, Aleksejeva works as a teacher at the Tartu Art School and the Tartu Art School for Children.
925cfb47bbf886876293008ec587b2d08709fa06: In the foreground a man in front view, right hand raised, left arm bent forward. Wearing soldier's clothes. On the left a soldier in front view, arms at his sides, a rifle in his right hand. Behind on the right a column of human figures and a horse. On the left edge a solitary figure walking in front view, a bag on his back. In the distance houses, human figures, on the right a galloping horse-drawn carriage with people, at the top centre, in front of a large dark house, ground being thrown into the air, on the left edge a burning house.
e314c141c798074d90df44bb301f9cd37789480b: In the foreground centre a yard in which a man with a horse stands by two carts, on the right by a plank fence solitary trees. In the centre left a stone house with a red tiled roof, behind and beside it towers of the town wall. To the right of the towers the town wall rising up the slope of Toompea, at the foot of the slope a gate opening. In front of it a half-ruined outer gate structure, through the gate opening leading towards the town a peasant woman passes in a cart. Above on the right, on the slope of Toompea, more houses.
d0cb863c78ec3260ce205f08c2af996eec0b7651: A conceptualist painting in which grey geometric surfaces have been painted over a monochrome reproduction. Upper left and right a lighter grey, below a brownish tone. In the centre a vertical darker rectangle, on which a black and white U-shaped form once more forms a rectangular element. At the bottom printed text: Rembrandt Harmensz van Rijn. 1606-1669. Young woman with earrings 1657. In the right corner: THE HERMITAGE. LENINGRAD
061801cecdb1661308fbb74ef3fb9ab070b097f4: The sheet depicts a section of a baroque palace wall surface with abundant architectural details. Above, under the cornice of the consoles, a row of masks. On the left two putti placed one above the other. On the right a rectangular window with small panes. Between the group of sculptures and the window a fresco depicting a hero in armour hovering in the air, pointing upward with his finger. Before him an old man kneels, arms spread wide. To the right of the old man's figure the base of a column.
51bec966e68f5aa4c4e2873b6e368de13c9ce6a7: The sheet depicts a section of a monster's belly with triple layers, a crest on its head and back, in a beak-like mouth with gigantic teeth. The creature points with one hand's index finger at a clown standing before it. Between the jaws comes the text: Naera pajats! [Laugh, clown!] The clown is in a white costume with a high ruffled collar, red hearts as appliqués on his clothes, his face snow-white - he stretches his mouth wide in laughter.
184e0f27885206ecdf2f8d3300235055074ec9e7: Applied art. Created large-scale bindings and objects with a forceful composition and colour treatment, in her own invented hand-sewing and paper-relief technique, used papier-mâché (bindings "Armunud naise päevik" 1987, "Kaotatud paradiis" 1991, "Kurb kirjutaja" 1999, object "Neeger" 1995). Illustrated books (E. Niit's "Onu ööbiku ööpäev" 1998). Published the poetry collection "Tõsimäng" and articles on applied art
7e63c6583c795229a8ecd70feac7c2bc780262c4: Kaidi Kaasik is a graphic designer who works with abstract painting. She has studied performance art at Non Grata, graphic art at EKA and documentary film at BFM. Her calligraphic abstract mixed-media paintings are colourful and contrasting, bringing organised chaos into the world. Her painting series NO MIND denotes the state of mind in which she creates. It is a creative flow free of ego and everyday life.
57afbb1434c37324bcdc412388f9f8c17b6eb477: Under a uniformly light blue sky a colourful group of figures consisting of nine young, scantily dressed women. In front, next to a suggested sports track, three cheering, exclaiming young women lean forward towards the viewer. Behind them, amid patches of colour, figures wave and rejoice. In the background centre, against the sky, a woman with raised arms. Between the figures modelled in greyish beige, bright, vivid tones shine. A vigorous, lush painting style.
b880507223832d94aab2bfaaee949917990674c8: In the foreground centre two female figures on the beach sand sorting fish. Behind them four standing men: one young man with a bared upper body holds a knife upright, beside him a bearded old man with a net cloth, while the one on the right shows a larger fish to two girls sitting on the beach sand at the right edge. Further back on the left, by a sailboat run up on the beach sand, two young men busy themselves, further out at sea a second sailboat, on which three figures can be seen.
a9f708290f05b1bd349355eed012544cbff35588: A female nude sitting in side view facing right on a white drapery with greenish folds. Right leg bent, on it a rolled-down stocking (cut off at the foot, above the left calf). Bent, intertwined arms in front, the left resting on the back of a chair, on which the lowered head, turned away from the viewer, rests. Background on the left greyish brown, on the right bluish. The nude is painted in whitish grey, beige tones, with shadows and forms at times accentuated with a broader contour line.
19bfcf4dab3847114c25fcf5e135100871d2130d: In the foreground, at the foot of a slope descending from right to left, a crowd of people sitting closely together; on the left in front people sitting on the grass, behind them, on the road, a peasant man with a horse and cart. Behind the cart two men carrying a lame woman. On the slope, among trees and bushes, people sitting together in smaller groups. At the right edge a bearded old man and a boy who has climbed a tree. In the background on the left the reflecting surface of a lake can be seen in the distance.
f88be903afbd2c8481991936fa7bff3211694a7d: A late-autumn landscape in gloomy weather. In the foreground an ox cart moving to the left with an old woman on the cart. In front of the ox an old woman walks with a stick. In the middle ground a pole fence spanning almost the whole width of the composition to near the right edge, at its end on the right a single-storey grey house; in front of the fence two bare birches. Behind the fence, in front of an open clearing, patches of snow, on the horizon left and right a strip of forest. The sky in grey clouds, here and there tinged blue.
95f8de63750c07eeeca596db011c33a6c6482b70: In an interior a 4/5 figure of a middle-aged man seated, turned three-quarters to the left, head turned to the right. The man has a high forehead, a straight nose, a deep furrow between slightly raised eyebrows. His left hand rests on the back of a chair, the right on the corner of a table on which there are vases, a book, linocut-cutting knives. On a lower table a number of books with colourful covers. The man wears a greenish-grey coat with wide lapels, brownish trousers. Left leg crossed over the other.
5b3138d385a02c328b128c3bdbc68cf02f7d5dc4: A summer view of the Sauga River from the right bank towards Siimu Bridge. On the left in front, in shallow shore water, a pole reflected in the water. By the shore fishermen's motorboats. Fishing nets drying on poles set up on the shore. Long fyke-net stakes are stacked upright in a cone shape. On the left behind, the arch of Siimu Bridge. Vehicles and pedestrians moving across the bridge. On the right bank, near the end of the bridge, wooden houses and the crowns of deciduous trees.
81f14284b6061df974395341c7f96a81e9d23f41: Irma Holm works in the fields of photography, installation and graphic art. In creating her works she draws on personal experiences and deals with themes of mental health, femininity and everyday poetry. Holm combines humour and sensitivity to reveal the tensions arising at the border of public and private space. She has participated in group exhibitions in various places in Estonia, and her work "Moenukk Irma" has been exhibited at the Poznań Print Biennale.
71f5d0cfdcbfa94e502926c13873fc71bc5cb90a: A coastal landscape with a small bay and a headland. On the central axis of the painting, on the right, clusters of wooden buildings. On the left and behind, on the horizon, the sea, in front some larger rocks. On the right, gardens surrounding the houses and a couple of solitary trees can also be seen. On the right there is also an upturned boat. The upper part of the painting is formed by a sky with tufts of cloud. The colouring is in grey tones. In the foreground slightly more vividness of colour. A marking, somewhat impressionistic brushstroke.
f7c2d8b836693bd13e77d0625a272e1bec6e8bd2: A panoramic winter landscape. In the foreground on the lower left, among trees, a farmstead consisting of three buildings; behind a low fence one woman drawing water from a pump-well, another heading to the barn with two buckets in hand, at the bottom right a small sauna. Higher up, among the hills, low patches of forest and scrub, and farmhouses buried in snow surrounded by solitary trees. Above, a grey, hazy winter sky. Grey and brown tones dominate.
bdcd7d2cefe3dcae49bd94ec225dfbfcc1ebfc3d: A view from Vaksali Avenue towards Falgi Road. In the foreground a gentleman in a top hat with a dog, two boys in folk costume, a woman with two children, a man with a scythe and a peasant man with a load of hay. In the centre an empty plot bounded by a low wall. On the left behind a lawn and the slope of Toompea, on which buildings and Pikk Hermann stand. The trees of Falgi Road are young and enclosed by a wooden fence. Kiek in de Kök is visible in the centre. On the right an open Rootsi kants (Swedish Bastion) with trees.
f52c9b26f0621e8338e8de88c896e5c34055fa65: Born in Tallinn in 1945. He received his art education at the Estonian State Art Institute, graduating in painting in 1969. Member of the Estonian Artists' Union since 1979. Has taken part in exhibitions since 1970. Since 1992 a lecturer at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Member of the Board of the Estonian Painters' Association since 1997. Member of the Estonian Watercolourists' Association 2002. In 2006 chairman of the Estonian Painters' Association.
4b43e79b94fc7361ea83a8058fe3b3662f464dd1: On the front cover of the folder Kristjan Raud's autograph and a reproduction "Magav Kalevipoeg" [Sleeping Kalevipoeg]. In the folder, together with the reproductions, a grey cardboard sheet with English text Kristjan Raud (21 X 1865 - 19 V 1943) and an overview of the life and work of the artist K. Raud, author Juta Kivimäe, photo: Kristjan Raud in his garden in Nõmme. On the verso of the sheet an English-language list of 12 reproductions. Reproductions on 12 sheets of chalk paper.
42ee2f4aba2db1c7ec81689b606f1627ef364bb4: A figurative composition in which two blood-covered bodies wrapped in white linen lie in a coffin on the left. In the foreground on the right a body wrapped in white, with a mourning woman dressed in white on the left and an old man with a white turban and beard on the right. On the right edge two standing figures seemingly cut through by the frame line. In the background at the centre a white building with arches. Upper right coloured abstract patches, upper left blue sky.
b384d860ecfa45b1735ad1aaa5e03f30b8e92589: In the foreground at sea a fishing boat with lowered sails, in the boat a seated female figure with a red kerchief on her head, and a standing bearded man in a wide-brimmed hat and long fisherman's boots pulling a net out of the water. On the bow of the boat a mark: DL. 23. In the distance sailing boats at various distances are visible, and from left and right toward the centre of the picture a mountainous coastline vanishing on the horizon, above which on the left the disc of the rising sun is visible.
3cfd6a7a7386adea1a27765344619c8bbcdd6396: On the left, in a greyish-pink colour scheme, a cattle shed, against whose end wall loose boards lean. In the centre and on the right a cattle gate, wattle-fenced, a stocky man in a brown hat with his back to the viewer opening or closing the cattle gate. Beyond the gate two cows, further back green fields and on the right edge a strip of forest. Above a grey cloudy sky. Generalised form, muted colour scheme in grey, brown, green and pink tones.
a91d619fbe651993a49c9867cf1b7bc7d8584add: In the foreground on the left a shepherd boy with sheep and a dog, in the centre on a winding road leading into the depth a woman in folk costume seen in profile, on the right a heath landscape with solitary bushes. Behind them a body of water (a bay of a lake), on whose opposite shore groups of deciduous trees and a solitary farm building. In the centre left, behind solitary oaks, farm buildings, above them on the road two men. The forest in the distance merges with the groups of trees on the far shore of the lake. The sky is cloudy.
b36841dab6d7410414880cf8e0891bdf9199ce14: Silver Vahtre (b. 1953 in Tartu) is a graphic artist, designer and theatre artist. Vahtre has taken part in ca 30 solo and joint exhibitions in Estonia and Finland. Silver Vahtre is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association, the Union of Stage Designers, the Union of Design Graphic Artists and the Tartu Artists' Union.
20fbbe27d98d97142c0b55e72da91a484f5f2c6f: The fresco depicted on the sheet is bordered by architectural decorations and sculptures. In the background a building, in whose round-arched niches sculptures are placed.
64ebf77d418b97bd5a849009a4d99ab55986bf6e: Anna Lihodedova (b. 1989) graduated in 2016 from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a master's degree in graphic art, having previously earned her bachelor's degree there as well (2012). In 2013-2015 she took part in Tallinn University's Noored Kooli (Teach for Estonia) programme. Since 2009 Anna has taken part in numerous group exhibitions in Estonia as well as in Latvia, Finland and Russia, and in 2011 her works were on view at the solo exhibition "10:10" at the Patarei Sea Fortress.
32442cdaa9f1ab89ade5e71dd6bb43ac3123265d: View of the Kadriorg bathing establishment. In the foreground a lawn with winding footpaths, bushes and young trees. Ladies and gentlemen with children walk along the paths, two dogs are also visible. In the background a road, along which a man with a handcart, a horseman and a two-horse carriage are moving. On the left the bathing salon - a long wooden building with a colonnaded façade and roof windows. In the distance the Bay of Tallinn is visible. On the right a low, long wooden building for baths.
6927298507488041b6c021279af872df854bbb7d: A low-horizon coastal view: in the foreground a sandy beach, on the left a few brown boats, at the bottom right a boat washed ashore. In the middle of the sand stands a woman with an oar in her hand, wearing an orange headscarf, a greenish blouse and a dark brown skirt, with her back to the viewer. In the background on the right a solitary boat pushed into the foaming water at the shore. On the horizon a dark blue strip of sea, above a bright, high sky, in places covered with greyish and pink clouds.
b9fec43f4b005ad1ed1abe50fea512d78637b995: In the foreground under the threshing barn's shelter two women are shearing sheep. To their right a small boy by a wool basket. In the distance on the left a small wooden house, forest on the horizon. On the pasture between the houses, by the threshold of the shelter, a flock of sheep is grazing, a red cow and a calf, a little further away a black cow. General colour scheme in various shades of green.
cb9614a34963c7611a9390525fd82785748935cb: sculptor. He has created monumental works, portraits and figural compositions on mythological subjects. Characteristic of him is the interweaving of the ironic and the grotesque with the serious. Since the 1990s he has created installations and conceptual projects.
45e960f7790191e78510c1f9f89745828b16aaf7: In the foreground on the right, on both banks of a stream (or main drainage ditch) being deepened and curving backward, an excavator is at work, on the right one with its bucket lowered, on the left one raised. One workman with a shovel, another with a pole and an axe. Further back a watery lowland with sparse trees.
ed5110863d47ccfed0ccbad70aef57694c7b6264: On a seat made shapeless by a white cushion sits a girl with short, parted-combed hair, her head tilted slightly to the right, her gaze directed at the viewer. The girl wears a dress of small-patterned fabric with a dark blue ground and a white collar, and a white apron in front. In the girl's lap sleeps a small yellowish-grey, striped cat with a white underbelly, asleep. The girl's left hand rests on the cat's back. The background is in blending wine-red and green tones.
916c6f3f824c724b30a0c7591f56558d298218b2: In the foreground: on a high hill a fortress wall of long upright logs is being erected. Above, on the fortress wall, men are working with axes.
94152562afd125d20556bbe8d5476f1a00e8d089: Ann Mirjam Vaikla (1990) is an Estonian artist, scenographer and curator. Her works were exhibited in 2020 at the VII Artishok Biennial at the Kai Art Centre and at the Black Box theatre in Oslo.
c5115aec4d38bace0fa74f2555125ce5d0fdc65b: The picture is divided into two parts. Blue tone dominates, in painting individual details red, yellow, green and dark purple have been used in the manner of spectral stripes. Mainly painted with a spray gun.
2a26ddbb4c10ee51dc294d576462fd2fee8ebe55: The sculpture depicts Fr. R. Kreutzwald standing, a book in his right hand, his left hand raised to his chin. On the base, behind the left foot, the author's initials JR and the year 1958-59. The white plaster figure is assembled from 2 parts: the lower part forms the base and the lower half of the body up to the middle, and the upper part forms the upper half of the body from the middle up.
7b361e6a86ab19a2ba282e35c9377830a387f0cb: On the horizontal centre line a wire-mesh fence, behind which trees in blending green tones and a strip of flaming red plants. In the foreground a white step with tufts of red feather-like plants on both sides. From the step, along the vertical centre line, a garden path with car-wheel tracks leads toward an arched gate. On both sides of the garden path green lawns. In the upper part of the picture a light green, watercolour-like sky.
14d3d63dcc01058df0fda854a7f9c81e6cca443b: He received his initial art education under his brother, the porcelain painter Anton Oechs, in Regensburg. From 1795 he studied in Nuremberg under the porcelain painter K. Trost, and then in Erfurt under the porcelain painter Bollermann, and in Dresden under professor Klengel. In 1804 he moved to Jelgava. He studied at the drawing school of Tartu University under Karl August Senff. From 1824 he worked as a drawing teacher at the Jelgava gymnasium.
71f81b6c6733f30a2d5ac32441dd3fec4ef6630e: In 1934, at his parents' wish, he entered Tartu University to study mathematics. In 1935 he began painting studies at the Pallas Higher Art School under Nikolai Triik. He fled to Germany in 1944. There he entered the Technical University of Munich, which he graduated from as an architect. He then worked at the same institution as an assistant to the professor of architecture Döllgast. He later moved to Sweden, where he worked at an architecture bureau.
026484b06e363a54f469e8906b5e087c00cacffb: Kaia Hommik (b. 1969, Pärnu) has graduated from the Faculty of Medicine of Tartu University. In addition she has for years taken part in the drawing and painting course of the KULLO Hobby Centre. The artist has acquired the speciality of textile and silk painting. Solo exhibitions since 2014.
1ad8bbee0b4d3212098dbd199a755f16e0b90b5d: Liis Koger is a painter and poet born in Estonia, whose work explores consciousness, emotions and invisible connections between all living things. More than fifteen years of a professional artistic career following her graduation from the painting department of Tartu University have shaped her abstract painterly hand into something deep and sensitive. In her work delicate pastel tones meet intense, contrasting brushstrokes.
3d298f885bcb36d26cbff92cb0783187963e2c57: An arrangement painted in a constructive manner: in the foreground centre a white, bulbous jug with blue cobalt design, to the right of which two slender bottles with upward-striving forms, above the jug a blue ceramic plate or platter with a lilac edge. In the foreground on the left two dull mustard-yellow toned lemons. Painted in muted blue, yellowish, green tones, strongly emphasising the contours of the surfaces.
3fffbc2665f8a7c88bfa1341a37ea7779f2b64ac: In the upper centre a paper target is glued to the canvas, against the background of a dark round shape. From under the target flows a pink, drop-like shape. In the centre, above the horizontal midline, on each side two lens motifs turned towards each other, connected by a fine white horizontal line. In the lower centre, a piece of sheepskin is glued to a black, lens-like surface. In cold blue tones. Black mount.
2f2e0022e01342674c27b20a303a2b2f754503e3: The picture shows a room, at the bottom in the foreground a table covered with a white, torn cloth. On the table a seal's skull, a cord, a tube of paint. In the lower left corner from the table part of a brown electric radiator, onto which blue paint has dripped. Most of the picture is occupied by a landscape painting on the brown wall of the room. It depicts the sea, a sandy beach, stones and grass tufts bent by the wind. In the area of the grass tufts there are stains of brown paint running down.
37d51dc81cc312e74e0e4274ee30a2612225e1c4: A summer suburban view in greyish-brown and green tones with an unpaved street in the foreground. To its left grey suburban houses built against one another with bushes along the wall and a fence of blue slats separating a small garden. To the right of the road bushes, directly behind them a couple of larger brown houses. Above, a yellowish-grey sky showing through sparse greenery. Painted pastosely, in places using the butt end of a brush or a wooden stick.
036ae3bc51d0f0b4f121305472a6b65f26343cc2: On a horse with a graceful neck and thick legs sits a female figure on a saddle consisting of four horizontal parts. Both the rider and the horse are strongly stylised, with a vigorous overall impression. The rider's longer hair covers the ears and falls back in the wind of riding, her hands hold the horse's mane near the ears; the horse's massive tail is stretched out at an angle behind, the hind legs are spread apart, the front legs rest straight on the base.
c811973c7248d3b30d99e0df33a92ff7e7c58d2e: A view of farm buildings under large trees. In the foreground grass with a few large stones on the right.
