Above, on both sides of the path, dull yellow grain fields, on the horizon a farmhouse with a couple of trees on the left, on the right two small grey houses and a windmill.
3ca02cca0862764f1cea697744d4ab572889a290: In a room with a brown floor and walls and ceiling in various shades of red, in purplish hues, the torso of a woman in a striding pose, filling the entire height of the room, in a slight turn to the left. In the left wall an arch with pink walls, opening onto a view over deciduous trees to a sky with scattered clouds, turning yellowish as it approaches the horizon.
024d262c7448c5382750e4d5ab3e1fda46e7271a: A biblical scene of the sacrifice of Isaac. In the foreground Jacob - a bearded man in a long robe, holding a knife in his right hand, pressing down with his left the head of Isaac, who lies face down on a stone altar. Rushing in from the left, a curly-haired young man - an angel - has grasped Jacob's hand holding the knife and points with his other hand to the ram on the right. Large trees in the background.
1816e5de8d9702c177d88f11736d5620013c0477: He received an art education in 1903-1908 in St. Petersburg at the Stieglitz School of Technical Drawing, in the field of etching. He worked as a teacher in Piiral, Rakvere and Tallinn. In 1909 he was elected to the board of the Estonian Art Society. From 1914 to 1918 he was a teacher of drawing, graphic art and style at the Tallinn School of Applied Arts, founded by the society. From 1921 to 1932 he was a lecturer at the Läänemaa Teachers' Seminary in Haapsalu.
23769dd2c4301181140c04d9bbf510064de6b220: In the foreground of the picture a lake, with houses on its shore further back. On the horizon a high mountain massif and a yellowish-grey sky. In the left corner a stony arched embankment wall with green trees and bushes, and between them a castle with a white tower. In overall bluish-grey tones, the picture is painted, at places especially in the trees, with clearly separated brush strokes.
0375882cdd67b8650ca4f9a1278a942e6af89954: An evening view of the new yacht club building at Pirita, seen from the sea. Directly across the water, stands line the quay with flagpoles and a fire place. Behind them a pyramid-like building, on the right yachts moored by the quay, reflected in the water. On the horizon, the silhouette of Tallinn's Old Town against a sky glowing red with sunset. In the foreground on the left, part of a yacht's striped spinnaker with the number SR-37.
8a30e570e624dae8530d8bc46012a7e6fecac1f6: A photo installation on a light-coloured wooden polyhedron-shaped construction attached to the wall. The photo shows a living room with laminate parquet wallpaper, in which a half-upright clothes drying rack stands with two blue inflated plastic bags attached to its sides and a green washbasin placed on its end panel, with a yellow sponge attached to its bottom.
d218f23093e8d8f2259d450c8b77e0497b9782cd: A trailer for Aljona Surzhikova's documentary film "Not My Land" (2013), which introduces the "residents" of the Soodevahe garden town - among them the artist Timo Toots - and shows their reaction to the demolition notices of Tallinn Airport attached to the garden town's buildings and gardens, and to the corresponding news in the media. Camera by Sergei Trofimov.
c8879c91e22659ef9026d6826967af41c4eda0e6: On a brownish-grey field, three blackening potato furrows on the right. Two women on the leftmost furrow, the one in front bent over, resting with her right hand on a basket, seen in profile, the one behind in a frontal view. Further back, on the right, a man with a horse. On the horizon, on the left an open landscape, on the right a group of trees and a farm. The painting is in a greyish-brown, moss-green colour scheme.
ef5146aa8097957fb8f2ca4cec922b8225758a16: Groups among theatre masks and stage props. On the left of the composition a yellowish-white surface with a narrow black vertical batten on its left edge, at the bottom edge a mass of people. Against a black and brownish background, in the foreground on the right two ballerinas in front of a large prop structure, on top of which sit two masks, and on which, in golden-section position, a man in puffed breeches climbs a ladder.
c54e310e7f34c932b40664dbf917f42343d97bb1: A bust portrait (to the waist) of a man in a dark blue hat. The face is largely in the shadow of the hat, in green and yellow tones. He wears a brown coat, a dark shirt and a light waistcoat. The figure and clothing items are surrounded by a dark blue contour, the forms slightly geometricized. Background greenish-blue, worked through with visible, at places pinkish, brush strokes.
207b04c26cadca0fe6737d00b36ea610332e5e80: A composition of buildings with long, intersecting rows of windows, above the glass door on the right a half-visible inscription: APK M... At the bottom centre a fountain, above it hanging strips of glowing orange and yellow colour masses. On both edges, three-quarter figures of men in blue suits with diplomat briefcases step out of the picture plane.
9d87ed7b2f6f814edf2686e03e407d6e74c648d6: Across the entire painting, composed in an oval, two women's faces merging into one another, turned to the left: the one behind has a slightly open mouth, bulging eyes, a strong nose, wrinkles at the bridge of the nose. In front, a dark shadow-like profile, a glowing cheekbone, an earring in the ear. On the right, at the back of the woman's head, a vertical lighter line. A powerful, expressive painting style.
dba535ffc125268b49d2e6c8989c720c4b0eb283: In the foreground a cove with a single rock and a large dark barge in the foreground. Further back on the right two log houses and a garden, behind them a dark green patch of forest. To the left of the forest a golden-yellow sandy bank slope, and beside it forest again. Above, a grey sky. Painted sparsely in dots, letting the underlying cardboard show through. The forest is given with a strongly emphasized silhouette.
7a544e60da517668f6066ee2604b641b7e6c5479: In the midst of fragments of a summer landscape and abstract colour surfaces stands a thick pine trunk, to the right of which a female nude in a quarter-turn to the left, arms raised. Behind and in front of the figure below, a billowing grey drapery. Upper left, a straight water canal narrowing towards the horizon, evening light reflecting in the water. Upper right, a row of white houses, a telephone pole.
82b97fcf79d7d3a5a4f6361260df3427273be859: In the foreground on the water's surface by the boat pier on the right a bluish-grey motorboat, behind it two conversing men can be seen. On the pier in the middle of the painting a group of three men, behind them on the right a lone man in a boat. On the left bank the gable end of a house with light-coloured cladding and tall deciduous trees. In the distance a bridge and to the right of it a three-masted sailboat.
8470c63faac4ef66e9c202f2252e141ecc3a3984: Within a frame of strong black contours on a purple background an oval stylised wreath of oak leaves. In the centre of the wreath a bird with a long beak rising in flight against a white (paper-coloured) sun. Both the purple bird and the sun are stylised. Below, in a black frame, the text SIURU III. At the lower right edge of the sheet, red, black, brown chalk trials.
deadd6ab612dcbcc38ee905ec26075843b9ac902: In the foreground a model airplane and six young engineers absorbed in discussion, gathered around a table. In the right corner a chair back can be seen. A small boy in full view with a pioneer scarf around his neck, leaning with his body against the table. Above in the centre a model airplane hanging. On the wall between two framed pictures a poster depicting a pilot among young model-aircraft builders.
bc49cb6cdf27883659c2d6502cf80df4b929eee1: A crowd scene painted in a Korovin-like impressionistic manner: in the foreground on the left and right people, horses, all rendered through the juxtaposition of flickering patches of colour. Upper left two large houses (one of them with a white chimney). Beside the rear house some trees and bushes. Upper part beige sky. Painted in yellowish-brown tones.
49e1fe0524af6bc34f0fad81feb800a94eb79932: On a red background, a bust portrait of a middle-aged man with strong facial features. Thick, dark hair combed back from the forehead. From beneath dense eyebrows covering the upper eyelid, an inquiring gaze directed at the viewer; lips slightly parted. Hands crossed on the chest. Wearing a dark brown paletot and a white smock. A broad reddish-brown horizontal surface at the lower edge.
7796f070df25c18f058d8bbe743e3b04b03899cb: A panoramic sea view with a low-painted horizon. In the foreground in the centre, stones visible through the water and a side section broken off from a ship's hull in a storm. Further back on the left another section of the ship, on the horizon on the right a small steamer. The sea steel-grey, with low foamy waves. Above the horizon a clearing sky, whitish, grey in the foreground with clouds.
7aa898f71ebad0a45716f3e5548be43cb2d485ce: An ancient Estonian elder is depicted in a seated position, fallen, leaning on his left hand holding a shield, his right hand holding a sword raised upward. Left leg stretched forward, right leg bent backward to the side, face turned upward, an axe and a short sword at the belt. Engraved on the edge of the sculpture's base Prof. A. Adamson, 1925, Pistoia.
5ad717194167c8132e49d8e4c29cdf2595f0f6c4: V. Ormisson mainly created landscapes and still lifes. In his early works the influence of impressionism and the work of Konrad Mägi can be noticed. After a visit to Germany, expressionistic traits appeared in his paintings, the colouring darkened and greenish-blue tones became predominant. In the second half of the 1920s, his treatment of landscape became more filled with air and light.
add49b759f07c8191cfba9714cd7ee130428f36c: Kaisa Puustak (born 1945 in Tallinn) is a recognised Estonian artist whose work focuses on free graphic art. She graduated in 1969 from the Estonian State Art Institute in the field of graphic art (MA). Since 1973, Puustak has actively participated in exhibitions, she is an honorary member of both the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Print Society.
8fa9cdcd4533a803f703601cb2626420f5625e93: In front, on a small clearing, two gate-post-like towers, decoratively painted blue-red-white. Between them a thin post striped red-yellow, on both sides curly bushes. In the background slender, pyramid-shaped trees rising to the sky, a pale sky visible between the treetops. A finely detailed painting, predominantly in deep bluish-green tones.
c59f4c2d1a33421e322d6a1214c4e3fc3c9b5012: In an interior, a girl kneeling on a rug in three-quarter profile to the left, supporting her chin with her left hand, her head turned to the right in three-quarter profile, her gaze directed downward. To her right sits a man in three-quarter profile to the left, his right leg bent under him on the rug, his left leg resting on the floor, the man's gaze turned to the left, his left hand on the woman's left shin.
031fe41b3073a37ed6c62b0c699a7e4bb471add7: A quarter-turned bust portrait of a woman with her head slightly lowered, eyes looking down. On her head a small black hat with a reddish-brown ribbon, wearing a beige jacket and a patterned blouse with a brooch with a stone at the neckline. The hat casts a shadow on the forehead, and part of the left cheek is also in shadow. A green little flower at the corner of the jacket collar. Predominantly in greenish-brown tones.
993b532b08c36307710091e39c8bef53221e0e43: In the foreground in the centre a brown horse, behind it a man in a light-coloured hat, dark coat and a red neckerchief. On the right sits a man in a blue coat and a hat, a greenish-coloured cloth bag between his legs. Further back a threshing barn, through whose open gates a piece of the farmyard can be seen. Painted with broad, sweeping brushstrokes, the paint layer thin.
3410524f3259ccdfa8cd6b475fd1b7e888aac886: An orange jagged-crowned, elongated-face figure on stilt-like legs in a blackish-blue setting. One hand bent near the head, the other holding a long knobbed staff pointed forward to the right, into a suggested blue puddle. Various shapes intertwined with the figure, on the left a head and a hand with a bone-like formation. Expressive painting style.
bb74e7c8398371c3169a4ab70d612a23b7c9b11f: In the centre of the painting two people in white coats and caps performing an operation. In front of them, in full view, a woman in a blue dress, white apron and bonnet, sitting, surrounded by a number of people. In the right corner a washbasin on a stand and a drum of surgical instruments on a stand. In the left corner a woman in a white coat and bonnet, in frontal view, holding a bottle.
9713e2c3c318e232472d9eb4bac7c1ff882b4931: In the foreground four bare-footed dancers, with wing-like pieces of cloth attached to their arms, sparkling ribbons around their heads, performing airy leaps. In front on the right a fifth dancer, bent over, holding her head with her hands and expressing despair. Further back, dancers in similar costumes lying in various poses.
7090097cc6a348f6704c061c0b215db00b137750: Autumn landscape with a stream and the first snow. A winding stream with fast-flowing open water runs from the back towards the front. On both banks a fresh white strip of snow. Yellow leaves in the water. In the centre 5 birches with a few golden leaves. Bushes bare, the ground covered with snow. Dark clouds in the sky. On the horizon, above the strip of forest, yellowish evening light.
fb2d144d9e5ac0f803262ecaf5ef65ae9b18fcda: Heldur Laretei studied under Paul Luhtein and Evald Okas in the graphic art department of the Estonian SSR State Art Institute, which he graduated from together with Peeter Ulas, Herald Eelma, Silvia Liiberg and Olav Maran in 1959. Laretei's diploma work was a series of woodcuts for Shakespeare's "Hamlet". In the 1960s–1970s he practised free graphic art.
7b1f87931b5bd36373737171ed02b447599e1655: A figural composition of a ski race starting point. In the foreground a brass band, on the right and left people gathered in groups, start numbers on their chests and backs. Pairs of skis leaning against the house walls, red flags beside the house door. According to Heldur Viires, this depicts the start of the 1st Tartu Marathon, in which the artist's son also took part.
94ba6dba5d56565e8c499cff855d35be00ee99e6: In a farm cattle yard, on the right foreground, a woman in milking position by a black-and-white patterned cow, facing left. In the centre, in full view, a woman in a reddish-coloured skirt standing beside a cow of the same breed. On both edges of the picture, farm outbuildings connected by a fence can be seen, behind which the farmyard and a straw-roofed threshing barn are visible. The sketch is executed in general outlines.
f17bba00996c64556b457c51a2432b95820176d8: By the corner of a house, in front of a randomly green fence, a man sits on a bench facing the viewer. To his left a woman in a red skirt and white blouse leans on the fence. A gesturing woman in a red kerchief, bent over, approaches them. In the distance on the left an open field. Painted vigorously in light bluish-green tones with a few yellowish sun patches.
d88d47330e2fa378ab619c7dd7c087a8579806ae: Väike-Munamägi and Tedremägi. Two adjacent low hill domes covered with dark green forest. At the foot of the hills a yellowish-brownish autumn landscape, which in the foreground turns green with various shades. On the right a light green field. Dark forest on the horizon. A yellowish sky covered with cirrus clouds, with a purplish tinge above the horizon.
8033517b0761f1cdc8739ab4aba1e3140cf74392: Slightly right of the central axis, the head of a middle-aged man with an elongated face, in a quarter-turn to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead, lips pressed together, eyebrows slightly raised, dark hair combed over the head, eyebrows slightly raised, dark hair combed over the head, a wider sweater collar at the neckline. Painted richly in grey - brownish beige tones.
6f237c83a95276d33a5217fa9466587d14432874: In the foreground a curving stony sandy beach running from right to left, from which in the middle a boat pier extends from the shore into the sea. Behind it a two-masted galliot. Further away on the right a sailboat gliding on the sea, behind it on the horizon a steamer with smoking chimney. Behind on the left on the shore three buildings. Over half of the picture surface on the left is taken up by a sky in dark clouds.
9b4f0b7b197bf90865d1c879998e23b1f8a149a7: Standing female nude in half-profile, face turned right. Yellowish-brown short hair with a fringe, an orangish cloth in the hands. On the left, an easel placed diagonally and a stool with a large blue jug. On the right, two easels. Background: on the left a greyish-green cloth, in the centre a green wall with a window, on the right a blue cloth. Colour scheme green-brown-blue. Smooth application.
56f215ff9871c62077d8aa0acf85cfb54f3f5f88: Janne Lias (b. 1981) is an interdisciplinary artist working in Tallinn. She graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in painting (2019) and completed a master's degree in contemporary art (2022). She previously earned a master's degree in informatics at Tallinn University of Technology, and therefore often combines information technology with art in her work.
f89847b6d9a4a6272bb5f1bf56ccfdf2f06d0730: Below the window, the edge of a round table on which stands a vase with a rich bouquet of various flowers placed side by side. A single flower on the table to the left. In the upper right corner, a yellowish full moon showing through the window. A captivating bluish light in the room. Purplish-blue, greenish poisonous tones. The vase with flowers is glued onto the backing paper, with flowers glued on top of it in turn.
9b01d7988bb1377afff902bb6840ebce0fc38de2: Evening summer landscape. Green field in the foreground. A group of buildings further back on the right. Another group of buildings further away on the left. A dark clump of forest behind them. Behind the forest, a small light-blue lake almost across the entire width of the painting. A blue streak on the horizon. The sky farther off is light, with a warmer tint. A ultramarine-blue ground shows through the whole extent of the painting.
cd6838e2728818bec418886198ef70d822cecb58: Against a white background, which is greyer on the left and at the bottom of the painting, an irregular bluish-white rectangle is placed. The shape begins at the lower left edge of the painting, positioned somewhat diagonally, its upper left corner reaching close to the top edge of the painting. The shape is not situated exactly in the centre of the painting but is shifted somewhat to the left.
9265a384d1508dd61534ddd99eb5de9536f13afe: A relief surface covered predominantly in white. Debris scattered onto the support, later covered with white. On the right side, slightly crumpled papers glued onto the support, projecting about 5 cm in places, partly covered with paint. In the lower left quarter, a metal pointer with an electric motor on the back. At the upper left of the picture, black streams of paint flow.
6fcdb1a69780f46e0a39738a01dfc19ae1e706d0: A partly fantastical landscape with realistic motifs. In the upper part, a cobalt-blue sea suggested with a jagged coastline. 2/3 of the picture's surface depicts the coastal area. In the foreground on the left, nets hung out to dry, fences. Further back on the left, huts, a dilapidated boat. On the right, motifs of a waterfall, a bridge. The painting is in greenish-grey, reddish, beige transitional tones.
4938a1922a92a1aa702de19aa022ba2f3acf28d0: Against a blue background, in the upper foreground, four beings with human heads. In the centre left, a female being in blue tones, dressed in an Asian-like manner. Behind her an older face in yellowish tones, beside it two smaller figures in pinkish garments. The beings are grouped among aquatic plants (?). At the bottom centre, an abstract image in pinkish and grey tones.
a555033ca243fd6a1f8a285e020c026576043a46: A composition in two halves: to the left of the vertical centre line, black, white, blue, light pink and green blotches are painted on an orange background. The green shape continues on the right, as black on a red background. On the right-hand part, on a red background, a dark red blotch, alongside a horizontal yellow, blue and cold-green blotch.
40957cdd631229744de2cf9cb917194418cf09f0: Between old stone walls, in a vaulted opening, two figures: on the left a half-bald man in a red-trimmed robe and sandals, a brown bag over his shoulder, his left hand on the shoulder of a dark-haired boy standing to the right. The boy holds a vessel in his hands, a large red shawl draped around his shoulders over his coat. In reddish-brown and green tones.
781c75f70a704214b42a823b72db8eadbeccf638: A caricatural drawing of a barber's salon. In front of a mirror sits a young man with a moustache and a crew-cut hairstyle, arranging a long tie with both hands; on the left stands a corpulent older woman who has placed her hands on the young man's shoulder and hair. To the left of the young man stands an older man counting banknotes. On the table, banknotes, a mirror and barber's implements.
53afd9c9c31b533640dd0ee57c97a7b410908ac9: Rait Rosin (b. 1981) earned a bachelor's degree in painting from the Estonian Academy of Arts (2005), a master's degree in art from the same institution (2007), and continues his studies in the doctoral programme in art and design at EKA (since 2015). Besides his artistic education, Rosin has earned a master's degree in philosophy from Tallinn University (2013).
6abaf07d6f72c9a1105c18686e04983da747db47: Margus Teska is an Estonian multidisciplinary artist whose work encompasses sculpture, ceramics, costume and graphic design. Moving between different media, he explores the interrelations of material, form and visual storytelling, combining technical mastery with an imaginative and conceptual approach.
96d452deb81fb7d4e8b3f7aae077d8255ff12eb4: Asteria (b. 1991) is an Estonian painter who lives and works in Tartu. She graduated from the Tartu Art College in decoration and earned a degree in painting from the Pallas Higher Art School. Asteria's works are regularly exhibited at various exhibitions and can be found in numerous private collections both in Estonia and abroad.
e0590ec6026c5eb49aba2f4907f7c2e969306c66: In the foreground, amid green grass, a grey urn from which a cress bush grows. In the lower right corner one, and upper left of the bush three, yellow- and red-striped metal pipes. In the background trees and bushes, a strip of sky in the upper left. Blades of grass and leaves carefully painted in detail, the colour scheme a combination of all manner of green tones.
aa2340dce4915a21cf631854b4a99a14a1d44194: A clearly delineated surface resembling aluminium plates runs from top to bottom through a beige-brown background imitating marble slabs. On it, at the top centre, a red upside-down half-moon with ray motifs. In the lower quarter, the Tallinn skyline. Along the bottom edge, a dark tabletop with a cobalt-blue slab, on which lie a fish, sea plants, a red piece of cord and a bullet.
39c3373f78d5fa7405568169417fb758d4a9347f: In a reddish-brown carved armchair sits a portly man in half-turn, hands resting in his lap. He wears a dark greenish-grey suit, a white shirt and a tie. His hair is slightly curly, with a thick moustache and a slightly hooked nose. To the right of the figure, a low round table with a cigarette holder, cigars and cigarettes. Background light beige, a patterned carpet on the floor.
744f7270b8190e7641475104bd7fcb5bc10e705d: In the foreground on the right, a black-haired woman in a white dress is washing herself. In the background on the left, one black and one reddish-brown horse and two people: a woman in a white dress and headscarf and a man in striped clothing with a black cap, a long pole on his shoulder. In the background, a yellow field with haystacks and a green strip of forest. The sky is yellowish-pink.
dc307cbc182089c84d9b63c8748dc6359ea0f054: A bird's-eye view of a winter yard with woodsheds at dusk. On the right, the gable end of a gabled-roof house, bare trees at the fence line. Further off, small houses, the glow of light in their windows. On the horizon, trees and house silhouettes suggested on a slope. Painted in dark greyish-, greenish-blue, reddish-brown tones, in places with sweeping strokes, in places impasto.
1ace038f259ea815dadec09bc614712aaec8748d: Against a background painted mainly in greenish-grey tones, two almost life-size running child figures - a naked, dark-haired boy, his head in profile turned to the left; and a girl in a pinkish dress, her right hand raised, ready to catch a golden-yellow butterfly hovering in front of her. The colour scheme is light. The line is in places diffused; the painted surface partly textured.
228c5ae83b829a90a756294a79e705465b0d18c9: The full figure, in frontal view, of a man in a long brown-toned tunic, standing with legs apart, over which is drawn a ring-mail shirt, his head turned toward his right shoulder. In his right hand the man holds a bared double-edged sword, while his left hand, falling into the shadow of a wide, wolf-like cloak of a greenish tone, holds a round wooden shield with a metal handle and finger-guard at the centre.
aff8fbf96966b79a11e4407e703219980e0c6fbb: 5 sketches under one glass. 1. High coastline: on the right a fenced house and 2 haystacks. 2. A large boulder under trees. 3. A low, sandy seashore. A three-masted sailboat at sea. 4. Strollers on the seaside promenade, a man and a woman in the foreground. 5. A sandy bluff on which young pines grow. A path runs beneath them.
4f4e7979ded6c3d868213b5fc3fb75254bddd000: Tiina Ojaste (b. 1961 in Pärnu) began her art studies at the age of eight. In 1981 she graduated from the Tartu Art College in leatherworking. After her studies she began working as an artist at the ELVI Special Design Bureau. A few years later she became an entrepreneur, and for about twenty years worked as a leather artist and designer in companies she had founded herself.
6fd090d049a104d39f1b32a34cc629ffa01d44fc: on two white-edged, red-grounded fibreboard panels, one bears a construction of white squares and spheres, purple semicircles and a hemisphere, and blue tubes; the other panel bears a construction of a white, blue and purple hemisphere and white and blue articulated tubes. Location on the object: none
710e626b2d6b5712f54e49b5516ed50e1ccac2c7: The blue background gradually turns blackish toward the top. In the centre of the background a rectangular metaphysical shape-view: a steel-grey uniform wall-surface at the lower left, over which a dark-blue drapery with silky folds is cast. At the right corner of the grey surface, a yellowish-green sphere, a captivating light on the sphere and on the drapery fold. Behind it, a bluish-grey expanse.
3344bba12efed2a953993c212602b7ffeb69753e: A uniform white background framed by a clear-edged black stripe. The stripe divides the upper part of the painting into a narrow horizontal band, and the left edge into two rectangles placed one above the other. Inside the boxes are marbled surfaces painted in red, black and green. On the white background at right, a cobalt-blue arc-shaped plant motif rendered freehand.
c07daae0b4f9e862a9df3b3d8dcbf3a633030f2a: A woman in a white kerchief and blouse, holding sheep shears, bending over a sheep. The facial features are given very schematically. In the foreground a half-shorn sheep, above which, at right, a basket with wool. The colour scheme is in greenish-brown and yellow tones. The woman's head and shoulders, and the sheep's hindquarters, are highlighted with light.
ff276155937611831e8fed8241e558e92f142022: In the foreground, a girl with a light-coloured hair bun, in a white blouse and grey skirt, sitting half turned with her back to the viewer on a chair, her right hand on a skein of wool. To the left of the girl, an older woman in a striped folk-costume skirt, a brown jacket and a dark red pot-shaped cap, her hand on the girl's shoulder, bending over her. The background is dark grey.
0c60ff80a1204042882421c0130f3967c277d0b1: In the foreground at left, fully armed men are climbing out of a boat in shallow water; in the middle, soldiers running through the water towards a rocky shore at right, some of whom have already reached the shore. On the shore a low pine grove, above which pillars of fire and smoke from shell detonations are visible. In the dawn light, scattered clouds in the sky.
be2293937fe638199033dfea2211796d8a80eff0: A whitish-grey canvas with horizontal cuts and small holes across the entire surface of the painting. The blackish-grey freehand-drawn stripes on the painting are likewise horizontal. Deliberate tears are concentrated in a larger group on the right side and lower part of the painting. There are fewer of them, and they are smaller in size, on the left and upper part.
40a777b15fd9e6a0c10eb46119d0fa37cedbeaf3: A portrait composition in bluish-green and red tones: carefully worked surfaces suggest architectural constructions at left. At right, in a niche (or under an arch), a young woman in profile with red hair, blue eyes, full lips and an upturned nose. The woman's hands are crossed on her chest, and on her left hand there is a light flower-shaped ring.
b73a4ba33718638237841fc58e288855eaa3bbd9: A colourful composition interwoven with decorative figures and doll-like female body forms. At the bottom centre, a stylised torso seen frontally. In the middle of the picture, a square-shaped surface bordered by decorative sectors and the like. The clearly delineated figures are mostly rendered with volume, predominantly in red, brown and turquoise tones.
84ed96c815674c17b02a1a819a938262e5476d36: In the foreground, a cheerful group of men, women and children sits around a table covered with vegetables, with a monkey among them. Further back, intermingled with each other from left to right, are a cow, a tractor, a lion with a cub, a man with a parrot, and a donkey's and an elk's head. In the right corner, a curly tree with an exotic bird. Decorative style, green and reddish-brown tones.
c03e3676aa522f4f6be6886ee50b6ab25faae5b1: An abstract geometric composition with a complex surface and spatial structure, whose main elements are rectangles and stripes of varying sizes. Above the approximately vertical central axis, a freehand-drawn grey spiral line. In the centre of the work, a black-and-grey abstract shape. Colourful, carefully balanced colour surfaces.
a2d9c36fe81d00e6642cef7a874c91d37f938c2d: A composition of clearly delineated, interlocking abstract colour surfaces dominated by olive-yellow, black, red, light blue and pink tones. The surfaces, with jagged and curved edges, are separated by a uniform contrasting contour line about 1 cm wide. The dynamic composition resembles a collage of coloured papers.
f874929a9920e62d5033c0d57f79c433f672ef39: A naked young woman with long, light, loose hair is leaving the water from a cliff. Her body is in half-profile facing left. Her head is turned to the right. A water nymph emerging from the water stretches both arms out towards her. On the right, on the steep bank, four monks are partly visible in torchlight, of whom the one on the left raises a cross towards Lorelei.
498b6e989b6a313363a0aeb1c2dc0bec301d567b: A genre scene depicting ship-loading work. In the foreground, six men in work clothes and sou'westers are lifting cargo on the ship and fastening it to ropes. Behind the ship being unloaded, at left and right, are the bows of large ships and a quay along which people are walking. In the distance, harbour warehouse buildings. In grey and brown tones. In places a pastose texture.
301e40c759eede7b5d99769db15f52d7414459e5: Portrait of an older Estonian farmer on a grey background that darkens towards the bottom. The man has long, dark-yellow hair over his ears, a short beard and moustache. His strong nose is slightly reddened. He is wearing a fur-trimmed läkiläki (sheepskin cap-like garment), a dark waistcoat with a raised collar, a white shirt and a dark green coat. In the man's strong hands, a small round tobacco box.
65686f26bdd0865e69da900623c321c88dc15147: A full-length frontal figure of a grey-haired old man in a long bluish-grey waistcoat trimmed with red, his head turned to the left. The coat's front is fastened at the chest with a large horseshoe-shaped brooch, and at the waist with a leather belt, from which hangs a large knife in a leather sheath. His attire also includes: a necklace with curls, a bracelet and a fur cap with upright ears.
e54482eceabe1c53462660e5eec53601fef67df6: Toom Tragel (born 1989) is an Estonian illustrator and graphic designer whose work focuses mainly on drawing and visual narratives. He graduated with a bachelor's degree in graphic design from the Estonian Academy of Arts, and obtained a master's degree in visual communication design at Aalto University in Finland.
9688296f7fc19fe238195f13770bbd7fa230ffc5: A landscape mainly in muted green, blue and grey tones, with a curving stone fence in the foreground at right and a post mill in the centre. Behind the mill at right, a field ploughed black, at left a road leading to a village in the depth of the picture. On the horizon, farmhouses and trees forming the village alternate. Above, a yellowish-grey sky.
f8e32bea2e79fdbc3b0feecbc58b26c669addc77: In a black-and-white photographic image divided into three horizontal frames, with a crumpled surface, a seated naked woman is repeated, holding her head with her hands, hair dishevelled, with a light rectangle at left in the background. In the middle frame, lower right, the title "Ühtki piiska pärast sadu" ["Not a Drop After the Rain"] written in red ink; in the bottom frame, lower left, a signature and date in red ink.
8c5061b8ad1960485a48c96ced24bf41b3c7d246: Bust portrait of a young man with an elongated face, his head turned slightly to the left, a high forehead, light-coloured, short, straight hair. He is wearing a yellowish-brown coat, a blue-and-white checked shirt with a tie. Different tones are blended together, in places pastose. In the background, clearly distinguishable brushstrokes in grey, blue, purple and cold-green tones.
314f42dc396d647875f2878a3d624a651567ad86: The bluish-grey sea merges with the equally grey sky on the horizon. Fishing boats with men busy with nets are chaotically scattered across the entire sea surface. In total there are 19 boats. In the distance, on the right side of the picture, three barely noticeable boats with raised sails. Seagulls circle above the boats. In an impressionistic painting style.
fd704cb2b27f883718d11566f56d55449e1ae15d: Bust portrait of an older man with glasses, his face almost frontal, his chest slightly turned to the left. The man's crown is covered with thinning hair, longer at the back, reaching below the ears. He is wearing a blue shirt with the top button undone and a slightly askew red tie. The background is mottled in green, blue and red.
bd0dd4b38e1fb84cdb561b52f433fe9b46cb00fb: A composition in the style of the 1960s with four stylised human figures. All figures are shown frontally and full-length. The middle one is a little shorter. The head of the frontal figure standing at the right edge is turned to the left. The colour scheme of the painting is dominated by dirty brown, grey and lighter green tones. A light blue colour accent in the middle part of the painting.
762e49555c42612e6d219c9683dd9605b6d25ddc: A grotesque scene with clowns. In the foreground, a central figure stands barefoot on a red pedestal, dressed in brown, wearing a crown; from an open coverall in front, a pink creature with human hands protrudes; the figure on the right has a raised leg, the figure on the left is growing a dandelion. Behind them, an audience as if in brown masks with glowing eye openings.
d20b887a0349c5578b74f190c3708f274efc8147: A landscape in vivid blue, red and green tones, which reads almost as a combination of abstract colour patches. In the foreground, a high bare rocky knoll resembling a hillock, behind which, at left, a similar elevation covered with greenery. The high horizon leaves only a little room at the top for the vivid blue and pink sky.
aacd5d48fc4a6aa60c3342e45755f83ce8ea4dff: In pale greenish-grey tones, among sedges, a whitish disc of a culvert. In the foreground, a dark water surface with blue-purplish-green reflections and, in dirty brownish-whitish colours, a line of debris here and there accentuated with black contour. Fine graphic work alongside broad free brushstrokes side by side; a smooth and slightly textured paint surface.
3e96c62b07986e633fd8d93dceb3f29d6b863454: A still life composed of porcelain vessels and weapons. In the centre, a round-shaped tureen, in front of it at left a small vessel with a narrow spout, and behind it a goblet-shaped vessel. To the right of the tureen, a dark vessel with a long narrow neck and a small bowl with blue glaze. In the foreground, an antique pistol and a dagger with a decorated handle. The background is a colourful oriental carpet.
6a4022d5bcbf19aa2c5f478f14d8bcd625213e6d: Armed Estonians burst through a broken-open gate into the manor courtyard, which is enclosed by a strong log fence. The roofs of the wooden towers on both sides are burning. In the courtyard are groups of armed Estonians. Behind, a larger building: the lower storey of stone, the upper of logs. On the left a church with a tower can be seen, and further away on a hill the blazing manor house.
e25516aad60866bd099056e4f7342bb88f92e070: ANNO DOMINI 1562 FEBRUARI DIE 27 IN ARCE REVALIENSI OBIIT NOBILIS AC GENEROSUS DOMINUS LAURENTIUS FLEMING. LIBER. BARO. DE SUNDTHOLM ET NINES. REGIA MAIESTATIS SWETIAE GUVERNATOR REVALIENSIS ZVI SUBSEZVENTI 4. MARTII DIE HIC SEPULTUS EST. CVIVS ANIMA IN CHRISTO REZVIESCAT Location on the object: Below the drawing a plaque with text
b0f1f97d092e90a4aa5ca4eb2b46d2d56b9cdbe8: from Rakvere, studied at "Pallas" 1927-1936 and graduated as a student of N. Triik. He furthered his education a year later in Paris, Berlin and Dresden. From 1940-1965 he worked as a stage designer at the theatre of his home town Rakvere: he designed about 150 productions. He was a painter of good professional level, who also exhibited at national exhibitions.
3c46d66298eb4a79ba98d9bcafbeba1121cfe736: Kadri Krüüner graduated from the painting department of Pallas in 2022 and from the specialty of teacher of arts and technology at the University of Tartu in 2024. Kadri teaches art and gathers inspiration at Tartu Veeriku School and keeps her brushes busy in her free time. She is interested in soul, city, cultural, micro and macro landscapes and the clashing sounds of colours.
f56ad18cc19657bbbfa86db63050bebef5487c28: Maari Soekov is an Estonian visual artist and illustrator, whose work brings together a dreamlike sensitivity, a nature-close worldview and mythopoeia. She has graduated from the photography specialty of the Tartu Art College (2010–2014) and furthered her education within the Erasmus programme at the Escola Superior Artística do Porto (2012–2013).
b3354485701b2b66d714b5e0b6308d3af791798e: The image consists of five identical vertical parts printed side by side from one plate. Below, two infant figures holding their right foot with both hands, above them a high-rise building composed of televisions, at the top on either edge a fragment of a parachute. The middle vertical part of the composition is darker (photo-etching in negative)
605f5f52a2aa41b174fe7cd2dc58956be8f2d58f: A three-part painting. On the central panel on the right a red horse's head, a bouquet of flowers and fruits, on the left a hand reaching for the fruits. The upper third of the central part is crossed by two dark blue stripes, above which on the vertical centre line is a brown rectangular surface. On the right-hand side panel an apple on a green background, on the left-hand one fruits on a beige background.
d8a0febaf3a1239c97034ffea9edda42458e1ddc: The picture depicts St John's Church in Haapsalu seen from the south. Signature in the lower right corner. Painted on cardboard, to the back of which a thin cardboard is glued. On it, in blue pencil, data about the painting is written. On both edges there have been glued rectangular pieces of thicker paper, which have been partially torn off.
59190038de9fdc9b0723e39a30e62994ce09ffd9: In the middle, in a large yellow armchair, sits a woman with yellow straight hair, both hands resting on the arms of the chair. The woman is wearing a light blue dress with black stripes at the top and black dots on the skirt part. In the background, directly behind the woman's back, a green rectangle, the rest of the background in several shades of purple. In places the form is emphasised with a black contour.
f6c1cd9d4c6701d527d3fd3b9e91ed0bb7363701: In a greyish, misty overall tone, a snowy street view with soft contours, with pale purple, pale yellowish and pale greenish house façades covering almost the entire compositional surface in the background. In the middle ground on the left, in the golden section, a cube-shaped two-storey greenish house, in the foreground on the right edge a one-storey purplish-greenish wooden house.
6d4f71aa33c7d82c6d32ebd32c9d55a28fc25bac: A knee-length portrait of an older dark-haired woman sitting in front of a harmonium. The body slightly turned to the right, the face in three-quarter profile to the left. A black taffeta dress with a narrow white lace collar and cuffs. On the head a white lace cap. In her lap, between her hands, an open book. On the right corner of the harmonium a vase with flowers; on the left, on a table, a small sculpture group with animals.
92ff6544d78f1ce88f5d94fb737fc0e07153fdac: A two-part spatial composition on a plywood base, to which a number of household waste items and objects of various materials are attached: plastic moulds, beer cans, a plastic rosette, strips of cloth, wooden details, openwork metal strips etc. The heap of objects runs from the bottom left up to the right. On the right edge a row of plastic rings. The plywood base is slightly tinted.
c5f20e935d69aebb09e8b43730ca58f9ef72d715: A snowy courtyard in the old town: on the right a wide, low-roofed house, next to which a cart stands under a canopy. In the background on the left, stone houses with high pointed roofs and long chimneys, from which a gate leads out of the courtyard in the foreground. Through the gate opening two snowy trees can be seen. Overall brownish-yellow colour scheme, in places pastose.
fe2a70b6a1c1d8bae9834ead3579a24762a06946: A ¾ portrait of an older woman against a dark background, the head slightly turned to the left. Fingers interlaced, resting in her lap. Wearing a light blouse with puffed sleeves and a light grey skirt with a high collar. On the chest a red brooch with a floral motif, on the head a light cap embroidered with reddish embroidery. Realistic manner of depiction, the edges of the canvas partially left unpainted.
d960402e69d02ae316e84b009aa47fb716746b86: Tiia Johannson was a media artist, lecturer and researcher. She began as a watercolourist and painter. She has been considered one of the representatives of neo-expressionism in Estonian art of the 1980s. From 1990 she worked mainly on numerous media art projects dealing with video, multimedia and information society technologies.
59862205af48f24cfdd421d4111fe4416263a714: Born in Tartu (1972). Graduated from the University of Tartu teacher training programme (2001), the painting specialty of the Faculty of Philosophy of the University of Tartu (1999), the Tartu Art School (1992). Lecturer in painting at the Tartu Art College from 2001-2009. Member of the Estonian Artists' Association since 2005. Member of the Tartu Artists' Association since 2000. Has exhibited since 1997.
fdc9c3dfd74be2ce5d68501213a3a72802d95043: In the foreground stands a young man with his hands in his trouser pockets, head in profile to the left. On the left sit two young men, the one further right holding a book, the one on the left resting his hands on the first one's shoulder. In the right-hand part of the painting two young men are playing the violin. In the background on the right two thick trees, on the left a yellow grain field, where a man is working with a horse.
c80e7e452aa92be4e5e7600d7bbe4daf5b5df5f3: In an interior marked by grey surfaces and stripes, on a brown floor a round-seated Vienna chair. Over the round back of the chair a bluish-green cloth is thrown. On the chair a hat with a grey brim and a brown crown on a yellowish-grey cloth, and a ceramic vase with a thin neck and square handle (reddish-brown glaze at the top, grey glaze below).
5d173a0625f24dcedbb85af1edcdaca1014d2d9f: The image consists of two identical vertical parts printed side by side from one plate: high-rise buildings symmetrically arranged on the sides, a stylised tree in the middle in the foreground; in the background low smoking chimneys and burning light bulbs at the tops of poles. Against the background of the buildings, two stylised trees one above the other
854e0856e15fa0ca23a344367b0fcfc3ce2e3abd: A view of two bare, abandoned green rooms, on the floor of which are dismantled radiators, and in the left-hand room, rubbish. From the window opening a view onto an orange path and a grandstand, whose benches are of different colours by sector. Behind the grandstand a park with two trees on a strip of grass between the paths. Black squares in the window openings. Greenish colour scheme.
5cf90790e89e411058cd0fe612708e864800bf8a: Against a black background three young women in three-quarter profile facing left, standing in long white dresses, all joined at the waist by a sash. On the left-hand one the breasts and belly are exposed; the middle one has a crown on her head, red rods in her hair, breasts bare; on the right-hand one the breasts are bare. Above on the left a sitting eagle, in the background red arrows, curved lines
474cdeb4a5ee4c40e5b8f58e4803b858a73e3f0a: In the foreground four pine trees with purplish-brown trunks and an emphasised silhouette, given with green crowns. In the background the silhouette of a forest rendered with vertical lines. Above, large white cloud masses, between which a small patch of bright blue sky can be seen. In the foreground grass and flowers in a stippling technique. Green and white tones predominate.
4b8afceaa67bd2ededf19bdbd125aedae0847ffd: In the middle ground of the painting, in the right-hand part of the picture field, a bluish-grey bathhouse with two black door openings in its left-hand part, with a bather emerging from each. Above the outermost door a stairway reaching down into the water. Green trees form the background. In the foreground in the water two posts for mooring boats; by the right-hand one two boats. In front of the bathhouse in the water two bathers.
a5d8bc3b079bac77cb3d7b69fb0208850362c4fb: In a half-dark farmhouse room, lit by two candles standing on a table, in the left-hand wall under a window a bed with a person lying in it, in front of which sits a man, his left hand supporting his head, in his right hand a book; on the right stand two figures - one a man with a bare head, in a long robe, the other a woman. In the room various household implements, under the ceiling firewood drying.
2ff4850e52e448593ca04e178ef59de4246c9dd8: Kiwa's sound sculpture The "Motor Girls" Perform For You, was one of the first works in the EKKM collection. It was acquired for a two-kroon note stolen from the tip cup at the Kumu café, which synchronizes nicely with the two watering cans that form the material embodiment of the work – two kroons, two watering cans.
e9021c1a4e9d555cc4ea10b43936fc9cc22bb1ab: In 1944 Silvia Leitu moved to live in Germany. From 1953 she lived in Sweden as a freelance artist, exhibiting actively and making book illustrations. In Sweden Silvia Leitu was known primarily as a virtuoso watercolourist. Her watercolours of Estonian folk costumes show the approach of a costume designer.
b5155e54535f1c59bf6f732003d77106b62e9646: Composition of a woman standing with legs apart facing the viewer, and of the hands joining a clock mechanism to her lap. The mouth of the woman with a Mongoloid face is wide open, printed text beside the mouth: Victory or death. A pop-like decorative, flat manner of depiction. Surrounded by black contour on a white background: the body a hazy pink, the clothing blue and black.
483c6395db8af47bfa7b610e2703d94e8fb83e92: In the front centre, a campfire on the grass. The line of smoke rising straight up from the fire forms a cross with the smoke haze running horizontally across the top of the work. Beside the fire on the left a man sits with his back to the viewer, on the right in half-profile facing left a woman with a child in her lap. Behind, on the left, a horse grazing on grass. Groups of deciduous trees border the open meadow in the distance.
7825dbd8066cea2c0c85e32f797b8658dcb90b65: A view of a town from above, painted in greenish-grey pastel tones. On the left reddish gable roofs, tree crowns, in the centre a street narrowing towards the horizon with vaguely discernible vehicles and people. In the distance and on the right edge a house wall with yellowish patches of light, a cornice at the top. Painted with short brushstrokes, more impasto in the trees.
3951362e203e05e394a550a750a3d404d5ec8486: Bust portrait of a young brown-eyed woman in half-profile facing left. Long dark hair combed smoothly apart from the centre at the front and falling to the nape of the neck, leaving the ear exposed. Above the finished head, within an oval, a dark greenish-brown background, whereas the chest area, from the neck down, shows only a lighter patch of uncovered ground - the work is unfinished.
b7a58989ca2e34d48985d6036d5477414406039d: Two-part composition in painted tin cans within a wooden frame. On the upper, light blue background one whole and half of a clock with a hexagonal dial, black contour, coloured hands. On the lower part, on an orange background, the word SEIS [STOP] in white with a reflection, below it the reading of an electronic clock 2106. At the bottom edge, on a yellow background, the number 2016.
e0d4bb32437d935b0fa93aa0421eb72a5549080f: A hilly panoramic landscape: in the foreground on the right two houses with brown roofs, trees behind them. From the houses a road runs to the right between the hills. Green clumps of forest between the hill tops, a larger forest-covered mountain in the centre of the horizon. The sky dark and cloudy. Painted in dark cold-green and grey tones, in a "Cézannist" manner.
a213e6f51dade9ee5895448210f0a86bfe5743f5: Given with small brushstrokes, the full figure of a woman in red clothing with a light headscarf, sitting by a body of water leaning against dark green shrubbery. A fishing net in her hands, on the right two boats by the sandy shore of the water. The painting's surface is partly translucent, the structure of the woman's scarf and the fishing net rendered as notches scratched into the paint layer.
a35760423a2ab6e6d04520df6b70dbbf9cc5d6f2: Ülo TEDER (1923, Võru – 2008) was an Estonian painter who worked in watercolour, pastel, oil and tempera painting. He created landscapes and townscapes, figural compositions and still lifes in a vigorous style. Among other things he also designed film posters. Teder received his art education at the Tartu State Art Institute and at ERKI.
26eb70a992777e1be035c567b5908e47245ea779: He furthered his education in Paris: at l'Academie de la Grande Chaumiere, Atelier George Bramsen et Clot, Atelier Desjobert; as well as at the University of California, Berkeley. From 1965-1973 he was a lecturer at the Ontario College of Art, in 1969 he was a founding member of the Toronto Open Studio Printmakers. In 1977 R. Tulving was elected a member of the Royal Canadian Academy of Arts.
bafba7a8e3f02a224c8c2aa832ef6592cf4eb4b9: Full figure, in frontal view, of a middle-aged stout woman sitting in the centre on a red sofa with a high back. In front of her, the full figure of a small red-cheeked girl in a pink dress, sitting on a low upholstered bench. Face in frontal view, body slightly turned to the left. Beside the woman on the sofa, on either side, the full figures of sitting boys in frontal view.
2b176cc69c103ce79ba52deeea1a9a3f564fdfd5: On a black background, in the centre, the figure of a young woman in a long dress standing in profile facing right, head in half-profile facing right, a basket with plants on her arm, left hand under her chin. 5224e08207cc74bc7b203bd014d559f40cf7d213: Behind uniform broad vertical, horizontal and diagonal lines, the figures of three women interwoven with landscape elements. The left one, with mouth ajar, and the middle one, with open lapels, facing the viewer. From the hairline the heads are covered by a uniform black surface. The right one in profile facing right. Four identical clearly bounded surfaces on either side. The lower edge red.
9923626b2baad654672e5f1863221aae1164b94c: On the vertical central axis of the composition, running across the picture, a light surface bordered with red stripes, which serves as background to a large cactus growing in a brown pot. The pot with the cactus stands on a three-legged bluish-black stool. To the left and right of the cactus are green surfaces on which a composition of fine red lines is placed.
84e7764f4523cffd22f02f962f07d2c050f59a0a: A uniform white background framed by a clearly bounded black stripe. The stripe divides the upper part of the painting into a narrow horizontal rectangle and the right side into two rectangles placed one above the other. Inside the boxes marbled surfaces painted with red, black, green. On the white background on the left, a cobalt blue branch-like form depicted with a free hand.
09f434e05d8a1c44ac2bd5cfa26d05a6d05a2c81: A long-haired blonde female nude in side view, sitting on a yellow-striped chaise longue, a towel in her hands, a washbasin in front on the floor. Surrounded by an indoor interior: on the right a yellow cabinet, a round little table with a vase, behind it a pink-striped screen, on the left greenish curtains. Pastel pink-green tones, a painting style modelling with light and shadow.
af871ab0ea5a368d4e1a33a1894aeaea8311ead6: A naturalistically true still life in brownish-grey tones with a light background and a dark base. Vessels are arranged in a triangular composition in the middle of the picture. On the left a larger brown bowl, slightly behind it a dark vessel on which a lower clay bowl in yellowish-brownish tones with a wooden spoon is placed. To the right there is a small tin cup.
b6c8828a01da723fd017d8718c5834d21467813f: In the centre of the picture, the full figure of an older man sitting behind a writing desk, in a slight turn to the right. Hands resting on the desk, left leg raised over the knee. The restless rhythm of the figure's irregular blue colour surfaces is contrasted by the calm rhythm of the regular grey-brown geometric surfaces marking the furnishing of the room as background.
8148c5fe68dc79bbcf98bdace119d1fd374f93a3: Plants with melted colours and vague contours, on the left and right sides of the picture. In the centre of the painting four round yellowish colour spots with white centres, below them on the left two smaller white dots. In the upper part of the painting a sky-blue tone smoothly transitions downward into reddish-brown, and on the right side into greenish.
0ad61ea3f5e80d39bef13cf353faf367410a9f10: A view from the back seat of a car: on the left, behind the wheel, part of a man in a blue jacket (Mäetamm), on the passenger seat part of a young man (Ole) pointing his finger at the green landscape opening through the windshield, on which there is text in white block letters: HOLOCAUST. The upper part of the painting is grey, depicting the car ceiling, in the centre a mirror, which partly conceals the letters CA.
f96e05ef1c8af7e2bb2ba48fca8fb892361bd65d: An abstract composition, in the middle part of which one half and one whole pink circle (as if covered with annual rings). At the top right part of a rainbow. Along the right edge a greyish-purple stripe, lighter at the top, darker at the bottom. Across the surface of the picture as if enlarged frost flowers, through which a pink, dark blue and yellowish background shows.
f2113e96e7965a8a5cbdf50829c92e39ec952355: Against a colourful background, a bust portrait, in frontal view, of a young woman with dark hair and long hair. Head slightly turned to the left, gaze directed forward and down. Right bent arm crossed over the chest near the left shoulder. The woman is wearing a bluish dress with short sleeves. Painted in bluish-brownish-ochre tones with light, vigorous brushstrokes.
1f7beaf6cbbdd99cd465e2447c9af6ca1a17b033: In the foreground a courtyard in the old town with two lilac bushes, between which colourful laundry is drying on lines. To the right of the lilac bush a low single-storey stone house, next to it a wooden shed. Further away a two-storey roofless building with a tall brick chimney and rafters. On the left, in front of an old-fashioned red house with a high roof, sheds and huts. Sunshine.
f3257f3f9c9c3ac9b061435c071f4599fabbeb80: A conveyor resembling a rowboat running diagonally across the picture into the distance, grey figures in pairs holding brushes instead of oars and painting rainbow-coloured painting panels. fe5dcdc12c1a52c3bbfd50683719d3cbe2ee29ba: A Tartu painter and pedagogue.
