From 1957-1992 he/she worked as a drawing teacher at the Tartu Art School, and thereafter, until retirement, also as a painting teacher. He/she began exhibiting at exhibitions from 1956.
5ea2e940a3db49becf358958abfd3d998299a28d: Fred Kotkas (1986) is a painter and illustrator who graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts, whose introspective work focuses on the inner world of the human being and the factors shaping it. His mode of expression is vivid and figurative, accompanied by a self-ironic attitude, which adds a certain playfulness to his works.
04a3a2f8de3ec55203c9c5068d20a4fa24386877: Taje Paldrok is a performance, installation and new media artist. She acquired her art education at Academia Non Grata, at the Kuvataideakatemia in Helsinki, at the Estonian Academy of Arts and at the Universität der Künste Berlin. She has been one of the main driving forces of the international Non Grata Performance Group since 1998.
a56ed810ded7911e80cbbc54c2b24f9ef3353688: The surface of the painting is divided into three parts, so that the narrow upper part with the depiction of the starry sky is separated by a horizontal line; to the left remains an intense blue uniform surface, on the right a bed in which lies a figure covered with folded cloth. On the white sheet lies a blue hand, which stands out even more due to the adjacent orange tone.
659051f2c55d11fa0274974766eb1761156b4aa0: A young woman sitting on a chair with her hands in her lap, in half-profile to the left. Hairstyle with two curled rolls above the ear, parted on both sides from the middle (?). Wearing a dark dress reaching to the ground, the bodice part of which ends in a point at the front. On the dress a white collar reaching halfway to the chest and covering the shoulders, over which a narrower double gathered collar.
dafbaa45f92291c72a13a5fb8bd40a528bb87de1: A view of a studio corner seen from above: on a brown pedestal a plaster torso in profile against a raspberry-red drapery background. In front, on a stool covered with a yellow cloth, a potted flower with red blossoms. Upper left, a corner of a picture with a light blue frame is visible, lower right part of a stand with painting materials. A style attentive to objects, vivid pure tones.
4328fe819f7aefc2990c51b65dbc573539a09b0d: A view of the harbour from the sea. Directly at the quay and on the left smaller rowing boats, people on the harbour pier. On the right larger ships with tall masts. Beyond, one- and multi-storey houses. On the left, against a light blue sky background, two smoking chimneys, in the middle the silhouette of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). The painting in blue, grey and brown tones.
e7b318dda48b7206460f4d879eaab00f11d1e2b2: A shoreline landscape reflected on the surface of a lake, painted in large soft-toned patches of colour with broad brush strokes. The waterline on the horizontal axis of the composition. In the background, on the left and right, taller groves of trees, in the foreground flat land with solitary bushes. On the right at the waterline a small spit of land, on the shore a tall small grove of trees.
2b6abd25919fe0dbca0bf4edd3ed483820a0e3ab: In the middle ground a monument of large massive pinkish-grey horizontal and vertical blocks, on the left a bronze soldier with bowed head. Flowers on the monument. In the foreground a young woman walking in a white dress with puffed sleeves, a red carnation flower in her hand. In the background a greyish-green landscape and a dark sky.
9c71a173c0ecedd8c62955a747aa655d54769af7: In the foreground, in the middle of a grain field, a large red combine harvester harvesting grain, driving towards the viewer. A red flag on the roof of the combine, a man standing on the driving platform. Above the horizontal centre line, a light blue sky with a fringe of clouds extending across it. The combine raspberry-red, the grain field brownish-yellow, painted very impasto.
66528a845fc7cb48e27ec79e3763f721632048eb: In the foreground on the left a bay, bordered on the right and behind by a low shore. In the bay a row of one- and two-masted sailing boats-galliots at anchor; most with sails lowered. On the right a two-masted galliot and boats pulled up onto the shore. In front of them two men by a small rowing boat. In the middle, on the open water, a solitary rower.
c47f1f1aed7695c46e31a151ff2461321504237b: In the middle a lake with a glowing water surface, turquoise-blue water near the shore. From the lake rise rocky blue mountains, alternating with valleys all the way to the horizon. In the foreground on the left and right the rocky surface of the cliffs is given in close view in grey and brown tones. Above, a sky with large yellowish-white clouds.
4260322f4a9f782ec5231c279ec19d7234fad9d6: In the foreground, a riverbank with stones and logs. There, on the right, a woman washing laundry. To her right sits a boy, in profile facing left. To their left, two ducks. By the shore, a horse with a water barrel. On the right, behind the rising sandy riverbank, a farmhouse with a chimney is visible. Boats can be seen on the river. Across the river, buildings are visible between the trees.
c20d88e996a91aa33cf3da9b5b551d901e60b1bb: The painting is divided into picture surfaces of different character, dominated by a chestnut-brown colour field. In the upper left and right corners a grey and white surface, on the right a few spruce tops. The middle section is crossed by a white-brown-white tricolour with abstract black and brown elements and a miniature figure on a white surface.
aa31d188492ed43719d0ae5f4885e6a76b2ca025: A face portrait of a sailor in yellowish-orange tones. Painted boldly in a laconic manner, emphasising mainly the black-toned silhouette and contour. The right half of the sailor's face is painted light blue. On the chest, under the sailor's blouse, three blue stripes of a sailor's shirt are visible. The sitter is wearing a sailor's cap.
56a6bbf6f6bf0f54daba06688ed2ffb372388497: He received his general education at the Tartu Boys' Gymnasium. In 1937 he entered the Pallas art school, where he studied in Villem Ormisson's painting class. Having spent a year in the army in between, he continued his studies in 1940 in Aleksander Vardi's studio. In 1941–1942 he was at the front, and continued his studies in 1943 until the closure of the Pallas art school.
2751cbe93752a73a41be2202719d7085db05bff5: Cloe Jancis (b. 25.03.1992) is a conceptual artist living in Tallinn, working mainly in the media of photography, video and installation. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts with a degree in photography (BA, 2018) and is currently studying in the Contemporary Art master's programme at the Faculty of Fine Arts of the Estonian Academy of Arts.
6eaa6b7a3e38567917372db7e48a7b194538843d: On an invisible seat sits a young woman in a dark skirt and pink blouse. White, shoeless feet are visible beneath the skirt. The woman's hair is dark, her face in profile, with a strong bird-beak-like nose. Her left arm is bent at the elbow, her chin resting on her hand, her right hand resting on the arm of the left. The background is dark wine-red.
100cca2558e7b4b349498111ed9fc95470062539: A corner of an interior with pale yellow walls and a rust-brown floor. In the upper part, against the wall, a black board with orange freehand lines hanging on a blue pipe. In front, a dark brown table with an open drawer, on which stands a green stand with a thin striped shaft and a blue triangular flag. On both sides on the floor, curved pipe-like shapes.
025fc0ecae7b9da1efd5efff189b207d0958e660: A painting in an overall raspberry-red tone, covered with relief crumb. Two vertical strips of film paper and three horizontal strips are attached to the surface, which in turn are covered in a glowing red tone. In the lower left quarter, four horizontal wire strips and a copper clock mechanism are attached to the surface, from which an orange-toned hand shape emerges.
fff6b519b217e97efaae34f7cfa8c1ec0d561bdb: A life-size portrait of a small 7–8-year-old girl in a sitting position. Dark background. The girl has brown, short-cropped hair, wearing a pink dress. Bare brownish arms and lower legs. She sits on a seat covered with patterned fabric, placing one leg crossed over the other knee. One hand placed on the knee, the other on the seat.
25a45652df7c359bfab15d9bf838886165537317: In front, on a strip of grass, figures of women dancing in a circle in the middle. To their left, a man sitting on a stump playing a kannel, in front of him a half-naked man with an arrowhead. Behind him three half-naked men with bows. To the right of the dancers, two men with spears, three with bows, and a maiden in folk costume. Beside her, a male figure with an arm around the maiden's waist.
c61f4a88c0ad5aea9c00ed6a4961a5d32e0d85e2: In front, a row of blooming tulips. A path leading diagonally from the left corner to the right, with individual green shrubby plants at its edges. To the left and right of the path, a flower bed. Behind, on the right, a small building painted light blue with individual large trees, on the left a green low wooden building. In the middle at the back, a yellow building. Purple sky.
6f9724b71786c39f41abbe238bb0e3eb7427169e: Against a bluish background, a young female nude sits in an armchair covered with white drapery, in a three-quarter turn to the left. The woman has a round face, short dark hair, her gaze directed straight ahead. Her hands rest on the armrest of the chair, the left leg slightly ahead of the other. The figure is modelled with light and shadow, painted in places with broad palette-knife strokes.
f721b99317c6001c8a81197b500116bde375b26b: A profile portrait of a younger man; satiny hair combed back, its line receding in an arch at the forehead, a straight nose, a tuft of beard on the chin matching the hair colour. Wearing a dark coat, with a green scarf or tie at the neck. The background is cut diagonally by a border between two tones: bluish-grey above, greenish-blue below.
f2af0d3cd3c4cab8ad73ae0c78730e262f0e9268: A sunny farmyard: in the foreground on the left a well with a sweep, on the right a pole fence and the end of a barn. Behind, a stout log farmhouse with a thatched roof, flanked by large green trees. On the horizon on the right, between two buildings, a small piece of a lake can be seen. Above, a blue sky covered with white cloud heaps.
1239d0798782d01dac67ad7b3eff4dc2e5c4ce9d: Three men against the background of a summer landscape. The middle one wears a short yellow coat and a cap of the same colour. On the right, a man embraces him by the shoulders, wearing a short sword at his belt. On the left, a young man standing sideways to the viewer, holding the middle man's left hand; his head slightly lowered. All of them have animal skins over their right shoulder.
beddb501acb9077c4bfd0cf3894f1aec17e3f004: A portrait head of an older man in frontal view, thick long hair combed over the head, partly covering the ears at the sides. The head rests on a plane formed by individual longer strands of beard and hair, the neck not visible; narrowed eyes, bags under the eyes, strong low eyebrows, drooping moustache surrounding the mouth, a longer narrow beard.
9f5d193a7d1a9e654b69ba55bb882306e4459e5d: Hillar Ehaste (b. 1954, Võru) is an Estonian artist working in Tartu, who took up painting in mature age after a long career as a mining engineer. He graduated from the Tallinn Polytechnic Institute in 1977 and improved his skills in painting at the Tartu People's University and at the SUVI art studio under the guidance of Robert Suvi.
f10455217eee444d30f7945bdfcacbf4c5642f21: In the foreground on the left, on a higher bank, light green deciduous tree crowns, pines with dark slender trunks. On the right, behind lower trees, bluish-pink water is visible and, on the horizon, a dark strip of the opposite bank. The sky is pale pink, blue, and green. Painted vigorously, generalising the forms. The painting is textured in the area of the trees.
4548bcb2ef7e56f3300b727e25573c4772b32477: The head of an older man in half-turn to the left, gaze directed at the viewer, the top of the head bare, hair at the sides, the nose with a small bump, cheeks slightly hollow, the corners of the mouth curving downward, a red scarf at the neck. A brush in the right hand. In the background on the left a dark cabinet with glass doors and two paintings, on the right the background is light blue and grey.
b5fcbd1682e8c96b49961fba9d657d316ab1ce75: In the foreground on a pink table, a document with an upturned edge, under which a blue pencil. On the left, a brown men's wallet with a red edge, containing documents. Partly under the latter, another document. In the centre against a blue background, a metal construction with a yellow gleam. The room is dark, the whole composition is lit by light coming from the left.
1bf9b8930e279705efaa10432ee641d169711724: In the middle of the picture, a pile of building constructions dividing it in two. To its right and left, faintly white-marked outlines of cranes. On the horizon, against a poison-green ground, in the right corner the silhouette of a new city district, on the left a piece of an industrial landscape with a chimney emitting sulphurous smoke. At the top edge, a dark blue sky.
8c9e2d20d468e67498ea05e596e870439791039e: In the foreground, stony ground with a few small juniper bushes, behind on a slope a church with a red roof and no tower spire, surrounded by trees and bushes, on the left the roof of an old farmhouse is visible. In the blue sky, which takes up 2/3 of the painting's surface, light bright cloud wisps. Light in colour scheme. Gilded frame.
fdcf4e4717c38782947f6763752d28cf3a486561: A view from above of a brown table and the objects on it: in the middle an oblong basket filled with red apples, pears and yellowish plums, and a veneer cylindrical small case, lid open, full of blue plums (on a cloth). In the foreground two sharp knives and two large pears. The background is dark, bluish-grey in the upper part.
98ae3d754f11eeee795640b79a77487b65caefa7: A half-figure of a seated young man with longer hair and a narrow face, in a half-turn to the left, right hand on the knee, a cigarette in the bent left hand. Wearing a blue shirt, a dark jacket, sand-brown trousers. Behind on the left part of a window, in front of it a greenish table corner with a dark green goblet. Vivid colour tones, sharply defined forms.
f879222bf28ecddf89b1e8d1bd07ba5aa80e2b89: A realistic early-spring landscape with a brook running into the depth of the picture in the foreground on the right. Unmelted snow on the banks of the brook, in the distance on the right two greyish farmhouses. On both banks of the brook, bare trees, the oaks still bearing last autumn's leaves. On the horizon on the left, a small oak grove and a strip of forest. Above, a clear blue spring sky.
e4264e2480798a30aecffe1b27b1ad85f17a68b4: On a background composed of colourful quadrangles, a blue bowl with fish, in front of which are fish. On the left, three large fish with heads pointing diagonally upward. In the centre, slightly higher than the fish, a white jug. In the flattened squares of the background, fish arranged vertically. Very impasto, in places relief-like, paint layer.
82fa13234974b5fd7dbcc275ce898911f3b9412a: Received art instruction from her mother B. Vomm and her brother A. E. Vomm. In 1944 went to Germany together with her mother, the painter Benita Vomm, and her brother Ants Erik Vomm. Her father, the sculptor August Vomm, remained in Estonia. Lived in Venezuela 1948-1953. Has lived in Toronto, Canada since 1953. Painter. Member of EKKT since 1960, chairman since 1992
eccd00199bfe8e6a6cd17706464ae59e4ba493fd: Born in the Harz, the so-called Saxon Switzerland, into a pastor's family, studied 1848-52 at the Dresden and 1852-56 at the Düsseldorf Art Academy. Lived in Vyborg 1855-56, then in Tallinn. Was a drawing teacher at the Tallinn Cathedral School 1872-77. Also worked as a painter, draughtsman, art critic, poet. Buried at Mõigu Cemetery
43595c98597e74e9b9ae774bb8567e199e361d07: Ludmilla studied at Tartu 2nd Secondary School and then at Tartu Art School. She graduated from ERKI in 1965 in painting. She then worked as an art teacher at Tallinn 46th Secondary School, influencing future painters, for example Ando Keskküla was her student. She was interested in spiritualist and mystical teachings.
5939878b6a574eb4fe5af0ac72bd47f8d14fc5fb: A geometric composition of three consecutively repeating motifs, consisting of vertical and horizontal black stripes reminiscent of a meander ornament, and quadrangular beige-brownish, red and blue surfaces; the latter are placed in the centre of the motif. Above and below the pattern, a whitish background.
d639459ed34f5c85c69ae3e3ca0823c9921b323f: At the bottom edge of the picture, a reclining woman, hands under her head, the lower part of her body up to the chest illuminated, the upper part in shadow. Beside her, a standing woman leaning on a balustrade, her upper body in shadow. Between the figures, a stand covered with blue cloth, on which is a white plate. In the lower right corner, a single leaf. The sky opening from the balcony is uniformly blue.
9ab2be45fae44dd5c2b750e69665a3521a72f7b3: A white, even background with a fine mourning frame and a black ribbon diagonally in the lower right corner. In the central section, a coffin with mourning decorations, in which lies the figure of a boy in braced trousers seen in profile, depicted in black and white. Above right, a yellow duckling in a red waistcoat, mourning. The finished design is rendered in a comic-like manner.
847760ad52674347de961364bf09b71ce0d9bb29: A composition of five figures: between one woman sitting with her cheek resting on her hand and another with her leg crossed over her knee, a male figure. On the right edge, a dark-haired woman in a yellowish-green dress, seen from behind, wearing a green shawl over her shoulders. Upper left the background is dark, lower right corner yellow. The seat is burgundy red.
d05be7f3266f1005590426f0382ed9e35c0f5ef9: Under a summery, bright pinkish-yellow sky, a rocky coastal landscape. In the foreground a sea-grassy shore area, on the left in the middle a massive erratic boulder half against the sky. Farther away another larger stone with a reflection in the water. Bright tones, bright blue reflections on the stones. The sea and land are divided at the horizon by a thin strip of forest.
687bb9083c03adb5506d39323688f968730603b2: A panoramic landscape, in the foreground a road (parallel to the lower edge of the picture), a green roadside with a single grazing black-and-white spotted cow and bushes. In the middle ground a stone wall, a light yellow grain field with a white, brown-roofed house in the centre. On the horizon a green strip of forest. The sky is green, with white and blue streaks.
7a5c4461022f34b7fdaed1f580340bf6f1142e91: A half-figure of a middle-aged woman sitting in an armchair, in three-quarter turn to the left, forehead exposed, fine facial features, short hair. Wearing a sleeveless black dress with a wide neckline, a clasp with a jewel on the left shoulder, around the arm, a greyish fur on the back of the chair. A naturalistic, realistic manner of depiction. Bluish-grey background.
092388b75c27ab63296f4ba408058f32376bbac0: A nude figure sitting on burgundy-red and blue-toned drapery; legs crossed, hands resting on the chair at the sides with palms down. The head with brown curly hair tilted slightly to the left, chin raised. The background is bluish-grey, with delicate ochre-coloured stripes. The nude figure is painted in yellow and lilac tones.
5534fb0ffe8c865b1d5038e7cf7692dabfe8ec74: A semi-reclining female nude figure: resting on the right hand, the left raised to grasp a branch, the left leg over the right. Below the figure, red and white drapery, behind it indicated foliage. Painted thinly with a fine brush, the left arm was originally in a different position, later slightly overpainted.
f7bb28a8708d980b7403d608fcad453b3e0c70a0: In the foreground a grain field with cut grain and sheaves, four people (two men and two women) binding grain into sheaves with rakes. In the background on the left a lake with bushes on its near shore, on the right rye stooks and a small wood. On the horizon a dark blue strip of forest, above a blue sky covered with white clouds.
4f2e471ec521312994a3e3ab076d8b3b1b39b909: A man and a woman stand side by side in frontal view, the man on the left, the woman on the right, the man's head turned in half-profile to the left, his right hand holding his chin, his left hand in his coat pocket, the woman's face in profile to the left, her right hand slightly bent in front on her stomach, her left hand behind her back, in the distance above right a single small human figure
1b426038a2c22b096f0dd35742ddaecb8e6626ec: Black geometric surfaces intersecting conventionally rendered motifs of doors, windows and interiors. On the left a suggested window view into a garden with the image of a bare tree. In the centre an upright, below right a uniformly black sloping surface. On the right images of glass doors, windows, and reflections in them. Yellowish ochre, bluish-grey mixed tones.
20b857d7064245f78915aa0aa87d38d918333799: A composition made up of almost abstractly rendered shapes: in the centre a man on horseback with a spear killing a blue dragon lying in the foreground. The background resembles a landscape, above a sky covered with small clouds. In poisonous blue-lilac-green tones, in the centre a horizontal bright red section of the background.
104212eec7e7c35f0c7087fb23142b6bd40cb413: A landscape composition built up in horizontals: in the foreground a strip of grass and an unsown field, above it farm buildings, trees and bushes painted with long, colourful, dotted brushstrokes. Above a light blue sky. Bright green and blue colour tones dominate, painted very impasto.
ef65606972a7e7fb051fc741006b2af86a442c84: A blue shape vertically splits the surface of the picture, which at the bottom grows over into a red section resembling the shoulder part of a mannequin. At the top of the blue shape it is bordered by a red, yellow and white stripe. To the right of the vertical centre line, a yellow face with one black eye and a tousled orange mop of hair. The background is dark grey.
141e94d0621b9e9e53aa9308794544b837591635: A brightly coloured (mainly blue-red) abstract composition, in the lower centre of which, in surfaces divided into quadrangles, various conventional shapes (hourglass, semicircle, paper collage, etc.) and a white seashell. The colourful surface is surrounded by intersecting arcs in blue tones, with isolated bright red shapes.
3cdac42b34ec29f382d0afe4b6a2298727b03c2b: Against the background of a snowy winter landscape with a bare tree, and growing out of it, a 7/8 figure of a young fair-haired woman with long hair, seen frontally, gaze to the right. The woman's body is covered by the image of a snowy garden with three birches, trees and small houses. The portrait part is painted realistically and colourfully against the background of a light blue sky with tufts of cloud.
c27fe3cb7110bfe3b06ac1c3d5a633b1de236cc0: Born on a farm in Lugaži (Luke) parish in Latvia, studied at Valga Town School and Penza Art School. Took part in the War of Independence. Worked as a drawing teacher 1920-25 in Tartu, 1925-29 in Tallinn. Was one of the founders of the Estonian Artists' Group in 1923. Made designs for War of Independence memorials, as a sculptor was a successful and talented autodidact.
77f2823a6f4653a98886949be7a18c55322c2413: book graphic artist, calligrapher and poster artist. Graduated in 1931 as an applied graphic artist from the State School of Applied Art. During World War II was in the Russian rear in Yaroslavl, was a member of the board of the ESSR Artists' Union 1945-1950, was one of the organisers and artistic director of the Art Products Combine, worked at the Estonian State Publishing House 1949-1954
e63238183be454a98024c579c766fcd05b86bd6f: Kertu-Liisa Sarap (2003) is a Tallinn-based artist whose practice moves along the borders of painting and leather art. In 2025 she graduated from EKA in painting and continues her studies in the master's programme in contemporary art. Sarap's work deals with layers of material memory and nostalgia through painting, leather and photo archives.
88d9b93c5b058a58d95b3cf035175ffcb85c9df0: Maria Generalova (b. 1991 in Tallinn) is a young painter who graduated in 2013 from the bachelor's programme in painting at the Estonian Academy of Arts. Her work is focused on figurative composition; her paintings reflect various socially topical global issues.
7db4f7c3620e26782ca39a6c2893fd1de4970491: In the centre, a round brown table covered with a sky-blue cloth, at its back edge a stack of books from which a yellow tape measure winds down. On the table to the left, a bright red notebook. To the left of the table, a cobalt-blue sofa, the wall white, in the upper right corner part of a painting is visible. Behind the table, a black picture frame leans against the wall.
dae1145739120a2ae264f764d7b4f1e928ab212c: On the right, a watermill with a grey roof, with a small river flowing beneath it. To the left of the mill, a road on which two brown horses with carts and men can be seen in the distance. In front of the mill door, a horse harnessed to a cart with sacks is standing. On the left, a pasture, in the distance a green forest, above a light blue sky with large whitish-grey clouds.
8af3ce704e17f9ac82a1bdbe9044f7b1bec01e0d: Against a dark brown background, along the lower edge of the painting with a narrow bright red stripe, a standing female nude depicted to the knees in a slight turn to the left, with a slight bend at the hip to the left. In front of the face, a wide white drapery reaching to the shoulders. The left arm straight, hand on the thigh, the right bent at the elbow above waist height, lightly holding the other forearm.
c1de10b67b37f3ab491db1ec2a95d82b656ca135: On a square table, objects bathed in light: in the foreground a greyish plate, behind it to the left a pink cup and a bowl filled with colourful fruit. Behind the cup, two dark blue bottles. Behind the arrangement, a window, windowsill and a lilac-pink curtain. Painted in places with small, brisk brushstrokes.
67dc5143b617121399153a5fe1cc9ae5b6a67e8c: The head and body of a young woman with fine but sharp facial features, in a half-turn to the right, while the gaze of her dark eyes is directed to the left. The woman has long dark hair, earrings with bluish-green stones, and a bluish-grey dress. The background in various shades of blue, painted in places with long, vigorous brushstrokes.
b3fc0697866da3d5e594188778a5db226954694a: In the foreground on the left, a young fair-haired girl in a white long-sleeved blouse and a dark skirt, with a stick in her hand, beside her bare deciduous trees. Further away, in a clearing bordered by yellowing trees, a herd is grazing. On the horizon a dark blue wall of forest. The sky autumnally overcast. The landscape in fading colour tones.
88a991a66699deb9570d9947020ff1dea44b33cc: In the foreground, a seabed in dark blue and grey tones, marked in relief below using mixed media. On the bottom, flowers with lilac and bluish blossoms, stems upright, painted very impasto. Above the flowers, sea water in various shades of blue. Above the sea, a whitish-blue, at the top considerably darkening, gloomy sky.
18f8fced358f1ef2fb61e054ca8da4a6a126af6e: In the foreground a light-coloured harbour quay and a heavy harbour crane, in front of it a brown wagon and a deep blue ship being unloaded. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn, to the right of the ship the Oleviste Church stands out especially. Above the city a sky rendered with brisk yellow and blue brushstrokes. Blue and brown tones dominate.
d69e2a16a4fb212417025fe9a69cd38aa295868b: A southern landscape with a strait running through the full width of the picture in the background. On the horizon a narrow coastal strip. In the middle ground on the left, a small grove of cypresses with three cypresses standing out from among them. In front of it, from the left edge of the picture field to the right golden section, a low whitewashed wall. In the background, solitary trees (on the right half of the picture field).
678bf3b3ecc9cec64e89887107548249709fc2d6: sculptor and educator; received his art education in 1911-12 in Munich at A. Azbe's art school; 1912-13 in Paris at the Academie Russe and the Academie de la Grande Chaumiere; in 1914 he was arrested and sent to southern Germany, was a prisoner of war; after returning to Estonia took part in founding the "Pallas" art school; People's Artist of the ESSR 1964
6b7a1106df5f4de1b75374c0dfdca0b3b53c2edb: A farm landscape painted with long brushstrokes forming distinct patches of colour: on the left two low farmhouses, on the right a low house and a stake fence. In the depth of the picture, in the middle, trees with large crowns. The composition of clearly distinguishable colour patches leaves an almost abstract overall impression, the objects are barely distinguishable.
e8fb795fcf6d5c927b724aeca83ed443fe07784b: The author has modelled the tongue of a slaughtered animal and cast 15 casts of it in soap, the casts are in various colour tones, visually resembling natural animal tongues. The installation includes an old aluminium bowl, in which, during exhibition, 1-2 tongues specially cast for the purpose soak.
f3e483f2250cc07c6c6b5041688c61f895006e5f: The figure of a standing man in frontal view, the weight of the body on the left leg, the right slightly forward, on his head a wide-brimmed headpiece, the head turned to the left in three-quarter profile, the mouth open, at chest height an oval string instrument, on the strings of which is the right hand, the left raised up to the right, on the man's shoulders a wide sleeveless garment falling to the knees.
36dc2b0ab689694c8fbe63389327491601d30072: A still life on a table covered with a red cloth against a dark background: a white teapot with a bluish sheen and two mugs, three glasses, five red apples, a copper plate, and an ultramarine blue drapery. Painted in relief, emphasising the materiality of the objects, with gleams and reflections. Red flat and glossy frame. Thick layer of varnish.
cf7e497a2078acba34a44413cebf1cefb18b5c34: In the centre a female nude with flowing hair in a slight turn to the left, right leg raised slightly at the knee, left arm raised up. Beside her on the left a female nude in a straight-on view, and on the right a female nude in a semi-reclining position in a slight turn to the left, arm straight at her side. Around them signs, lines and abstract shapes.
c4dd3e23d4de425e35a93f40ca0485dce2bc01f5: On a black background, in the upper half, on a red horizontal line, two posts with rounded ends, from the end of the right-hand one red lines radiate to both sides. In the lower half, the crossing projections of the posts. Upper left, in the corner, a bundle of white diagonal lines; on the right edge, below, three incomplete rectangles with white lines.
e172e39436d6877e0377457f73856a307d29f568: A summer, overcast view of a fork in park paths. On either side of the path, trees with pink blossoms in green boxes with knobbed corners. Further back on the left, a lawn bordered with flowers, trees and bushes. On the horizon on a slope, the silhouette of a castle. On the right, green tree crowns. The painting pastel-light, seen through a bluish haze.
1e6df421fd5a260b0c73b85badf21d0cb40a53c9: In a field by a lake, a crowd of people at harvest work. On the right a threshing machine, around it people bustling about, in the centre two women carrying a sheaf of straw on a pitchfork handle. On the left two men and a woman making a straw stack, further back a horse with a load of grain. Under a darkening evening sky, a forest-covered hill, reflected in the water.
2f536c3ecf3655b493a5ccb774c568fe13645c5f: In the foreground two male and two female figures. The angular drawing marking the individual elements of the figures is clearly visible. In the upper left corner a body of water, in the centre buildings, at the top of the picture on the horizon a mountainous landscape in green, blue and ochre tones. The whole composition articulated geometrically and covered with colour.
aab27bc8353c24449cb4151b0c0c0303d847259e: A summer view of a suburb. In the foreground on the right a road bordered by a churchyard. Behind the fence on the left, sheaves of rye, a well with a sweep, further back two thatched farm buildings, the gable end of a red house. Behind the buildings in the centre, against the backdrop of a cloudy sky, the red-helmeted church tower is visible. Lush brushwork, following forms with dark contours.
c71141d05d0a8bacefababf9311d7901cb55bfb8: Portrait of an old woman in half-profile to the left, in a dark brown dress with a white collar, with coarse black lace around the neck and at the shoulder of the sleeve. On her head a thin white pleated bonnet, revealing greyish hair parted in the middle at the front, a golden brooch fastened under the chin with a green ribbon. Dark green background.
aa60066c9d8c3c2cb699a4547f458d34d2c889b3: In the foreground a body of water, a shore, trees on both sides. On the right, up to the frame, a tall group of trees, on the left a lower group of trees, above which sky is also visible. In the centre of the picture, between the trees, a body of water, on the horizon a dark stripe and above 2/3 sky, the water and sky bluish. The trees, the shore - brown, beige, orange.
07777b10ba6ca2184edcda3377bfbee85312f676: In the centre, a double-leaf door open into a warehouse, to which a wooden plank walkway leads. Through the open door, fish barrels are visible and workers closing them. The plaster of the stone warehouse building has crumbled in places. To the right of the door, a bricked-up window opening. To the left of the door, empty fish crates, on the right empty barrels and crates. In front of the door, a platform made of planks.
442c535f58758b383bb001999fde079cecb1f44f: Holger Loodus has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in the specialty of heritage conservation and restoration, studied painting in the department of free arts, and furthered his studies at the Karlsruhe University of Arts and Design in the media art department. The recurring method of his work is the mystification of everyday experiences.
33486275ac844265bbcc1494e8dcb7623dfbe8a0: The half-figure of a middle-aged bald man, resting his cheek on his hand, leaning on a table with a red cover, in half-profile to the right. A burning cigarette in the right corner of his mouth, his gaze directed at the man sitting opposite him, of whom his left hand, his left side, and a diagonally lying newspaper sheet on the table are visible in a gesturing posture.
1ad658646b04464112d7d36c709ce50f10ac8751: Frontal three-quarter portrait of an older woman sitting on a chair. Her right hand rests on the chair back, her left hand is in her lap. A small shawl in a purplish tone on her shoulders. She wears a greenish-grey blouse and a brown skirt. The woman's head is slightly tilted to the right. Hair yellowish, eyes blue. Background in a bluish-grey colour scheme.
e25644a98f9a812d36cd7e6d98fd68fb9d87cbf0: In a black circle, geometric signs, some of which resemble Freemason symbols. At the bottom centre, a white rectangle with a protruding round tip (? a plumb line/level) and a triangle above which is a jagged line (? a bell). At the right centre an egg (? a mirror), at the left a triangle (? a set square) and an equilateral cross. White dots in the background.
6695e40b07987932375fdb714950746f494180f5: In the foreground on the left, a dark brown boat, against which a man repairing a net is leaning. The man wears a white shirt and a brown waistcoat, the left leg of his brown trousers is rolled up to the knee. On his head a brown hat, half-covering his face. In the background, the sea with a single small ship, a strip of forested land on the horizon. Above, a greyish-blue sky.
6acadb5d85b403704accce679de058de03e0ec5a: On a stool covered with white drapery, a female nude sitting to the left of the central axis, seen from behind, the lower body turned to the right. Slightly bent forward, hands resting on the stool in front. Left leg hanging, right leg resting on the floor. On an even light grey background, the model's darker shadow on the right. The painting is in whitish-grey, beige tones.
b109ee4d604af0e4600a365638db3d3388c4ec31: An autumn landscape in ochre - yellow tones, with occasional green patches. In the foreground, two cows grazing - a brown-and-white one and a black-and-white one. In front of the group of cows a white calf with a few dark patches. The sky covered with whitish clouds. Bright colouring. A pointillist painting technique used in the landscape section.
51fee6c7149eed6fa8441b6f46683203dc4a3bd5: Bust portrait of a young woman, head turned 1/4 to the right, short hair combed back in a higher hairstyle above the forehead; the woman's body in perceptible motion, cut below the prominent collarbones, the arms, which are directed forward, are cut off only slightly below the shoulder, the bust's cut is lively, uneven
fb00fd50ca4288211b770fc4b2f4c3c26f0f1292: A wide plank bridge built on posts leads from the shore to the river. In the middle of the bridge, iron rails. On both sides of the rails, piles of empty fish crates. To the right of the bridge a motorboat is tied with a rope, in which a man sits with an outstretched hand. At the end of the bridge two men with a barrel on its side and two boys fishing.
bb1d5c2e624057a0299b3f7413ae14f8ce35dab1: The artist was born in St. Petersburg. He came to Hiiumaa after the 1917 revolution, where he worked as the driver for the director of the Kärdla Cloth Factory; his father Nikolai (1873-1933) was a doctor on Hiiumaa. Around 1939 he moved to live on Saaremaa. He was arrested in 1945 in Kuressaare, the tribunal's decision of 19.06.1945 under paragraph 58-1a, 15+5 years.
d1ec3e7b1cff2ff7b20191bd81a9b259f2c5410e: Lappy Mary (Maria Lapteva) is an Estonian painter. She has graduated from the Estonian Academy of Arts in painting (MA, 2014). She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association and the Estonian Authors' Society, and in 2015-2017 she was the chairwoman of the board of the Estonian Painters' Association. She has participated in exhibitions since 2008.
b31315adbd9ce3eecd3bca171584dc4f7bf61adb: View of a side street: on the left a pink house with an open window, in the middle a street seemingly descending down a hill, on the right a single larger tree, a telephone pole and bushes. In the middle ground, corners of small houses, some people, a traffic sign. In the distance, a fragment of a new district with light-coloured houses. Above, a heavy greyish-blue sky.
55104e1a4909a85c6bb63454ff93b9afc70467db: On a predominantly yellowish-green background, painted in places with expressive bright-coloured strokes, in places with flowing streams of colour, two nude female figures in a colourful embrace, in each other's lap. Meek, absent-looking faces turned toward the viewer. Above the head on the right, a green colour patch, on the left one a blue colour patch.
191a1aed106893d74827a0de6c4c233f58b604b9: Left of the centre of the painting, a sphere lit from above with a reddish self-shadow on a milky bluish-grey background, on which in black an arrow marked "valgus" [light] points down to the sphere. The lower surface of the sphere is unevenly black, with an upward-pointing arrow and the white inscription "horisont" [horizon]. In the middle of the top and bottom edges, a rectangular stamp mark.
f4130a9d0f3f40367e65842f98422498d147b5aa: In the foreground, a stone wall running diagonally from the left corner to the right through a valley. Behind the wall, a city wall with round towers running diagonally from the right into the depth. Behind the wall, houses with tiled roofs and the tower of St. Olaf's Church (Oleviste). To the left of the city wall, a zigzag-shaped slope runs from the lower corner into the depth.
6bf5bab9f809fe72ccfa329eb893f8b06e131f07: Two people sitting on a low sofa; on the right an oriental man with a dark beard, legs crossed in front, left hand on a sable resting on his knees. Beside him on the left a young woman, in full profile, leaning against the man, hands in a gesturing pose. Background on the right drapery, on the left a view of a landscape through arcades.
816bf9e03afefc053262004b5b380f6c57fc82d6: Bust portrait of a young man with a small moustache, view to the right. On his shoulders a draped cloak fastened on the right shoulder, curly hair, a laurel wreath on his head. The bust stands on a round baluster-shaped bronze base. Belonging together with the work is a polished round column of red-veined granite on a grey granite plinth.
19e2a58e5ad4e49c31dc1432fef6ed6cc6bb1e6e: A winged putto sits on a human skull, under the skull books, the top one open, on which lie a goose feather and a fly, on the putto's right knee a worm; the skull is anatomically very precise, opens with a hinge, the interior designed as an inkpot stand. The putto's right hand holds a palm branch, in the left hand a snake and grape leaves.
127f7b25a186d5bc8bd5d855783b200146dadcdf: In the foreground a soldier on a horse. The soldier holds a submachine gun in his left hand. The horse's neck and head are turned toward the soldier, while the soldier in turn has his whole face and upper body turned directly toward the viewer. With his right hand he supports the horse's rear. The painting's background is colourful, upper left a red and, a little lower, a yellow patch of colour.
ad7933d0619c4a688d5a282fbd0b4c084fd90e74: In the middle and lower part, large open flowers with pink petals and yellow centres, with green stems and leaves. Above the bouquet two buds. Background patchily light blue. Above the bouquet two buds reach upward. Background patchily light blue. Signature lower right G. Mootse 1943.
83de997afda510fb94e61ee7e9debc8c7259b0db: H. Lukk studied art probably in 1912-1915 in Helsinki, at the school of the Finnish Art Society. He practised Art Nouveau and Neo-Impressionist art (influence of A. Finch). Voldemar Vaga called H. Lukk the only pure Neo-Impressionist in Estonian art. He participated in the survey exhibition of Estonian art in 1919, attracting attention.
38eda6b68383d6debefde9ec01424c8f7135c716: Saskia Järve earned a master's degree from the Estonian Academy of Arts and works mainly in the field of figurative painting. In her work Järve deals with everyday events and focuses on the complex psychology of human nature. She combines frames from personal life with elements of pop culture and folklore.
61ac64022bdcd32a35b192e1fcf5b4ee0bf7d475: From a higher viewpoint, a broad view of the landscape: in the foreground bushes, a fence with spreading trees along it, further back a river bend marked with white pastels, on whose banks small groves grow, at the top a grey-clouded sky. Compared to the replica M 2023, the tones are more subdued and the mood more melancholic.
666815acfd66091c32496319d7de5c3e1dba5aa3: In the middle, on a bed, lies a woman in a blue undergarment and a reddish-brown outer garment. Around her angels and saints are bowing. Behind the bed, in the centre, in a golden ray of light, the golden Christ, holding the small Mother of God on his hand. He is surrounded by four angels in a greyish-blue orb, above them a red swirl.
b187b663a8f237d77119623586b00aba3ed48a9f: In the foreground a yellowish-brown section of stairs, on whose small purple platform a pink being crouches, in each hand an object resembling a purple dumbbell. Behind it, stairs and toothed wall sections in various shades of blue. In the intensely blue sky in the upper right corner, three blue horn-like objects.
319f99ef82cee3d9b2db459d2059581dca7f9453: Bust portrait of a young woman in half-turn to the left, her gaze directed into an oval mirror in front of her. The woman wears a beret, semi-long curly hair on her back and on her right cheek, which she is adjusting with both hands. She wears a dress with an oval décolleté and short sleeves. Painted in red-brown and ochre tones.
e1eed26de2488fff32bf319e26a0d38fc304c7c4: On a metal frame shaped like a rectangular box sits a human figure in a coat with several buttons, from the widened lower part of the coat three rods hang down; on the sitter's nape a block with the inscription: # 83; under the rectangular box are the sitter's legs, which appear to have sunk through the plate, below, a bronze construction rests on a marble slab.
1ecf04c4fbffdc53a2a3512dbab42d1ae1f83fef: The basis of the installation is E. Ole's painting "Laud" (1924, M 6327), to whose image a hamburger has been added on the plate in the foreground during computer processing. The resulting slide has been reduced in size and attached to plexiglass with adhesive film. The light box contains 2 bulbs, the cord has no plug. (Liina Tiitsmaa 10.01.1997)
9aed6bba4ba9b4b6e77d7a22c4df33dcdc70961b: Painted in orangish, warm light tones, depicting a section of a street in Viljandi (near Tartu tn 20). In the middle of the painting a street, a car, driving direction towards the viewer. On the left side of the picture two old wooden houses. On the right side, across the picture surface, the side of a red brick house, in front of which are street lighting poles.
3d1c6c75360a9afe1336f9d8172e0abc3aa3e9ba: In the foreground a high riverbank. On the left in front bushes, next to them a dark, tilted birdhouse. Below the high bank, in the middle of the picture the river winds with a bend backwards. On the mountainous banks lower hills covered with forest, the higher peaks bare and rocky. Across the river a settlement with a church and closely placed houses.
11fcb5aa65360b9644e9433e8b289454b1e4897a: A still life depicting larger and smaller bottles of various shapes. Greenish, reddish, purplish and bluish tones and their transitional shades dominate. In total there are 5 larger and 5 smaller bottles in the picture. In the lower right corner of the painting is lightly written in pencil H... 82
8eb408c1349124ba9c564599e62b652d49e44858: Was initially a fashion-magazine illustrator and author of humorous illustrations. Also created anatomical drawings for an atlas of human and horse anatomy. Later practised lithography, etching and woodcut, as well as various techniques of watercolour and drypoint. He has created much applied graphic art, especially ex libris, but also portraits, nudes, interiors, etc.
650e6b5cf5b046c4e8be8e30e851c3660c945132: Maire Aarsalu is a painter and educator whose work focuses primarily on landscape and figure painting and on the exploration of colour as an experiential and perceptual medium. Her works are characterised by attentive observation, a calm rhythm and sensitive treatment of colour, in which the presence of nature and humans intertwine.
3d8d33f3ba85982ff54c5891f54b8afa5dbd15c9: Helle Lõhmus (b. 1962) is a painter living and working in Tartu, who also engages in drawing, graphic art and sculpture. She has completed a painting degree at the University of Tartu (BA, 2015) and an art and technology teacher's degree (MA, 2022). She is a member of the Estonian Artists' Association, the Estonian Painters' Association and NAS.
4be3566d02d62067effb0ad79d4c8342753f7969: 3/4 of the left part of the painting depicts a uniformly white surface with fine red horizontal stripes, which merges on the right with an implied starry sky. Against this background, upper right, the image of a silvery sputnik, at the bottom edge, on a sturdy tabletop a model of a farmhouse amid greenery and a poison-green table lamp with a triangular base.
be045f362ade24305ef846f4fe4e03da419c7c2b: In the middle, against a brown-yellow mottled abstract background, the head of an Indian covered with colourful tattoos. On the left, against a pink background, two discs covered with geometric shapes. In the lower right corner three pink discs covered with symbols, below the latter yellowish-grey and blue stripes and the word - DOORKEEPER
85ea53f18d675ff5fca6e19de0d74adfa28abe62: Oval composition. At the top centre a tower-like structure, with a clock between its two doors. On the arched doors the inscriptions: VÄLJAPÄÄS [EXIT] and SISSEPÄÄS [ENTRANCE]. According to the function of the door, a mass of people gathered in front of it is depicted in frontal or profile view. On either side of the structure containers, pipes, gearwheels with chains
c71758f7277313b124642b16dbd4b721c7077422: Against a background of white cumulus clouds and blue sky, in the foreground on the left, in front of a house under trees, a group of women in colourful clothes with the mother of the family at the head, towards her with outstretched right hand Kalev, behind him three men with chests and a jug, in the middle Kalev's steed with a man holding it, on the right under trees a row of horsemen with spears.
d7caaaba86329237cc4df7d5c1fd62ebc7e7d893: 3/4 figure of an ancient Estonian sitting on the shore /Kalevipoeg/, in side view facing left. The man bound hand and foot with a thick chain to a cliff. Head on chest, arms resting behind, legs stretched forward. Behind on the left, the half-figure of a naked woman bending over him, in a three-quarter turn to the right. Background a rocky sea coast.
3b4e1d44c9ab7316615496d8fbdb5b86cac6080a: Against the background of an open landscape, the half-figure of a young man in side view facing right, holding against his chest a backpack, out of which a bird with a curved beak is peeking. The man has longer hair combed back over the head, his smiling face turned towards the bird, wearing a rust-brown shirt. Realistically depicted, subdued beigish-brown tones.
7d67cff5abab1acb46f87b634e0d0658d0408555: Graduated in 1926 from the Viljandi Estonian Education Society Girls' Gymnasium. At the beginning of 1928 he entered the Higher Art School Pallas, where he studied painting initially in Nikolai Triik's studio, then in Ado Vabbe's studio. He graduated from the school in 1936 together with Johannes Võerahansu, Richard Sagrits, Karl Pärsimägi and Ellinor Aikas.
54ab398b4020b8844a4c3251545baaab8d6e4e8c: Born in Tartu. Studied in 1897-1898 at the drawing courses of the Tartu German Craftsmen's Society. In 1904 at Baron A. Stieglitz's School of Applied Art in Petersburg, in 1905-1906 at Ants Laikmaa's studio in Tallinn and in 1906 at J. Goldblatt's art courses in Petersburg. In 1906 he moved to Helsinki, in 1907 to Paris, where he continued his art studies.
c0d301b0bef082d9f88fc4248ec3f72a17d05413: In the middle a river bend, partly frozen, partly with open water. On the left bare trees, across the river a copse in pink and green tones, on the left on the horizon a bluish-green strip of forest. In the foreground on the right a hillock with yellow dead grass, exposed from under the snow. Dense clouds in the sky, on the left above a strip of light blue sky.
c681f7b3f3a952ca2c9eec6827f21f00d0c81802: An Art Nouveau-symbolist composition in vivid colours, in the foreground a zigzagging "water", in the middle at the edges greenish-brownish mountains or trees, with orangish-yellowish basket-shaped "branches", in the middle of the picture a Siuru bird in blue tones flying, above which a rainbow. Background a blue sky and a white mountain
43b69367362a4c87f9458a11b385d07e9d78586f: In the interior on the left, a piano, behind it, in profile facing left, a seated woman, fingers on the keys. In the middle, in frontal view, a man, gaze directed down to the right, to his left hand, which rests on the table, right hand on the back of a chair. Behind in the middle, in half-profile facing left down, a portrait of a person looking. On the upper right a tree-like plant.
2350655ac8293b904106ba366009927649ba9229: In a room with dark walls and a small window, in the foreground a nude female figure washing her dark hair. Around the woman's legs and hips a very light-coloured sheet, behind her back a white bowl. In the open doorway of the room stands, against the light, another female figure with a brown cloth around her legs. On the open door hang clothes and towels.
5a39f9e0ff8d1816667d2e7b590d99eafc331bbd: Two seven-storey building facades converging diagonally towards the centre with rows of windows, half-figures of people looking out of the windows, trees depicted on the walls between the windows. In the middle of the image seven rows of balconies, where laundry dries on lines. At the top centre, in a circle, a large letter "Ü", framed by ears of grain
cb09d1a7d863cb79f784f1b0a5cacbf8c26c9bfb: A clearly divided background: below, against a light blue background, an explosion centre with a glowing red core, black fragments scattered in a ray-like pattern, black handprints at the edges. On the upper, strontium-yellow surface a whitish disc. In the middle, mostly against a yellow background, a black crumpled vehicle.
d97e6209f8de44c47dfa3d88c124a76ec9fd84fd: In a room marked yellow below and grey above, four seated men: on the left in profile a man with yellow hair, legs stretched out, to his right in frontal view a man in a purple shirt, a man with a moustache (chin resting on hand), and finally a man in red outer clothing with a softly rendered face. A form-diffusing painting style.
f2c12abdc59a50ec8a9fe0d357e24a2412e2a798: A view of the part of old Tallinn near the sea, from high above: in the foreground Lai t., houses with red roofs, further back St. Olaf's Church. On the horizon the sea, harbour cranes on the right and a pale grey sky. Painted with sparse brushstrokes through which the underlying surface shines through, emphasising the contours of the objects.
80faf011fef47dc8f0fba687264a730de31ac950: A longitudinal view into the dim interior of a Gothic church. On the right three pillars, high vaults above. From two window niches on the left scant light falls. Straight ahead and on the right two bright windows are visible. Individual figures in the space. Greenish-grey, brown gamut, a style clearly modelling architectural details.
96d96036361e5bbf6567d67d3b9d4b80f7074f54: A sea coast with gently sloping banks, covered with flat boulders and grass. On the left slope, autumnally colourful and half-bare deciduous trees in the wind. On the right, below near the shore, a low farmhouse with a thatched roof. The sky entirely filled with fluffy cumulus clouds. A painting with clearly defined forms, often surrounded by dark contours.
cd0c23a693a37bb896ed5f5d568c94d282d3d1a4: A still life with very pastose, almost relief-like objects: in the centre a glowing brown vase of a squat form with large red poppies and white lilies. In the foreground three orange-coloured fruits. The background in warm brown tones. All the fruits and flowers are painted as if glowing from within.
8587c1a4c537972d986a4fa426d09d39ed580279: In the centre, in a thick glass vase tapering conically upward, a large bunch of branches with colourful autumn leaves, some with clusters of black chokeberries. Behind the vase on the left a beige ceramic bowl, with a chokeberry branch hanging over its rim. In the foreground on the right some red leaves fallen onto the table. The background greyish-green.
d38fd199299d4ad7a8ed7fd0c0d193726cc59b9d: Three-quarter figure of a woman seated in a pinkish-purplish dress, in a slight turn to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead; left hand raised to the neckline of the dress. Background in bluish, greenish tones. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes that partly dissolve the contours of the figure, blending them into the background.
0a7f8c646846f98bcbb62c3d4009214b2c50fa7d: A view painted in a naivistic-realistic manner through an open door into a yard enclosed by a fence. In bright sunshine a brown-haired girl in a blue dress plays hopscotch. The girl is seen in profile, standing on one leg, while bending forward to grab a small stone. Behind the girl laundry hangs drying on a line.
fde782748c5d23dbd634fc5cea0a8fb63992ba13: A black-and-white studio photograph, a multiple photographic image with two male figures in dark clothing (on the left, standing and reclining, Jaak Kadarik; on the right, standing and stepping, Peeter Laurits). On the left a marked tripod leg, on the right a faint image of a camera standing on a tripod, in front on the floor a black hat, with white paper as background.
1d27dcd4232b5a5cd2eca83cd863aebdd31bad54: Laureate of the All-Union competition of the newspaper "Izvestia", bronze and gold medal of the All-Union Exhibition of Achievements of the National Economy, diploma of the Latvian SSR 1st degree for the high artistic design of cotton fabrics at the exhibition of the Baltic republics, participated in republican, all-union and international exhibitions.
e8bcb1d2b738add70a43c2d4f24d5297c3e5fb30: A relief-like landscape based on mixed technique, in a diffuse, greenish-brown colour scheme. ab5fbf029d02aa2c079e2584134569827df664d7: Standing nude figure of a young woman, resting on her left leg, right leg bent at the knee, right arm raised and bent over her head holding a globeflower, left arm lowered to the side holding an extinguished torch, beneath the torch an ancient Roman-style empty urn. f8deb0ca2f91552bda5ed5c61a607b5216677241: Bust portrait of a round-faced girl with large bluish-grey eyes, in a slight turn to the left. Satin-like hair tied behind the neck. Painted in muted brown-beige tones with occasional bright reddish-green patches.
9511dbb458c4d7d6b1255f6f6f11a8628227db28: In the foreground (a winter landscape) on the left an exploding shell and a soldier with a rifle in his right hand. c3c49a255f2ca62aa5e61608f8326f4d12c871be: On the left a stormy sea. On the right a rocky shore rising in tiers, with a patch of forest on the lower plateau. 503319e3d007d0e7d1dfacc6fdcb1decc78989a4: A landscape depicted as wavy hillocks, alternating reddish-brown fields with bright green domes. In the centre of the foreground two stylised pines and a small spruce. Above the horizon a strip of pale sky. Decorative brushwork following the wavy form.
ddc2a1b7022d65d3572b88ce4e151c8aa73f1086: Semi-abstract composition with four figures seated in a car. The figures are deformed in a surrealist style suggesting organic life. 589647ef4fcf212ff4b08476e49f8e4a3b24b434: A vividly modelled full figure of a young man with a rough surface, arms hacked off, head lowered, legs cut off above the knees. A bronze triangle covering the genitals was later welded onto the sculpture in the 1980s. Dark patina

89bda457e2c8ba42c145c2eba54d08e502c17a28: Vladimir Baciu (b. 1965 in Gilicenis, Moldova) graduated as a painter-pedagogue from the I. Repin Art School in Kishinev (1984). 6d71254665a2205a3e2ae2cb9627dbea942ae57e: Kerstin Rei (1981) graduated in sculpture from the Tartu Art College. During her studies she continued her education at the University of Ioannina, Greece. 3ca0483e0caa8d8716d55e966a5b964c831d51d4: In the centre a bay of a lake, surrounded by lush trees and bushes in greenish-grey, blue and pink tones. Beyond the lake a bright green meadow, on the horizon a dark blue strip of forest. Above, a blue sky, white and pinkish near the horizon.
af557da42ba5e304a9789c0be5aa5622d02b5290: A metaphysical landscape composed of geometric bodies in grey and blue tones. In the background a blue sky darkening upwards. 3791e06767d94ac335f124ad6ea32d70b659f565: In the centre of the sheet an abstract motif consisting of yellow, red and black areas with jagged outlines, onto which are glued three light blue elements of abstract shape cut out of paper. On the left and right, in the middle, horizontal lines

ebc3df4a2afb0779d34e3a5bda23a07135998d08: On a blackish-brown background a half-figure of a woman - a blue blouse with a wide neckline and short sleeves, light short hair, a serious and distant expression. 1a5982c9e00af264b9c4dde3a6aa357833ce9293: Gottlieb Welté was born in the late 1740s in the Mainz/Frankfurt region of Germany, arrived in Estonia in 1782, where he worked at Põltsamaa Castle, in Tallinn, at Lohu Manor and elsewhere. 189cbcc5cb913d35303838b0d8f30f1047d5e4d8: Sitting three-quarter figure of a dark-haired, dark-eyed middle-aged woman shown frontally against a background of striped drapery. Wearing a green jacket and a light-coloured skirt, left hand in her lap, right hand resting on a blue support. In the left corner of the background a pale yellow strip.
b6f09fae440e7117bf1268ef3a18c7820998d3ad: In the foreground a farm garden in a sea of blossoms with apple trees. Grass-covered ground beneath the trees, bordered by a fence of slatted boards with gaps. Behind the fence a small brick-red house with a white roof, on the right further back a similar shed. Above the trees a bright blue cloudless sky.
f1506f8cdb4e419cb69375c27bd8cbb210499176: Wide panoramic landscape with a bright blue lake in the centre. Solitary trees on the lakeshore, the banks rising into a hilly area. Further away above, patches of forest and a grey strip of sky. Painted pastosely, in places with a palette knife and the brush handle. Yellowish-green colour range.
a01d24515b8ac6cdebf7f5a175cd7693c7c639c1: View painted in bright tones of low sheds and the gable roofs of houses behind them. On the left, between the houses, the bare crown of a tree, on the right, against the sky, two trees. Painted in reddish, orange tones with dark contours.
25c2f93b2017f74cabe966816b7c5d1c84147987: Autumn park view. In the foreground in the centre a path curving to the right and disappearing behind tree trunks. To the left and right of the path, straight-trunked trees reaching to the top edge of the painting, thinning out in the distance. Further along the path a female figure in red clothing and a male figure.
d10183141fe4f879ba731e7c857bb1c133af504f: Against a background of houses, on an open square, a monument. Behind, on the right, a river with a sailboat. A group of people on the square. Text on the monument: AN. MDCCCXII MEMORABLE PAR LA CAMPAGE CONTRE LES RUSSES. VUETAPPROUVÉ BAD NOUS COMMAND RUSSE DE COBLENCE LE I: JANUIER 1814
9d3997a7acb0b08d719342109ddfb74caa1a4876: The left half and right quarter of the painting depict predominantly bluish, greyish, greenish, beige, evenly painted geometric surfaces and lines. Between them an interior motif with a view of a sink, a door, a window, and a cylindrical light-coloured lamp above.
1235daf61325561c370a1513fb6626499d3c52f6: Three-quarter figure of a man standing in the foreground, leaning on the back of a chair. In his right hand a pipe, his left hand resting on the chair frame. On the left a table with papers and printer's type-cases. In the background on the left, in shadow, the figure of a standing man in a brown smock, his back to the viewer.
bcfc7ff300a8116baccf5227980978c38f153c44: In the centre foreground a bridge over a stream with a man and a dog, behind on a hillock a water mill; beside it on the left a mill dam. In front of the door in the gable wall of the building one standing and a couple of sitting figures; a dog and chickens. Behind, forest, in front on the right a large tree with a gnarled trunk.
49e4461d1305a007efc317636f81cf2d8a776950: Panoramic landscape with yellow grain fields and farmhouses among them. On the horizon a dark strip of forest, above the midline a tall sky with lush white clouds. The grain field in the foreground in particular, and the clouds in the sky, painted very pastosely.
a7983840ee50e77e7814429493e19a3cf4977dba: In the foreground a group of small old wooden huts. Behind the huts on the left the brown roof of a larger house with a chimney. In the background on the right a green meadow and part of a body of water. On the horizon low forested elevations. Sky in bluish-yellowish tones.
b5f08f044cde468ba2e6c6018067115b22459443: In the foreground three pigs and two piglets lying on straw in a pen. Behind the pig pen the wall of a shed with a small window is visible. Part of the pen and the shed wall in shadow, part in bright sunlight. The straw in particular painted pastosely. Greyish-brown colouring.
c1d15dd45c5b0927c833a15260e4e0d5f588b3d9: In the foreground a bright blue sea surface, further away harbour buildings, boats and cranes reflected in the water. At the top edge a blue, expressively painted sky with white clouds. In places the paint surface is pastose, predominantly in blue, brown and white tones.
ba7aa45799b70e401eec9f38e4309e056daea51b: On either side of a vertical greyish architectonic shape, greenhouse-like frameworks from which a multitude of fantastical plant motifs emerge. In the predominantly blackish colour range, red tones glow along with a few bright yellow and green patches.
bd805820d70cabb61c49e79c6d9db3cb8505ae9a: In the foreground, one white, one black and two brown horses harnessed to carts. Behind the horses, suburban houses rendered with sketch-like generalisation. Green, grey and brown tones. Painted with a broad brush, in places letting the canvas show through.
e73125050aae603b6a99912b752575dba0785b0f: The painted surface is covered with geometric, mutually converging forms on a greenish-brown background. Contrast is added by the lightly rendered parts of the forms. In the middle, a roundish, face-like image with distinguishable eyes, a green nose and mouth.
d40189dc2bce43ccae040c37b5066c81d9d75c66: Portrait of a man in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man has light brown hair, brown eyes and a brown jacket; a thick black stripe or rectangle runs from near his right eye. Around him are coloured patches and splashes of paint, in the background on the right a blurred depiction of a car.
1f7259573dec50bbbb28dcc664be1520e50eca87: Composition with four figures and a mine cart. Moving from left to right, three male workers in miners' caps and work clothes, the middle one emptying a shovel into the cart, the outer ones loading the cart, a fourth figure supports the cart while turning to the left.
b06ea3fe65b5b843a28a19960188ef4d7cb31398: Summer landscape with a lake. On the right, on a bridge by the water, a man in a brownish suit sits on a bench with a backrest, his face turned away and his head lowered. Most of the picture surface is filled with the expanse of water. In the background, sandy, wooded shores. A small steamer passing by.
3fd404bdce5cae3b5928fc52193153bc80ebb2bf: A spring valley with a bluish winding brook at the bottom of the valley. To the left of the brook a small patch of forest, on the right, on a bank rising toward the hill, small fields of varying colours. In the middle, further back, farm buildings, behind them a denser group of trees. On the horizon a dark strip of forest.
8b675e5f722778124e14b314cb6a169874a1e80c: The paper on which the drawing is made has been rolled and mounted on cardboard. The picture depicts a view of the café-restaurant "Rannapaargu" from the park side. Signature (Adamson Jaak) lower right. The work was presumably made in early spring 1972.
eaf77562141862bf9cc18904c702495304f8a1d6: View of a café. In the middle a doorway, to the right of which, under a window, sit two men. To the left of the door a white cabinet with glasses and a long, low counter. At the end of the latter stands a waiter in a light shirt, with a white apron in front. Impressionistic painting style.
763cd25043bc81c64ad75b2673c95dc15902d71f: In an undefined interior, in the foreground, in the middle, the figure of a woman composed of stylised angular planes, seen frontally, in her right hand a tray with a carafe and a glass. On the right a chair with a backrest, on the left a male figure sitting at a table, in profile to the right.
7251674ff0ad35fd1d49ac0790f3b19d6d4abf3e: In the foreground a river, under bare trees on the bank four boats drawn up. Behind them houses with gable roofs. Against a light, bluish-green sky, treetops, on the left a smoking chimney. The painting is in bluish-green, reddish colouring with dark contour lines.
6286660c76c3a23c33213a0f35fca6bb718c6775: In the middle, among reddish-brown hillocks, a group of blackish-grey construction posts. Behind, on the horizon, the wall of panel houses of a new district, in front of it fluttering laundry, on the right a broken pram. Behind on the left, against a blackening sky, light-coloured construction posts.
6d603ca4e8aa26fc44b9f817132285c180c7c95d: In a brownish oval, in the foreground one seated male and one female figure. Behind them in the middle two standing male figures and one female figure. Lower right corner a teapot and cups, on the left a bowl with fruit. Above, a white drapery and multicoloured flowers.
d319bec11dc07b4e46ccb0c73f4158a01e2f0fc0: A colourful autumn landscape with a body of water under a cloudy sky. In the front, in the middle, a grassy bank between a river bend. Behind, on a higher, sun-lit bank, solitary yellow birches. Between the trees, corners of buildings are visible. Realistic manner of depiction.
6e1ffd94f9f3f56b6616791cc4f982dcdc1577cc: A composition obtained by combining geometric shapes and lines, using cold blue and green tones, grey, yellow and ochre. On the horizon a strong dark blue accent emphasising height and distance, at the bottom in the foreground a patch of lake water.
082cab3adf1702f7af0e52d8d088421b183f9995: Bust portrait of a dark-haired boyish young man, leaning on his right elbow with his cheek resting on his hand. On his head a wide, low hat, wearing a dark coat with metal buttons and a white shirt with a red neckerchief. On the left edge a vine garland. The image is in an oval.
582967c65f98eabe2ab467fdc08414eff14496cd: In the foreground, a water surface painted transparent and mirror-smooth. Behind on the right stand fishing boats, and slightly ahead of them a white yacht without sails. On the left three factory chimneys rise. Sketch-like handling, in places using broad brushstrokes.
b9a5cd2332463017ea53e655642fb06a6acbe63d: In the foreground a courtyard with crossing stone-paved paths. In the middle ground an old castle building with a staircase, an archway and a roof of red brick. The sunlit part and the shaded side are sharply emphasised. From the upper edge a narrow strip of sky is visible.
fcf241a7bb29c5f2ec0e852bfbd6170f47da5db0: Two young women sit at a table, half-length, one en face, the other in profile and cut off by the left edge of the picture. 37a6a0212e685307a6dd6082bed2df1fc48f5ac7: In front, on a path descending with a slight turn from left to right into a valley, the figure of a man with a backpack and a stick (en face); on the right, on the crest of a hillock, a group of trees. Further away a valley and steep rocky ridges. At the foot of the mountains a belt of deciduous trees, with two low buildings on the left.
bd58b0480c7c2cd246e27f38e134d71ceaf9b580: The yellow background of the canvas is painted in a checkered pattern with regular broad paired brush-bristle strokes crosswise in white, so that three yellow parallel vertical stripes remain visible. Around the edges of the painting a regular row of painted nails.
95f68d102975418e70cbbae4040bb012cefd29df: A rectangular high relief, two nude figures, backs toward the viewer; of the figure in the upper left corner only the inverted upper body and head are modelled, with the arms forming a rectangle around the head; the figure on the right sits on its knees, in profile to the right.
fac0e41634b13bb8d15a8a2b9cd406dc3d4f7967: Portrait bust of a middle-aged man, a stooping man in civilian clothing, hair combed back over the head, bare temples, suit lapels, a waistcoat with lapels, a cross tie, small eyes with Mongolian folds, a shorter nose. Academic portrait bust on a baluster.
7ea7ba9982d65ae81a67715d50ee4128be482bce: Portrait bust executed with modernist generalisation, hair combed back over the head, lapels, tie, shirt collar. From the middle of the lapels begins a more rustic, unworked part of the bust. The base narrows toward the middle, with a straight-cut unworked part below.
412f900c2a593a2375c004aa789ea2880a287872: Seated male nude, seen frontally. The left arm stretched straight out to the side, the right diagonally down, with fingers resting on the base surface. The head slightly turned to the left. The left leg bent at the knee and upright, the right bent horizontally. White background.
b5b656566f024671467a5a4d84276728550fbe30: Vello Vinn / [compiled by: Elnara Taidre ; texts by: Andreas Trossek, Elnara Taidre ; translated into English by: Kadi Sutter ; photographs of works: Stanislav Stepaško]. – Tallinn : Art Museum of Estonia : Kumu, 2020. – 222 pp. : ill., portr.
8732c4a7b90e8f3bb7765df15e7359883d9bfd29: On the table in the centre a glass fruit vase (on a stem), inside which are placed, one within another, a plate, a tin bowl and three cups. ca6a4331b3fd99093c529c18f21ef3c6b4f698ca: In the foreground a table. On it an open book. The background is a drapery of a mottled and blue cloth.
f19787d4cd5751483a6c7068e3079417e393552f: A street in night light, with long shadows. On the left an ochre-coloured house and a fence, further on greyish-green houses. On the right the corner of a brown house. On the right side of the street a row of dark green deciduous trees, on the left a solitary electricity pole. The sky deep blue.
66064279595bbd7f01efa9b7a4d525492f8add3a: In the foreground, seen from behind, the half-figure of a person carrying a backpack, arms raised to shoulder height. The body slightly tilted to the left. In the background, against a landscape, 2 human figures. One of them with a large backpack. Dominant muted green tone.
0bf9387dbe329bcf142895b6fc35ed1ba6f7fecd: Across a slope a sandy road leading to the sea, on the right side of it two stunted pines against the sky, on the left one tree. In the sky the moon. On the horizon a strip of sea. Greyish, moss-green colouring. A vigorous, form-giving brushstroke, in places a very pastose painting.
0f99b4ed6671c6083d917a5e8601d10c640f8eea: A picture on a white background. A witch in folk costume, on her head a bonnet - white in the middle, with a red band around it, striped ribbons behind. Belt and skirt in red, brown tones. A striped shirt. The witch's hands rest on a curved grey stick, a pipe in her mouth.
63421d40dfec5fe9b594c0d5806c01f7fe6ff810: 2/3 of the picture's surface is taken up, along the lower edge, by a green-brown coastal strip and a grey, mirror-smooth sea surface darkening near the horizon. 0719adcc43fd2828d6ef12b7c4a6c8f563d9da11: A composition consisting of large, vividly coloured patches of colour: on the left in profile a young man's head, the nose line curved, mouth open. In the lower right corner, seen head-on, a young man, right hand raised to the ear, wearing a blue-and-white striped sports shirt.
dfbf95fbef0749e5c5543b8efaa98f7dcc879915: A 3/4 figure of a standing young woman with a blue coat and a wide-brimmed hat, hands in pockets, gaze cast over the left shoulder.
