Background white, tones: grey, blue, yellow, red, pink.
9fa32d208bd64036c98df91919c9ac91e951c79d: Carl Sigismund Walther was the first practitioner of lithography in Estonia, and "Christ's Head in the Crown of Thorns" after Guido Reni, from 1818, is the first lithograph printed in Estonia. Only two copies are known: the present one, which once belonged to the collection of Walther's granddaughter Lilly Walther, and one held by the Tartu University Library.

A small child leaning against her breast - seen frontally, face turned towards the viewer. Tones greenish (clothing, hair), pink (flesh), greyish-blue (background), purplish (the pedestal on the left, against which the woman leans).
17eb12dad17245b2ed548dfbd7212990a75b3009: A view of the city spanning two sheets. In the foreground the ridge of Harju Hill, where there are tables and benches for strollers. On the left a refreshment pavilion, on the right the towers of St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) and other Tallinn churches. In the centre Kiek in de Kök, in the distance the buildings of Toompea can be seen. The sheet is surrounded by a single decorative frame.
b5a479cb7ac48421facd5c7ce99a2b95382b015a: A large female nude sitting on the ground, in half-profile facing left, legs bent at the knees, the head with long hair tilted slightly back, in half-profile facing right. The left arm supports her straight against the ground, with the right she embraces a small male figure sitting in front of her on the ground, his head lowered onto his drawn-up knees, between his arms
8f3a375d21a3feea17c17420b02841e5f240249e:
a) In the centre the bust portrait of a man seen frontally, on the left three sketchy men as half-figures seen frontally. Above, in a row, four men's faces, on the right below them two faces in profile facing right.
b) A standing male nude in half-profile facing right, legs apart, hands behind his back. Above on the right, a repetition of the previous in sparse lines.
b200f586a7cdf363882f093d485177994defc8d4: In the foreground a boat with two people: a younger woman and a man rowing with his back (in a half-turn to the left) towards the viewer. On the left a stony bank. In the background - a building with a colonnade visible under the arch of the bridge on the left, in the background on the right - two buildings. High on the bank on the left a large tree stretching its branches over the river
94467c90898440709726482896a9bdb5eab57f88:
A. Drawn in a frame on the sheet, five okapis in different positions, in the foreground an okapi lying on the ground, on the right an okapi seen frontally, its head turned towards another okapi standing behind it, outside the frame, below to the right, some symbols are drawn.
B. On the sheet a similar but sketchier composition of okapis.
35c4fc34abca4ee90fe414501354f2ffdc6b8e97: Below in the centre, in the middle of the town square, a church. Below on the left a two-storey house with figures in the window openings. On the right a house, on the gable of which is an advertisement with a horseman: CINZANO. Above the town, against a dark sky, three flying angels making music: the middle one with an accordion, the one on the left with a guitar, and the one on the right with a violin.
a37ab259cccdd2abd2ec3c939e7c619cc4c40073: two female nudes with long black hair, backs facing each other, lower bodies bent backward. Heads turned over the shoulder to the left and right. Throughout the image white circles, black dots, between the figures a vertical plane with vertical lines, circles and dots. The frame around the figures has the same motif
1169d711c17342d5e41e57ba098125a34e8baa81:
a) A croquis hour in the studio. A female nude lying on her back in the foreground, behind her four artists behind drawing boards and easels. Above on the right a bee. The nude has a smoking cigarette in her mouth.
b) Some intersecting streets (Avenue Maine), a partly shaded crescent moon, a man's head in a hat with an eagle, the outlines of a boot (Italy).
062e9bcf65f46e3b72ee1f29cc2c14a76954ef37: The basket is divided into eight by narrow protruding ribs. The rim of the basket is decorated with a stamped ornament of curling plant leaves and shell motifs. In the middle part of the handle a relief palmette, in the centre of which is a small knob, at each end of the handle a stylised leaf. The oval foot is divided into eight sections.
e1966c3b7933f6941be49fa3d2425dc25de77d65: In the foreground on the right, the face of a woman in a headscarf tilted to the left, eyes closed, a hand with spread fingers under her chin. On the left, partly in the woman's shadow, the bust portrait of a man, bearded face, his head also tilted to the left, eyes directed towards the woman. On the man's shoulder a cross. At the top edge of the sheet, human heads in scarves and helmets.
ea34da8190b1eefbf95aad6a80bcb65d7210fefb: An image printed from a three-part plate, cut off with an indented edge below on the left, the middle section depicts Harju Hill with the monument of V. Kingissepp and the wall of a house on the right, from which a hand and faces protrude. The left section depicts the skating rink with St. Charles's Church (Kaarli kirik) in the background. The right section - fragile-lined figures
5abb0679e4dbf568514e98777a66f92605d0c0a8: A summer view of a town with a river. On the left, a river winding into the distance, with a stone bridge resting on two arches. On the bank, on the left in the centre, a church with a sharp-pointed tower and a green tree. On the river, near the right bank, a small red boat, on the bank some trees, a lone pedestrian, further back densely packed multi-storey town houses
d61afe482f91f5d286f013af90b30cc15a93ec4c: On the left a man in a soldier's uniform standing seen frontally, holding a horse depicted in profile. On the right a seated man and woman, both holding paper and a pencil. Behind them, from the window of a building, the heads of horses look out. In the background, further away, several more buildings and sketchily depicted horsemen
0b51440068c752a597e2d338b68905a7910e4e73: Friedrich Tammik's (b. 1897) oil painting "Suur Tõll", donated to the museum on the occasion of the thirtieth anniversary of the restoration of independence of the Republic of Estonia, complements the collection of paintings of Estonian steamships and the painting collection of the artist Friedrich Tammik. The painting is also a significant addition to the topic of Suur Tõll as a museum ship.
7bd5fd7e0f94a8fdb933c5da6ea091dcabddd8ff: View of Kadriorg Palace from the seaward side. In the foreground, a footpath in front of the palace, with groups of trees to its right and left. On the right edge of the footpath a group of three figures, on the left a solitary figure with a dog. Behind the group of trees on the left the palace buildings can be seen. The sheet is surrounded by a single decorative frame.
492f55dd0907e3e814cd12cce7b523f4c6061058: Four barefoot male figures sitting in profile facing right, holding on to each other with their hands. The first and last wear cone-shaped hats. The first has his right arm bent at the elbow, held straight out in front, fingers spread. The background is an expressive sky with a small group of trees visible in the back right.
4fc7a659e37eab334519a6887cb9f6f6a84c7ef0: Upper left: a female nude; lower right corner: a reclining male nude and five different sketches: one for the composition DREAM, upper right; one for the composition GOING OUT IN THE EVENING, lower right; two sketches of a female portrait, centre right; and one sketch for a composition with an older man and a woman, lower left.
620bf1475619770006456d1ef4fa6e66cb581ba8: Six undefined images in two rows. Above: a portrait of an ancient warrior with a shield, a half-figure of an ancient warrior facing forward, and a round shield with a quiver with arrows attached to it. In the lower row: a man's face in half-profile facing left, a round shield with ornament, and a rectangular octagonal shield with ornament.
44b8cad0b975cea0c4a181a8082bd7a144ea95cf: In an exotic landscape, lower left, under a strange tree, a small male figure running to the right. On the right, partly behind the foliage of the tree, a large female nude in profile facing right, her head turned back over her right shoulder looking down to the left, her left arm at a right angle above her head, her right arm behind the tree. On the ground, plants resembling flames.
458031cb6488cefc496e4c0ff1049dada264e898: The acclaimed Latvian printmaker Aleksandrs Dembo (1931–1999) took part repeatedly in the Tallinn Print Triennial and received recognition for his works there (1968, 1980). "Baltic Songs", acquired as a gift from the Latvian Museum of Art, remains to this day the only example of Dembo's work in the Art Museum of Estonia's collection.
fdfc6bb28ec75bfb2f936115607926e13c435390: In the foreground, centre, a group of large dark green trees, behind which a purplish-blue river. By the river, to the right of the trees, a solitary man in a hat fishing. In the distance, patches of forest and meadows, on the left a group of white houses with red roofs. On the horizon a dark blue streak, above a dark, ominous-looking sky.
429d593ba45873ee2c2ce34472a8401fa1e4f648:
In the foreground on the ground, a boy leafing through a book; lower left a crown with an eagle with outspread wings on top of it; in the background a winter landscape, a hare running to the left, a hunter shooting with a rifle, three birds, in the distance trees and a sharp-pointed tower; below, the text: HILLAR
                KOPPELI
                   RAAMAT
5ba89f7b4cdb109133be63c2380ee64cf8b31652: In the foreground, a female nude lying diagonally, her head to the right, her body half covered with translucent cloth. Behind her, in the centre, two women standing in translucent robes. Further back, six more reclining female nudes, positioned in the same direction as the first. Among them, upper left, a standing female figure with a veil on her head.
c32275160bb99fe9e94378cc0aa34c54df51c462:
A pensive man with a teapot. Below the image, the text:
The theme "The Artist and the Model", presumably due to its particular intimacy, has found little use in Estonian art. Now this sparse gallery is joined by yet another drawing, capturing the master of suggestive materiality, Olev Maran.
faa8401afa68e2b2476017dabe2c139a96bf26ac: A log man stands with his back to the viewer, arms outspread or fingers splayed, embracing various objects in the landscape. This is done with many well-known buildings of Tallinn, Tartu, Jõhvi and Toila. Interspersed with images from medieval manuscripts and reproductions. All of this is accompanied by avant-garde brass music.
e0dbb48f285f2d916b80ee071d64c3bf8250d5ff: On a dark square background, a chalice stands on a horizontal surface, surrounded by human, bird, horse and other masks, from which some liquid flows into the chalice. Above the chalice, on an object resembling an (eye)egg, hovers the figure of a stylised naked seated person, holding a smaller chalice surrounded by masks.
ca829a2184d9d81ddd5c0b467c9eb2155809adf9: In the foreground, centre, a figure lying prone with its feet toward the viewer (the number 35 under both soles). All lines and dotted lines converge to one point on the horizon. In various places, black discs, rectangles, posts and curved lines. Along the lower edge, the numbers one to zero repeat 8 times.
7934f9ad1cea9b2a353b94a83056a47ae9f88521: In a winter landscape, in the foreground on the right, an elderly man and woman in winter clothing stand side by side, the man with a pipe in his mouth, both looking left toward a female skier in the background. The skier wears a long skirt; she moves with her legs apart and arms outspread, her skis pointing left. In the background, on the right, houses and trees.
dfa05a916992ebcc01bde9a6d2d2ad3cb7b79d54: In the foreground, a slightly diagonal street along which two people are walking side by side to the right. Along the street a plank fence, behind which the silhouettes of trees can be seen. In the centre, a two-storey house with its gable end facing the street, behind which a church building with a tall tower stands parallel to the street. Between the two buildings, two human figures.
b0173cc8b9ff1f4c8e6d143284b59362ea61498f: Jaanus Samma's set, addressing queer themes through the aesthetics of folk art, combines heritage and socially topical contemporary issues into a witty artist's investigation, whose output expands the boundaries of (graphic) art while remaining notably true to visual argumentation.
7fc42196e77d3a81385b71db223929ca4a71ae11: In the foreground, an old man sowing, turned a quarter to the left, one hand holding a seed basket, the other stretched forward. Behind the figure, a ploughman and horse moving to the right. In the background, a landscape with a windmill, two peasants in a cart, and on the right two horses pulling a load of hay, a farm building. Above, a few clouds and the sun.
42578343b2fe8c1aab5b88b3bd1424f95075ca3b: Illustration for the first scene of the second act: on the right, by a small table, a young man in Livonian-style attire sits on a chair - Kaupo. Behind him the abbot of the monastery and a priest-monk. On the left a man in the mantle of a Sword Brother, behind him two of Kaupo's men dressed in Livonian style. All eyes are directed to the right.
49a17c69c8959978b3852cb669f415c25139d850:
a) dominated by a large head shown frontally, in the lower half of which a female nude (3/5 figure) fits, and through which two more heads shine from the left and right.
b) a man's half-figure pressing a woman against himself. Both cling to each other with gentle masks that conceal their true monstrous faces.
02ce55f80465eb68c413806f0c9f6a915e3ac69a: In a gloomy interior, lit by rays of light coming from the side, a female nude stands in half-profile facing left, at a large pair of scales. To her right sits an old man with glasses and a beard, leaning slightly forward, counting coins. On the right, a young man stands facing the viewer, a sword in a sheath on his back. In the centre below, a cat playing with a coin.
1863ef16f8e153db54d919b1b95c1a589f8d162a: Due to his life having been cut short, Erik Obermann's surviving creative legacy is scant and his works are rare, which is why this caricature, made in Munich, is a valuable addition to Estonian museum collections. The caricature reflects Obermann's characteristic artistic hand and social nerve.
9145f3079b9182fae29af1a2c4eb7c24b46e8760: View into the interior of a log cabin, with a wall with a window on the left. A woman with a headscarf standing behind a table. On the table, dishes, above which a kerosene lamp shines. Under the window a bench, behind it another window. On the right a Russian stove. Outside on the left, a man in a long greatcoat with epaulettes stands facing the viewer, a bundle over his shoulder. Further away a tree and a well.
d00b0d3c74afd3c929e11e62581b20f405135934: Taavi Suisalu's work stems from modern society's relationship with technology and its effect on the behaviour, perception and thinking of the social being. He can be considered a representative of the second generation of technological art. His works are characterised by technical complexity, masterful execution, and aesthetic quality.
5e187f0c59d7b8f39edf4b70985af0d61b9e6bec: In the foreground, a stout man in a winter coat with a fur collar, walking to the left; in his left hand a walking stick with a knob, and a smoking cigarette in his mouth. Behind him, on the right, stands a lady watching him with her eyes; in her left hand a small bag, and a fur boa around her neck. In the background, on the left, an advertising pillar.
c6359c5547c17af895a820909761834f9b06b1e0: Circular composition in a stylised manner. A bearded old man's 3/4 figure in profile to the left, wearing a hat, a light shirt and a dark waistcoat. The old man sits on a bench, hands in his lap. To the right is the corner of a table with a beer mug, to the left the 3/5 figure of a standing girl. Background of a meadow with birches and bushes.
294eafc63eae1a3bfed5558791d0550789ec5416: Vytautas Valius (1930–2004), a well-known Lithuanian graphic artist, has written himself into Estonian art history as one of the three laureates of the 1st Tallinn Graphic Art Triennial (1968) (nomination for the series "Planeet"). The work "Planeet VI" belongs to the same series and is a good addition to the history of Estonian graphic art.
c75d4c1b2ed124ad92be843917fd25efbcb92903: In the foreground on the right, a large, human-like animal figure crouches. Between the hooves of its right front leg is a bottle, under its left front leg a writhing peasant. Beside the figure on the ground is a row of empty bottles. In the background on the left, a man in uniform, whose raised right hand holds a disc with the text KEELU SEADUS
53385206748a8c7e16d55ff0bdbbf7233134b510:
In a book with hard pink covers, 18 leaves, of which 4 are blank, 4 printed with text. Designed in woodcut:
cover with a thunderbolt and two "p" letters; page with the title "piksepalve"; vignette with a thunderbolt; frontispiece depicting fire; title page "pikse 1644 palve"; 7 pages of text; 2 vignettes with a thunderbolt
f0db68fff7cc36b996c50ce0d257191275f694a9: Half-figure of a woman in frontal view, head in half-turn to the right. Hair put up, a bow at the nape. A cape covering the forehead, neck and shoulders leaves the breast bare. Left hand raised to the waist. Right eye half-closed. In the background concentric arcs, fine grids, on the right a curtain marked with a few strokes.
e1478da56c88a0b449012fd0d121ff4ae73e5773: In the grass at the front left a child sitting on a snail's shell; behind her a girl in a lilac dress, with a bluebell flower on her head, walking to the left. Further back, near the hollow of an old tree trunk, sits an owl, and in a carriage harnessed to a butterfly sits a fair-haired girl. In front of the "vehicle" a gnome with a lantern. Full moon in the sky.
519ca10c36f5a6e7386e837b70d8407cabc6b3e8: In a theatre box, sitting side by side in half-profile to the left: on the right an elderly man with a moustache in a formal suit, hands in front, at the edge of the box, with many rings on both hands, and on the left a stout lady in a dress with a large décolleté, wearing necklaces and earrings. Behind, on the left, a column and the faces of two more men.
3d9728013a2389b49d512e7b24276cd1913d51ea: On the left – the head of a man with an elongated face, tilted to the right, glasses askew on his nose. Beside him the head of a man in a slight turn to the right, and the three-quarter figure of a man in a greatcoat, in profile to the left, a cigarette falling from his mouth. In the centre the face of a man smoking a pipe, in profile to the left. On the right an elongated head of a man in frontal view
973a8fa899c9b717019202a7a6f7d18f78c26c33:
A dark-haired man with a moustache and beard sharpening a scythe. Below the depiction, text:
Paul-Eerik Rummo has got stuck living in the countryside in autumn, in a merciless urge for de-aestheticisation whittles a scythe to pass the time, senses nature and, casting aside all sorts of decorative gadgets, philosophises about his life.
fa388b6fe022b7154a47195f8e951dce2ad7fd00: The jug stands on three gilded balls held between eagle's talons. The lid was probably modelled on the cylindrical jug made by V. Adriani (EKM B 325), as the details of the two jugs are very similar, differing only in the design of the lid. The lid of this jug is decorated with the coat of arms and motto of the Blackheads.
09ff94301edf06baadc49b708c1a01e45c914b2d: The lower part of the slightly upward-widening bowl is articulated into six convex surfaces. On the upper, smooth part of the bowl is engraved the Rehbinder coat of arms (3 crowned serpents and 10 stars). The knop is likewise divided into six convexities, the foot is hexagonal, with a small sharp point after every two facets.
45b47702f826c9f5106d202223aeaaf137586636: Alexandra Milyakina has made illustrations for several Tartu cafés, bars, cultural institutions and enterprises, and shares them with Tartu residents and those interested in Tartu also via social media. Important material for recording the activity of artists inspired by Tartu.
a50974381adb3316b563bed769ddc484428f8604: Colour digital print on cover board. In front on the right, half the head of a girl in a blue dress – a long ponytail with a pink bow, and a shoulder. Behind her, a girl in green, slightly bent over, right hand plucking at a necklace. Eyes covered with a broad white-and-black polka-dot kerchief. In the background a stone wall and grass.
52fda1de9ab28b753277e140c2c27a43287d499e: Portrait of a seated girl in frontal view, body turned slightly to the left, gaze on the viewer, the woman has short curly hair, wears a dress with long gathered sleeves, around her neck a patterned scarf fastened with a bunch-of-grapes brooch, on a finger of the left hand a ring with a gemstone, the model being Miss Tall.
5c7444aede135197ec1d992972f98a96a249866d: In the upper part of the envelope, five okapis in different positions sketched in red chalk, in the lower part six more clearly distinguishable okapis in black chalk, in the middle part, upside down, remain a blue sticker LUFTPOST PAR AVION, the artist's address in Paris and three Swedish postage stamps of ten-unit denomination.
1aa80eb0342c3743bb2504faaa260944374ced9a: Two female nudes: the left one seated, body in three-quarter turn to the left, head in profile to the left, left hand placed behind the back, legs sketched, without feet. The right nude standing, in profile to the left, left hand on the left thigh, the raised right hand only sketched, as are the calves.
c360b77969a253b94dea10e0960d1683222d84b2: At the bottom right a seated female nude in half-back view, turned to the left. The left hand rests straight on the ground beside her. With the right hand she reaches a small bowl to a small man seated at the bottom left. Behind, on the left, a man with a large curly beard, in a wide-brimmed hat and a dark coat, walking to the right, hand in pocket
3544aee747ffb4156e083ffc3b0793f85e3f3697: Composition in mirror image, without the upper part. A tree with one branch sawn off and another split lengthwise, beside which two small children demonstrate the techniques of copper engraving and woodcut: the one on the left making a print in woodcut of a female figure, the one on the right engraving a child's head onto a stump.
f995b4062155471580d4e1b1deccf473a6f796ef: At the top right, in profile to the left, the face of a short-bearded man and two hands stretched forward in parallel, from which jagged, light rays of light emanate diagonally down to the left. At the bottom right, at a right angle, a fantastical being with human eyes and an animal muzzle. Darkness in the background on the left.
cdddd2e9b363ce04a284eb174dfcb294382791e8: A standing female figure on the left in frontal view, right hand behind the back, left hand stretched out to the side. Coloured with yellow, white and red chalk. A standing female nude on the right in half-turn to the right, hands stretched forward, left leg behind, head sketched in outline only. Coloured with white chalk.
ce066eb1c8c71604a8e453b085c8ae2ba364ed76: Two seated female nudes, legs sketched to the knees. The left one in back view, left hand at the side, right visible to the elbow, head tilted to the right. The right nude in half-turn to the right, only the right hand visible (to the wrist), head tilted to the left, eyes narrowed as if in bright light.
f109a26fb7c55fc67ab8daedf12e5cf6156fd839: On the left two standing female nudes in half-turn to the left, of which the left one is given in outline, the right one modelled with light and shade. At the bottom left a sketch of a man's head, at the top right of an arm, at the bottom right of a seated man drawing, in frontal view. On the verso a schematic nude figure.
4cce7de485140876ebfe207fa9017ad68cdbad35: A female nude drawn with a blue pencil, seated on a green armchair, in a slight turn to the left. A blue canotier crowns the round head, a red transparent robe covers the upper body. Left leg raised onto the right thigh. On the left the corner of a table with a bottle and a coffee cup. Study for the work "Women with Top Hats"
67898e5b3aa1b88b7cacb88516570095e4e2d14f: Full figure of an old man seated on a round base, in profile to the left. Elongated head, sparse short hair, slightly hooked nose, luxuriant beard, gaunt body. Right hand slightly bent, stretched back, left resting on the thigh. The nude's seat is a round base, under which is a woman's handbag, on which a pair of feet rests.
92f458224ff18b1cd680cd017b277e1d7310d4e9: U. Särev worked as a design artist at the Tartu Dairy Combine and the Tartu Trade Administration, and from 1969 to 1983 worked in the Arsi decoration workshop. Since his work is largely connected with Tartu, it is important to preserve it in order to reflect the history of the city of Tartu in the years 1950–1990.
e67ae5c18dcaeee63d1b4338bf61ae4e1b839da3: an artist looking out of his studio's skylight, cigarette in hand, wine glass on the table, behind him a wastebasket with discarded works, drawings on the walls, a coffee grinder on the table in front of the viewer, at the lower edge of the sheet a fantastical-visionary female figure and a hexagonal floor tile are drawn
f2d039b76a2bb78fc833b78e14984b2630f6a8d8: A. Seated woman, head turned to the right, gaze lowered, hands holding onto a column, a rhombus-shaped ring on the finger of her left hand, the motif of hands and column repeated on the left of the sheet. B. Small Arab boy, head in profile turned to the right, long eyelashes, wearing a kippah on his head, simple light-dark background.
00d91504c63045566288e2e96ef8c6966eb9ceb1: across the sheet six cats: above a seated cat looking straight ahead, below it a cat seen from the front, in the lower left corner a cat's head viewed from the left, upper right a cat sitting on the ground with a white nose and throat, below a half-crouching cat looking straight ahead, in the right corner a crouching cat in side view with head turned right
bb955057750a22e8742fa7b57455927a2b9985b0: in the right part of the sheet a man standing at a door, holding a club, looking at a figure pleading on the left, whose body is a book with the inscription: АПОЛЛОН. At the feet of the man with the club sits another male figure on the ground, reading a newspaper with the inscription САТИРНКОН. Above these men, on the door arch, a sign LINNARAAMATUKOGU
765956cc9cd35448b8fb16c8cbf9122f01c4b901: in the foreground an ancient warrior bent forward, in his right hand a sword, which he holds against the chest of a man lying on the ground. In the middle a young frightened woman, held from behind by two warriors, an infant in the woman's arms. On the right a warrior taking the infant from the woman. In the background a group of warriors and a horseman
c20051d8e60747c15f0d6e0ddad9872f231d4d43: in the foreground, in the middle, in profile to the right, a portrait figure of a man seated at a table, head slightly bowed forward, in his left hand, on the table, a cup, in his right - a fish on the end of a fork, between his hands a bowl of potatoes, an open tin can, to the right a radio. Above the man's neck vertebrae an open mouth with teeth and tongue
3fa2387653e0dfff3addc58d96f4f3b8caf157bb: The urn-shaped vessel has two tall handles. The upper edge of the box and the lid, and the junction of the body and the foot, are decorated with a beaded cord. The lid tapers to a spear-shaped knob. There is a spoon groove on the edge of the lid. The rounded foot of the box is surrounded by a relief laurel wreath, the foot in turn resting on a smooth rectangular base.
b55e9a53de41e01ec580da5aa5460bfb0947ec46: view of the ruins of a brick church building on a slope, in front two massive towers without spires, with pointed-arch window openings, between them a pointed-arch portal, behind partially visible a section of the building with buttresses and a roof. Around the building scattered trees, in front a branching path runs.
90cb705dca1fa1644145be59e8418e2ce5eb83d6: One of the earliest richly illustrated albums introducing Tartu and the University of Tartu, for which the large-format aquatint drawings were made by Karl August Senff, the University of Tartu's first drawing teacher. The album complements the Art Museum of Estonia's collection of Baltic German graphic art.
1100ae0366d568fde3c1f7411dd4800e13fb4168: Ain Protsin (b. 1958) is a press photographer and photo artist working in Tartu. Important in his work is a sensitive choice of motif and unexpected viewpoints; here one finds clever emotional documentarism, humorous conceptualism, enjoyable formal aesthetics, and sensitive portraits.

Kai Kaljo's video is based on the letters of her artist father Richard Kaljo to her and her mother Mia Kaljo.

Above, on the left, a seated female nude seen frontally, leaning back on her left hand placed behind her. Right arm bent upward on the knee of the right leg. Left leg beneath the latter. Head tilted slightly to the left.

dc5b2fe88ea9b709cdd6cb8a1e5a0840a6c9ea63: A standing female figure in a half-turn to the right, left hand at the chin, right arm extended holding a handbag hanging from a long straight strap. c8ca78bdaddb48e89098dfd8b24f819c5e1a6216:
Academic drawing after a plaster cast: a male nude hung on a tree.
The model for the plaster sculpture, a Hellenistic sculpture, is in the Louvre in Paris. In the sculpture Marsyas is tied to the tree awaiting flaying. The accompanying figures - a Scythian sharpening a knife and Apollo - are apparently missing.
3f0d701c84aea266522dce9b741664dc7e809d8a:
A) The figure of a man resting on one knee, in a half-turn to the left, bare torso, arms raised up. Below on the right the same figure with a harp between his knees. In the centre on the left a lyre.
B) A half-figure of the same man in a half-turn to the left, to the right of it the motif of the left arm extended sideways is repeated.
308a68083e0701ec34fbc4667ea40e0f3d8ef2ad: A composition of geometric shapes in steel-grey, black-and-white tones. In front and on the right spherical surfaces, in the centre a circle cut by a black parallelogram. Behind, on both sides, silhouettes of buildings as coulisses. The composition is surrounded by a greyish-brown border.
da040751f412118703119fba3d5a8a4d901c6c13:
In the centre of the sheet two seated men, hands on their stomachs, legs apart. Below on the right the half-figure of a third man seen from behind, face turned towards the others, to the left. In the foreground on the left a campfire. In the background in the centre a wall of boards and landscape motifs.

On the verso, upper left, an art fund label.
2cb701e5f49f60c9f51b8a4018d43f461112c37a: On the sheet a faceless divided male figure, around the head alternating stamps with portraits of the radio inventors Popov and Marconi. The image is supplemented with the inscription in red "Potentsiaalne raadio leiutaja" ["Potential radio inventor"]
70339f7d5199d57634d829161274cc9b64e1168c: A view of a square, where in front on the right a bush and on pedestals two large recumbent figures of animals (lions). On the left edge a park, in the background a hilly, forested landscape with solitary buildings on the hills.
6f74f7ac713b463f701d801cd8a9ef332b8f40c3: In the foreground a sandy shore with a few large stones, in the left part a woman with a load of boards. Along a diagonal line beginning at a cart and horse and heading right, isolated figures are placed, in the distance women standing approaching a boat. In the boat a group of men lowering a net into the sea.
082adff9caf0e2148207cd4d90df39d12d7de43e: two lithographs for the illustrations of the second scene of the third act: on the left-hand one, Lembitu risen to his feet at the table, with him three seated men. 51127a7be11c0c0aadec362caf6fad6b2d7960f2:

d) Bookplate "Tiit Okas"

2b0b2e0b06b8607e6403fa402e6d857f448a14be:
An older thin man, a cigarette in his mouth, hand in trouser pocket, in front of him an empty picture frame held by a woman's hand. The composition is in a rectangle, below which is the author's text:
An inimitable lithographic technique, a sensitive gaze and an impeccable physique - such a man can only be Alo Hoidre.
dfc5712f08e8dea48b7542f9be732b484d9c8a49: A view of a single-storey manor house, with a wing with a stepped gable at one end and an entrance with a sloping roof, and at the other end a veranda with a gabled roof. 293b832c059d0645eaec7cfe3d90c5d9f9d24eb3: A bare landscape with scraggly pines, death striding against the sky background, a scythe on its shoulder. In the middle left, from an unhatched area, the image of a mystical giant flower emerges, beside it a winding snake, mushrooms, plants. At the roots of the left pine, 2 small animals. The image is created by varying hatching
ffc9663c78b04c302af2e93155d557feace4c7cb:
At the top right of the sheet, an exhibition invitation card with information on the printing press and poster "Au Sacre du Printemps". At the bottom left of the sheet, a portrait of a smiling man wearing an aviator's cap and goggles (Charles Lindbergh). 
At the bottom right of the sheet, a bust portrait of a bearded man in half-profile to the right, arms crossed.
c3768782b50be33b578e8294c07f8e97fab6d288:
A. Zebra's head in half-turn to the left, zebra with an upright mane, left ear unfinished, black narrow crossbands on the body, horizontal hatching in the background.

566f80bd5f11dc46c5bc42414e7dd3f8c87a80c4: In a room with an arched door, in the foreground on the floor a half-reclining nun in a white habit and black kerchief, to her left a young man in a short belted coat. c37a6fb7c83c06374ea94b652608fe3e2e31e896: View of the buildings and park of Kose manor. In the distance the manor park with buildings. The sheet is surrounded by a single decorative frame.
5b4b0f8c6ff51bbc1088007e6322b576baf35924: Sketches of trees and bushes. In the bottom row, from left to right, four sketches: a single bushy branch, a stunted grove with two trunks, three upright bushes and a single bushy branch. In the top row, from left to right, a bushy and leafless tree, a bushy tree with a thick trunk, a spruce and a bush, and a bushy tree.
353cfc8a456ea5d1fa25556b7bb214efb04b510b: A black surface divided by coloured lines into overlapping squares, triangles, rectangles, creating a recurring arrow motif. Exlibris for the University of Tartu Library. The composition uses Parrot and Peterson, the portal of the library located on Toome Hill.
The exlibris is in a mount and a wooden frame with simple profiling, on the back two metal hanging clamps and a University of Tartu Library congratulatory card.
0eb1e75711b1f675d67f7f9bf67934307a82c129: In the foreground, a three-quarter figure of a reclining female nude, right hand beside the body, left hand on the body. In the image, at the bottom left corner, a vase with flowers
801c7ea77a123025d1bdbbe9ddbe0c0b2194264a: In the foreground a large-eyed, madonna-like female figure in a slight turn to the right, gaze directed to the right, into the distance, on her head a wide hemp-cloth hood, in the background a natural landscape with a body of water and stones, on the right a small forest. On the sheet, at the bottom left, in pencil: vernis-mou 1952 1/75,
058bbdc051d538f667d2c5ff58228be888c57f79: In the foreground the sea shore with the mouth of the Härjapea stream, to its left sheep, cows and 5 child figures, to the right of the stream 3 children and animals. Behind the green hills, the Bay of Tallinn with sailing ships and the silhouette of the Old Town. The tower of St. Olaf's before the 1820 fire. On the shore, on the right, a horseman
e2a5681aa0d4e496b17bfa593b49b2b2e166de66: In the interior, in the centre on a carpet, behind a round table, on the left a woman sitting in an armchair in half-profile to the right, holding with her left hand near her face a decorated comb-like object, right hand on the edge of the table, on the table a frame with drawings. e33e6295fa88d520c1e7a524fae8b0b3fffe8f00: Two women in loose, short-sleeved dresses sitting on a sofa in similar poses: right leg raised, left arm placed back on the backrest, head in half-turn to the right. f003d4db3cbb3c90c86cd3b3a89b78932585d14a:
A) In the foreground an uneven landscape, in the distance a house with a red roof and industrial buildings with three towers. Trees on the right and left.

5277c766cd0465f903a8dff6a24474dea7e9577a: In the foreground a three-quarter figure of a thin man with a frightened face, frontal view, head in half-profile to the right, holding with his left hand a cloth pouch hanging on his right hip. Below, sketches of the left hand.
1f5426902f076e7b99f00bce4c2338a0ed888832:
Wine jug with lid. 
Wine jug with rococo-imitation ornament on the lid, spout, handle and foot. The ornamented parts are gilded, the rest of the surface is silvered. 
The Calvary group has been lost from the body of the jug - this detail can be seen in a photograph taken by the Parikas brothers in 1943.
3c68627302b0e393b5c2fc51fbaa2641f5f74114: A diagonally reclining female nude - a knee-length figure, head at the top left. At the bottom left, a fabric-textured, softly frothing surface, at the top right a texture resembling aquatint grain.
4e7abac5f4f7809656ab1c6524d62fc60cd9b66c: On the railway tracks, a snail is harnessed in front of a "train" consisting of three hemisphere-shaped carriages. 8b74a8b811108e475cd50ba8fe5fd19fd1a5a36e: A half-figure, frontal view, of a lady in festive attire sitting in a box with curtains on the sides, on the lady's head a richly decorated headdress, small human figures on the shoulders, in her hand long-stemmed gloves. Hands in front, on the edge of the box, in the right hand a sheet with the text "LIBRETTO", in the left glasses.
544681253fba288e6b43d40dad33802c3598612e:
In the lower half of the sheet a fence of horizontal boards, behind it deciduous trees. Further back a stone wall, behind it trees, between which two gable roofs and a tall church tower are visible.
In the upper half of the sheet, in the foreground a bare landscape, in the distance the roofs of low farmhouses closely grouped together.
4b6b03e3f8fcb0014f539ae8c544d9b4381e8476:
On the left, in an upright rectangle, a design for an exlibris, at the top the text: EX LIBRIS
Below the text, in a rectangle with rounded corners, a broken, thick tree, behind it three slender trees. Below, a chamomile-like plant motif, at the bottom edge a ribbon.. to the right of the design, interlaced ovals.

A man with wavy glasses, below a girl with sunglasses and a tape measure. Below the image the text:
The Hiiumaa art prize did not come easily to Olev Soans. In the picture you see him doing survey work in wild elemental conditions for his award-winning "Map of Estonian Maritime History".
985050a0c0fd7bf76e3e0f4ba724bd185685d56c: Mare Vint is a prominent Estonian graphic artist, whose oeuvre is characterised by exceptional wholeness and consistency. In this legacy, very diverse examples deserve attention, both early experiments in poster art and later metaphysical series of prints.
e8544f21eb351e6b343b33025c263236437bb6d2:
a) Standing female nude leaning on a post with the left hand, in a frontal view, right hand behind the back, gaze directed down to the right.
b) Standing female nude leaning against a post with the left hand, in profile to the left, weight of the body on the left leg. At the bottom edge a dark horizontal surface, behind which the feet remain hidden.
6cfb60642c418848e052ad6d84219be02f999b5f: A radio mechanism built into a cigar box with a mythological picture and an Italian text, together with an earpiece. The image is complemented by red inscriptions, at the top right "Marconi built his first wireless receiver into a cigar box in 1895" and at the bottom "Diagram of the 1896 model".
d599bb5ac0b9f50f8aaf0b814baedf382ed8b5de:
Head of a man with long hair, a moustache and a beard, turned to the right, a chest ornament around the neck, above the chest a bird and a woman's head, wings instead of shoulders, composition within a rectangle, below which the author's text:
Neck ornament "Rein Mets". Material: silver, beard, mother-of-pearl and raisins.
743d2a3db5ebcb84d36b7aca587c47ce53c1b5a6: In front, on a dark background, a white human figure lying down, right leg bent at the knee and raised slightly. At the top right an arched opening, in which, against a blue background, a motif of an angel with double wings is visible.
9219eae84aae0460e2e5590971c5e1fbd5f0c2e2:
Portrait of a round-bearded man within a circle, a clothes brush in his right hand. Below the image the text:
Mait Summatavet, amid seven urgent tasks, still found enough time to brush the dust off his progressive chest -- the making and remaking of the "Ugala" interior -- for the prize money.
5fbbebda7fcb2ec0eb5fe1ededa05424aa7ee88b: Female nude knee-length figure lying on a sofa, head to the left, resting on the right hand. Left hand on the armrest of the sofa. In front on the left an arabesque of the armrest.
ec263832150f95fe61f1302b09c8daa9fb6f20ac: Colour digital print on cardboard panel. In front on the right, a girl in a half-turn with her hand on her hip, a pillow placed as a belly. 2b7be42172d8dfda823b4ffb15c4cddf56b0a181: From both edges of the sheet a thick dark line runs toward the lower right corner. At the height of the middle of the left edge, a short thick dark line and three thin lines run from top to bottom.
b793f83246e1694053fda7a49f4fced717712bdc: Ülle Meister's prints, drawings and watercolours vividly complement the overview of the development of Estonian graphic art in the 1960s-1990s. Among other things, they reflect such themes as the Soviet-era culture of mountain hiking, as well as an interest in Finno-Ugric peoples and their heritage.
bd8589d52368e134063f4a5a0d27dca8cd314a48: A characteristic example of Raoul Kernumees's early work, of which little has survived in museum collections. The drawing reflects the socially sensitive and characterful peasant themes typical of Kernumees. The sheet's value is enhanced by a pre-Second World War Cultural Endowment stamp.
599675839a9ad04630877db292749bb74b9be0a6: A densely filled composition with five heads: two women's heads -- top left and bottom right, between them two children's heads -- the raised left hands of both children are also visible. bbf13731efe6351cf8ddc5e66d09325f3d7df8ee: Against a background of a purplish-red starry sky, a female figure in folk costume standing on a bird with outstretched wings, arms bent at the elbows and raised, holding a radiant sun disc in the left hand. Covers of grey linen fabric, at the centre right ribbons attached to the front and back covers.

Under Jaan Kaplinski's childishly joyful gaze, Estonian artists capture on walrus tusks the beauty of our vanishing and endangered coloured world.

The original binding gives the booklet added value.

a rebirth and straight into the front rank of our contemporary musicians.

Light green, light blue, grey, pink and white tones.
